settings.name: attendancelocationtimeout
settings.description:
If "attendancelocationtimeout" == 0, then Attendance will happen in Offline mode (Location NOT mandatory, Internet NOT mandatory).

If "attendancelocationtimeout" == 1, Attendance functionality will be online.
(Location Mandatory, Internet Mandatory)
Location will be mandatory and Attendance will be marked ONLY if the Location is received. App will wait for 60 seconds to get the Location and syncs to Bizom server. If Location is NOT received or Attendance Sync fails, Error is displayed.

If "attendancelocationtimeout" == 2, Attendance functionality will be online but Location will NOT be mandatory.
(Location NOT Mandatory, Internet Mandatory)
If within 60 seconds Location is not received, the Attendance is synced without Location to Bizom Server. If not synced, Error is displayed.
If "attendancelocationtimeout" == 3, attendance functionality will be offline. Location will be mandatory. If Location is not received within 30 seconds, Error will be shown.

settings.name: checkforuniqueoutletmobilenumber
settings.description:
Accepted values are 0,1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8 or 9.Determines if the outlet phone numbers (i.e outlets.phoneno) should be unique across outlets during outlet add and edit. If the setting value is 1 we will enable check for unique outlet phone. If the setting value is 2 we will enable check for combination of outlet gstinno and outlet phone. If the setting value is 3 we will enable check for unique outlet gstinno. If the setting value is 4 we will enable check for combination of outlet panno and outlet phone. If the setting value is 5 we will enable check for unique outlet panno. If the setting value is 6 we will enable check for outlet gstinno and outlet phone independently, i.e. outlet add/edit is blocked if either the outlet phone or the outlet gstinno already exists on another outlet and is allowed only when both are unique. If the setting value is 7 we will enable check for outlet panno and outlet phone independently, i.e. outlet add/edit is blocked if either the outlet phone or the outlet panno already exists on another outlet. If the setting value is 8 we will enable check for outlet gstinno and outlet panno independently, i.e. outlet add/edit is blocked if either the outlet gstinno or the outlet panno already exists on another outlet. If the setting value is 9 we will enable check for outlet gstinno, outlet panno and outlet phone independently, i.e. outlet add/edit is blocked if any one of the outlet gstinno, outlet panno or outlet phone already exists on another outlet and is allowed only when all of them are unique. If setting value is 0, Check is disabled. This has been handled in App and Web

NOTE :: If you are enabling this setting then make sure you are setting phoneno field as required in basic outlet formoutletadd formdefintion and outletedit formdefinition
NOTE :: For setting values 6, 7, 8 and 9, at least one of the fields checked by that value (phoneno, gstinno, panno) must be sent in the request, otherwise outlet add/edit will be rejected. Setting values 6, 7, 8 and 9 are also validated in MDM/bulk outlet upload.

settings.name: multischemeenable
settings.description: This is a company based setting. If this setting value is set to 1, it will enable multiple/group scheme on same skunit. Default value is 0. Note: Once this setting is enabled / changed the existing schemes configured will stop applying. Hence if there are any active schemes you will have to recreate them to get the schemes working.

settings.name: inventory_audit
settings.description: This setting will give access for inventory audit. Default value is 1 and 0 is to disabled inventory audit screen for company/user/role/designation wise.

settings.name: enablePaymentsRetailer
settings.description: This indicates that payment tab field should be visible in the app. If value is set to 1 then payment tab will be display in retailers app else it wont display in retailers app.

settings.name: enableOrderFeedback
settings.description: If setting values is 0. Feedback Feature will be disabled in retailers app.If setting values is 1. Feedback Feature will be disabled in retailers app.

settings.name: automatic_eod
settings.description: This setting is used in APP for automatically send EOD on value if set 1. If a value set 0 then a user should submit EOD manually.

settings.name: loyaltypoints
settings.description: This setting will give access for loyalty points. Default value is 0 and 1 is to enable loyalty point data calculations.

settings.name: enablebatch
settings.description:
This setting is used to enable the batch through out the system. default value is 0, to enable set it to 1.
NOTE:- Enablebatch= 1, (you must set 'checkavailableinventory' to 1)Inventory of all the active batches will be considered. Enablebatch= 0, Only the inventory of batch_id=0 will be considered.
Pre-requisites before enabling:
1. Clear all pending Goods Receipt Notes (GRNs).
2. Complete all pending sales return approvals.
3. Once the above steps are complete, clear and deactivate any inventory with a zero batch ID or without a batch. This means that both saleable and non-saleable stocks should have a zero quantity.

settings.name: qtyincasesformobile_pri
settings.description: This setting is handled in web and app portal for primary transactions. If set to 1, only cases are visible. If set to 2, only units are visible. If set to 0, both units and cases are visible

settings.name: loyaltypointConversionRate
settings.description: This setting is used to convert the points to cash. For Ex: 100 points = 1 INR. Default value is 0, U can give the no of points that can be converted for 1 Rupee.

settings.name: inventoryapproval
settings.description: if it is 1 it will enable inventory movement approval process

settings.name: inventoryapprovalroles
settings.description: Comma Separated Role Id's who can approve inventory audit(inventoryapproval has to be set to 1).

settings.name: prefix_to_creditno
settings.description: Default Value is '', if any value is added this prefix is added to the credit note number.

settings.name: suffix_to_creditno
settings.description: Default Value is '', if any value is added this suffix is added to the credit note number.

settings.name: prefix_to_debitno
settings.description: Default Value is '', if any value is added this prefix is added to the debit note number.

settings.name: suffix_to_debitno
settings.description: Default Value is '', if any value is added this suffix is added to the debit note number.

settings.name: isprimaryorderupdate
settings.description: Possible Values are 0,1. If value is 0, primary order list wont be displayed. If value is 1, primary order can be edited and order states of multiple orders can be changed.  The default value is "0".This setting is used only in APP.

settings.name: supportedCountries
settings.description: This setting is used to set preferred countries in phone number drop down menu. Use comma separated countries code to use this ( These will appear on top of drop down menu, The first one in the list will be default selected ). Country code for india is 'in', China is 'cn' etc. Example: in,us,cn

settings.name: enablesalereturnreplacement
settings.description: This is supported in case of OMS and DMS in both app & web. Default value is 0. If setting value is 1, salereturn replacement feature will be on. If setting value is 2, Support for "Replace with Return" on salerturn screen will be enabled and "Approve with Return" will be enabled on approval screen. Setting value= 0, replacement feature will be off. Note: This is warehouse wise setting

settings.name: replace_same_sku
settings.description: This setting default value is 1. if this setting value is 1 that means user can only replace same sku of returned prodcut.if value is 0 that means user can replace any sku. this setting is userwise, if same brand has to be replaced set to 2, if same subbrand has to be replaced set to 3.

settings.name: allowassignorder
settings.description:
User wise Setting Which will enable a user to assign orders from orders/newindex page.
If set to 1 will allow the user to assign order.

settings.name: maptype
settings.description: 1 will azure map and 2 will amazon map,  for google map please contact dev team

settings.name: chequenumberregex
settings.description: Default value \d{6} (as Indian cheques are of 6 digits). This setting supports regex value.This setting is warehousewise

settings.name: crosszonedepomapping
settings.description: Default value 0. Set the Value to 1 if cross zone depo mapping is required, this setting will affect only for admin, role id 1.

settings.name: checkoutletcreditdays
settings.description: used to block sale if there are pending payments exceeding credit limit days

settings.name: deliverymodulestatus
settings.description:
Controls the delivery selection mode. It allows configuration of whether delivery is disabled, supports multiple delivery selections, or restricts the user to selecting only one delivery option.
Disabled :value is set to 0.
Enabled : Value is set to 1 or 2. When value is set to 1 it allows multiple delivery selections. When value is set to 2 it allows only one delivery selection.

This setting is used to enable loadoutsheet for mobile

settings.name: calculateschemebudget
settings.description: The default value is 0. If set to 1, the scheme budget will be post-processed. If set to 2, the scheme budget will be pre-processed, ensuring it does not exceed the budget. If set to 3, it will be used to track the budget. This works only with scheme holder support. To extend support in the app, enable the Online Sale setting. Please contact R&D before enabling, as this is not supported in offline mode.

settings.name: enableuiforbulksku
settings.description: This setting is used to enable the UI for bulk skus.

settings.name: enableprimaryorderchallan
settings.description: If  enableprimaryorderchallan == 1 existing flow [email id which is mapped in the warehouse & user of role ID 4 to whom warehouse is mapped] if  enableprimaryorderchallan == 2  mail will be sent to email id which is mapped in the warehouse. if enableprimaryorderchallan  == 0 no email will be sent

settings.name: notification_service
settings.description: Setting to use notificationService module to send email or sms instead of using celery or push notification.If notification_service set to 1, then notification service will be used to send notification. If notification_service is set to 0, then celery or push notification will be used to send notification.

settings.name: onlinesale
settings.description:
This setting is only for app transactions.

Default value: 0 - Sale & Sale Return transactions will sync with a delay.

Value: 1 - Sale & Sale Return both primary & secondary transactions will sync immediately upon transaction submission.

Note: This setting will NOT be supported in offline mode or in areas with poor network connectivity.

settings.name: bidmaxamount
settings.description: This setting holds the maximum Bid amount allowed during Bid submission. Default value has to be set to "999999". Maximum allowed value should be Integer.MAX_VALUE (2147483647).

settings.name: max_image_dimensions
settings.description: This setting has two integer values with comma separated where first value will be the required width and second value will be the required height for calculating image scale size and the default value is 1000,1000

settings.name: defaultdialcode
settings.description: Default national dial code for the phone numbers.

settings.name: attendance_audit
settings.description: This is used for enabling attendance audit facility

settings.name: twofactorauth
settings.description: Possible values 0,1,2,3,4 ( 0 - No 2 Factor Authorization, 1 - Only SMS, 2- Only Email, 3 - Both SMS and Email, 4 - Twofactor authentication ). default value 0

settings.name: google_signin
settings.description: This setting is used to enable google signin feature. Default value is 0. Supported values are 0(Disable) and 1(enable). This works through company wise setting only.

settings.name: sync_limit_days
settings.description: Number of days after which user will be asked to force sync. This setting will be used only for selling point platform.

settings.name: cancelcollection
settings.description: This setting allows users to cancel a collection. It accepts two possible values: 0 (default) and 1. Setting the value to 1 enables the collection cancel option.The setting is supported at the company, role, user, and designation levels. By default, the cancel option is enabled for the Admin role. If you wish to disable it for Admin, please update the setting accordingly.

settings.name: cancelsalereturn
settings.description: This setting allows user to cancel the sale return. There are two possible values of this setting either 0 or 1. 0 is the default value and 1 is used for enabling the sale return cancel option.This setting is rolewise/userwise.

settings.name: staggeredqps
settings.description: Setting to enable Staggered Qps Scheme Calculation,Default Value is 0, if set to 1 Staggered Qps V1 calculation will be processed(Credit Note will be generated after invoice generation), if set to 2 Staggered Qps V2 calculation will be processed(Benefit In Line with Skunit as Scheme).

settings.name: trackLocationAfterAttendance
settings.description: Default value is 0. If the value is 1 then the location is tracked after attendance and if the value is 0 then the location is tracked from the first activity as per existing flow.

settings.name: sp_inventoryAllow
settings.description: This setting is used to reduce the API calls done for the users which are not having different inventory for warehouses assigned to that user.

settings.name: password_ageing_days
settings.description:
Setting to force the user to reset their password after 'n' number of days.
To disable the feature, set the value to 0.

settings.name: previous_password_count
settings.description: Setting to enable the number of logs to be maintained for the password such that the user can not use the password that used previously. To disable the feature, set the value to 0.

settings.name: retailerapppops
settings.description: This is used to add more filters while creating pops for retailer app banner purpose

settings.name: enterponumber
settings.description:
Setting value 1 - Allows to enter the PO number while placing the order in Mobile APP.
Setting value 2 - Allows to enter the PO number only for the outlets marked as is_mt_outlet (Value of is_mt_outlet =1 in outlets table).
Default value is 0.

settings.name: outlettypecollateral
settings.description: Setting is to allow to configure collateral based on outlet type

settings.name: autosettle
settings.description: This setting is used to enable auto approval of loadin. The settlement happens automatically when the user submits the EOD (Supports autoeod as well). If both are not submitted, then settlement happens automatically at 23:59:59. Setting value 1 : To enable auto approval of loadin. (The loadin stock gets added to warehouse inventory). Setting value 0: To enable manual approval of loadin. (The loadin stock gets added to the warehouse inventory). Setting value 2: To enable auto approval of loadin. (The loadin stock gets added to next day loadout). )

settings.name: enablemsl
settings.description:
This setting controls the enablement of MSL. Value 0 represents MSL is disabled, 1 represents MSL is enabled & 2 represents, MSL is enabled and users must provide an MSL exception reason during order placement if an MSL SKU is not included (applicable only when exception categories are available). A constant called mslPropertyReasonLimit limits the number of reasons that can be captured. The default value is 20. If the number of MSL SKUs exceeds this limit, providing reasons is not mandatory. This limit cannot be configured from the UI. To change it, please contact the R&D team.
Note: Please do not enable this feature when RI Co-pilot functionality is enabled.

settings.name: cutoffeditorder
settings.description: Default value is 0, if the value is greater than 0 then it is the number of days a order can be edited. It is warehouse-wise setting, if the value is set on company level then it will impact for both primary and secondary orders.this setting is dependent on editorderpermission.

settings.name: editorderpermission
settings.description: This setting is used to enable and disable the edit order. Possible values are 0 and 1. Default value is 0. This is userwise setting. Note: Disable the setting editorder

settings.name: initialPasswordReset
settings.description: The user will be prompted to reset their password during their first login attempt if the value is set to 1.

settings.name: pregst
settings.description: This setting displays the option to select pregst in value or percentage in transaction screens. To disable it use 0. To enable it use 1 or 2. For default selection of value use 1 and for default selection of percentage use 2.

settings.name: enableppq
settings.description:
Set to 1 which enables the version 1 of PPQ which enables a button in the mobile app which shows the previous transactions made on the SKU wise.
Set to 2 which enables the version 2 of PPQ, which enables the options of ppq_modules values under reportmappings/add(or edit) page and user need to give widgetid values, the app will show the widget data accordingly. 
Set to 0 the setting to disable this feature.

settings.name: multiplebooking
settings.description: if multiplebooking enable then trainer available for that time slot.If he not have any approved task.

settings.name: sendkafkaevent
settings.description: This setting is used to send the event to kafka server when the outlet is added or updated.

settings.name: enablestockavailability
settings.description: This setting is used in APP only. The value are accepted is 0 or 1. "0" means disabled and 1 means enabled. This setting used to change the UI of stock at outlets screen. Setting is created for UBL. Default value is "0".

settings.name: showformpartialfillederror
settings.description: This setting is used to allow / disallow Call submit in the app if non-Compulsory form is partially filled (i.e., all mandatory fields are not filled and hence not submittable). If "showformpartialfillederror" == 1, error is shown and Call Submit is NOT allowed when form is partially filled (i.e., not submittable). If setting == 0, then Call Submit is allowed.

settings.name: outletapproval
settings.description:
If this setting is set to 1, outlets can be approved directly from the Bizom application. The default value is 0, which means the setting is disabled. This setting is supported only for the app.
Note: Please ensure that the autooutletapprove setting is disabled.

settings.name: loadinaudit
settings.description: This setting controls editing of Load-in quantities and related settlement sections. Setting 0 - Load-in quantity is non-editable. 1 - Load-in quantity is editable. 2 - Load-in quantity is non-editable. Three new sections are introduced as Settle,Add to Next Day,and Lost (Saleable) which can be editable. Load-in quantity is auto-populated in Settle (Van to Distributor Inventory) and Add to Next Day. Lost / Theft (Saleable) is auto-calculated using: Lost = Loadout - Sale + Sale Return - Settle Quantity. Entered values must match the Load-in quantity (validation applied). 3 - Same as Setting 2, an additional section Lost (Non-Saleable) is introduced (editable) but Lost / Theft (Saleable) quantity will be auto populated if there are mismatches which will be non-editable. No additional validation is applied to Lost / Theft (Non-Saleable) entries. 4 - Includes functionalities of Settings 2 and 3. Two additional sections: Loss and Extra for both Saleable and Non-Saleable in place of lost / theft saleable & non-saleable. The system allows capturing reasons for Loss and Extra (classified as Saleable or Non-Saleable), here reason configuration for extra & loss is mandatory. Note: 1 Enable guidedloadin setting to auto populate the quantities in loadin settlement screen in APP. 2. Loadin enablement in app & web to be configured using setting approveLoadoutLoadin.

settings.name: tourprogram
settings.description: This setting is used to enable / disable the Tour program functionality.

settings.name: auto_move_of_expire_batch_inventory
settings.description: Possible values 0 or 1. if this setting value is 1 then expire batch invetory will be  automatically moved to non-saleable inventory by event scheduler of stored procedure, default value is 0

settings.name: ignorepancheck
settings.description: If 0 then 2 lakhs transaction restriction will be done, if 1 then no restriction on any amount. Default is 0

settings.name: leavemanagement
settings.description:
1: Leaves will be credited using MDM and user will apply for the leave through app.
2: Advanced Leave Management - Advanced features like crediting leaves based on frequency ( Monthly / Quarterly / Half Yearly ) and carry forwarding the leaves ( frequency C/F, Yearly C/F and C/F on promotion ). Leaves can be configured for both role and designation.

settings.name: noDueCertificate
settings.description:
Setting that enables the functionality of No Due Certificate.
frequency is the time duration (eg: 2 weeks or 3 months etc) for which a distributor has to upload the NOC.
autoApprove decides if the uploaded NOC should be auto approved automatically or not.
blockPrimaryTransactions and blockSecondaryTransaction decides if primary and secondary transactions need to be blocked or not respectively. Set to 0 to unblock, set to 1 to block only primary/secondary order, set to 2 to block only primary/secondary sale, and set to 3 to block both sale and order for primary/secondary.
approvalRoleIDs is a comma separated value that decides users of which roles can approve/disapprove NOCs.
Enable submitClaims (1) to select the claims that are to be included along with the NOC, else disable (0) it to just upload the document. 
 nocmailtodistributor value 1 then this will work for new distributor claim and after noc submission successful then mail sent to distributor. 
 nocdefaultemail this will work with nocmailtodistributor =1 noc submit successful then mail sent to nocdefaultemail.

settings.name: verifyOutletPhone
settings.description: This Setting is used to enable/disable the outlet phone number validation via OTP on the app. Default value is 0 If value is 1, outlet phone number validation will be enabled but wont be mandatoryIf value is 2, outlet phone number validation will be enabled and will be mandatory

settings.name: bluetoothInvoiceTemplate
settings.description: This settings use for map the invoice for mobile app

settings.name: mapping_service_mode
settings.description: default value 0. if value is 0 then it will use old code of map related services, 1 means it will use new mapping services

settings.name: defaultleavedays
settings.description: Setting to Set the default leaves for user when leave management is being used, this is a company wise setting. for which override will not be considered. Setting values can be Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday

settings.name: requestotpforcollection
settings.description: This setting is used by bizom app for sending the otp while doing collection.

settings.name: outlet_skunits
settings.description: This setting is used by app only to enable outlet skunits form, when there is no work flow enabled for the user which enables skunits api.

settings.name: maxclaimdate
settings.description: maximum date of user can able to claim; Value between 1 - 31 for month

settings.name: secondary_max_digits
settings.description: This setting is used only for APP. The default value is 5. It is for restrict on units / cases length. This is used for secondary. For example user can enter for 5 digtis the value is 99999 of max.

settings.name: primary_max_digits
settings.description: This setting is used only for APP. The default value is 5. It is for restrict on units / cases length. This is used for primary. For example user can enter for 5 digtis the value is 99999 of max.

settings.name: minbudgetfortour
settings.description: default value is Zero. Tour budget can be specified based on the users. This value indicates what should be the minimum value for tourplan.

settings.name: isstocktransfertobranch
settings.description: A Company Level Setting used for stocktransfer to a branch which is processed without gst, scheme and discount with a static bill number. This is applicable for sale between warehouse / distributor of same state and gstinno only. The default value is 0, Set the value to 1 to enable the same. This is company specific setting built for Shell,please contact R&D before enabling this setting

settings.name: newtaskmodule
settings.description: this setting for enable new task module default value is 0 means it will be disable by default.

settings.name: budgetforclaim
settings.description: Default value 0 means disable the claim budget functionality. This settings is company wise . Claim budget can be specified based on the zones,subzones,warehouse to roles ,designations,users.This is specific to JyothylabDMS,please contact R&D before using this setting

settings.name: alwaysapplyvariablediscountskuwise
settings.description:
Setting to apply variable discount on sku's by default when applyvariablediscountskuwise setting is set to 1.
If set to 1, the variable discount sku wise percentage radio button will be checked and it's respective value will be populated.

settings.name: autotaskassignmentapproval
settings.description: The default value is 1 as it is working currently, if a task assignment has to be approved then change the value to 0.

settings.name: editTaskAssignment
settings.description: default value 0. To enable the editing of task assignment set the value as 1. This is used for app.

settings.name: tourProgramWithoutBudget
settings.description: default value 0. To enable the tour program without budget, set the value as 1 and tourprogram setting should be 1. This is used for app.

settings.name: cutoffordertime
settings.description: The default value is last second of the day. To use the feature set a time where after that the order cannot be placed. This is a warehouse-wise setting, set a value for a warehouse for which order will be placed. To mention the time provide 24 hour format in HH:mm:ss

settings.name: warehouseallowedlocvariance
settings.description: This setting (in metres) is used to allow transactions in warehouses whose location is within Circular area of the User location as Center. Default value is 0. In case of 0, this setting will be ignored. If value is > 0, then transactions(extended support for inventory audit) will not be allowed in warehouses if warehouse location is beyond the distance from the User location

settings.name: loyaltyPointsNew
settings.description: This setting is specific to retaler App.This is used to facilitate the revamped loyalty points setting

settings.name: show_grids
settings.description: This will be used by the Burbon app to check whether EagleEye is enabled for that company/user. Default value 0.

settings.name: ratepervalue
settings.description: This setting is used to display the rate per unit/case/unitcase when enterskuprice is set to 1. it is a comma separated setting whose accepted values are unit,case,unitcase,unitprice,caseprice,unitcaseprice. EX: to show unit and case, we need to configure as "unit,case"(without quotes). Default value is "".

settings.name: oneViewSalesmanDashboard
settings.description: Enable OneView Salesman Dashboard on Android App, Default 0 indicates that no analysis button will be shown on EOD page, Non-zero value indicates reportsmapping id.

settings.name: collectionmodes
settings.description: This setting is used to set the drop down values for collections. It is a comma separated value which will let us configure the modes of payments which are to be displayed. The default value is "cash,cheque,online"(without quotes). EX: if only cash and online is accepted, "cash,online"(without quotes) should be configured.

settings.name: salereturnselfapproval
settings.description: This setting is to enable auto approval of salereturn even when the setting "salesreturnsapproval value is 1", however the auto approved salereturn happens only when user id is mapped to warehouse / distributor and users respective role should be present in "salereturnapprovereject" setting. Accepted values are 0 and 1. When the setting is 1, the sales returns approval works are described above. Default value is 0.

settings.name: outletattendeeMandatoryfields
settings.description: This is used to mandate the fields among email and phoneno. Default value is 0 which indicates phoneno is mandatory and 1 for email.

settings.name: qrcodeinexistingasset
settings.description: Option 1(Default) - "1" means QR code enabled. Serial number will be disabled but visible. Option 2 -  "2" Serial number input is editable, QR code will be hidden. Option 3 - "3"  Both Serial number and QR code enabled. Once QR code is scanned, Serial no. will be disabled.

settings.name: nocsequence
settings.description: This settings value = 0 then system will auto generate noc sequence in noduecertificates else value = 1 then user will enter manual.

settings.name: showskunitaddinstock
settings.description:
When 1, the "+" sign will show in Stock, at Outlet, enabling to capture multiple mfg stocks.

When 0, the "+" sign will not show, so, only single mfg stocks can be captured.

settings.name: isEInvoiceEnabled
settings.description: Setting to enable the E-Invoicing/Fiscalisation module. Set the value to 0 to disable the module, 1 to enable the E-Invoicing module for India, 2 to enable the E-Invoicing module for SADAFCO, 3 to enable Fiscalisation for Zimbabwe for Sale and Sale Return transactions, and 4 to enable Fiscalisation for Malaysia for Sale, Sale Return, Credit Note and Debit Note transactions. For India, refer to the eInvoiceStartDate setting to configure the date from which the warehouse/distributor can start using the E-Invoicing module.

settings.name: isEInvoiceAutomated
settings.description: Setting to automate the process of submission of invoices to the GST portal. This will be dependant on the setting: isEInvoiceEnabled. 0 to disable and 1 to enable this feature.

settings.name: eod_map_screen
settings.description: This setting is used for enable or disable map on eod mail. By default value is 0. To enable set as 1. This is only for company level.

settings.name: formatamount
settings.description:
The default setting is 0, which applies to both the app and web.
        If the value is 0, there will be no formatting of the amount.
        If the value is 1, the amount will be formatted with lakhs and crores.
        If the value is 2, the amount will be formatted with millions and billions.

settings.name: replace_multiple_sku
settings.description: Setting to enable replacement of a Single Skunit to multiple skunit. Default value is 0, set to 1 to enable replacement of a Single Skunit to multiple skunit.This setting was built for B&L and GCPL.Please contact R&D before enabling this setting

settings.name: mandatestockfocussku
settings.description: This settings used in App if value is is 1 then either stock or order or sale for focus SKU must be taken, if the value is 2 then stock for focus SKU must be taken. Default value is 0.

settings.name: restrictaftercollectioninvoice
settings.description: This setting is used to restrict invoice edit,cancel or salereturn after collection. The values should be 1 for edit primary, 2 for cancel primary, 3 for sales return primary, 4 for edit secondary, 5 for cancel secondary and 6 for sales return secondary. Default value is 0. Values can be 1,2,3,4,5,6 or 1,2 or 1,3 or 2,3.

settings.name: assetapprovalfor
settings.description:
This setting enables a one-level approval process for assets in the app. The default value is 0.
To enable approvals, enter comma-separated values for:asset registration (assetregister), de-registration (assetderegister), asset orders (assetorder). Example: for enabling approval process for all actions assetorder,assetregister,assetderegister
Note:
1. Do not use single or double quotes.
2. Using any other values will disable this feature.
3. For multi-level approvals, use the multilevelassetapproval setting instead.

settings.name: auditmandatory
settings.description: If this is 1 then any asset audit mandatory, if 2 all asset audit should be mandatory. Only for APP.

settings.name: allowpartialreturn
settings.description: This setting allow the user to perform partial approval / partial reject during sale return approval. Set the value to 1 to enable the same, Default value 0.

settings.name: reportinghierarchyforattendance
settings.description: This setting is used to set the user hierarchy depth for attendance approval. Default Value is 0, This setting allows to fetch 1st level of reporting users when setting value set to 1.

settings.name: blockexcesscollectionamount
settings.description: If the setting value is "1" then it will not allow user to take collection more than invoice pending amount.Default value is "0".Note : This settings is handled only in backend.

settings.name: retailersku_columnidentifier
settings.description: This setting is used to identify the column based on which skus will be visible in the retailer app, The default value is 0.

settings.name: retailersku_columnpattern
settings.description: This setting is used to identify the column value pattern based on which skus will be visible in the retailer app, The default value is 0.

settings.name: autoapplycollectiondiscount
settings.description: This setting to enable or disable discount should apply automatical on basis of collection discount on aging basis.

settings.name: collectiondiscountaging
settings.description: This setting is used to  enabled or disabled discount and penality on aging basis.

settings.name: benefitBeforeGst
settings.description:
Setting to apply the discount and scheme benefits on the base price of the skunit(price without gst/vat), Default value is 0. Supported Values are 0,1,2
0: works on post tax amounts with scheme application on post tax values
1: works on post tax amounts with scheme application on pre tax amount
2: works on pre tax amounts with scheme application on pre tax amount
The setting works for amount based, quantity based and lpc schemes only.

settings.name: addUserForPayment
settings.description: This setting is supported in the web sale screen (/payments/sale) , fulfilment & payment edit screen. When enabled, a user filter will be visible on the sale UI, allowing selection of a user. The generated invoice will be tagged to the selected user. Supported Values are 0: Disabled & 1: Enabled (user filter visible)

settings.name: purchaseOrderWorkFlow
settings.description:
If the setting value is 1, the PO number while placing an order will be mandatory. If the setting value is 2, the PO number field will be visible but not mandatory. On value 3 , PO Number and Return Order number is visible and mandatory only when sku are present in cart for order/sale or return.For app, please enable PO number setting.
Note : Setting applicable only when is_mt_outlet = 1 is enabled for outlet.

settings.name: standardOutletWorkFlow
settings.description: Setting to enable standard outlet workflow, Default value is 0, When set to 1 we will check for standardoutlet value in outlets table.

settings.name: alloweditqty_skuform
settings.description: This is handled ONLY in App. Default value is zero. If the setting value = 1, Incase of custom SKU order form & custom SKU sale form, user will be asked to fill the form only once irrespective of the quantity.

settings.name: orderonphone
settings.description: After enabling this setting salesman can place Orders at his place (by phone call). no need to physically present at outlet. Supported values are as below</br>0 - Feature disabled.</br>1 - Feature enabled for only secondary (outlet) orders.</br>2 - Feature enabled for only primary (warehouse) orders.</br>3 - Feature enabled for both primary and secondary orders.</br>

settings.name: schemeApiPageSize
settings.description: This setting used in APP for get schemes API pagination on outlets wise,where number of outlets sent in request will be configured here. Default value is 100.

settings.name: show_open_outlets_data_from_eagle_eye
settings.description: Default value is 0, If value is 1 then some intelligence like highest selling vertical and outlet's presence on retailer app will be shown on Beatwise outlets screen in app(Landing page).

settings.name: onecustomformpersku
settings.description: when enabled one customform per sku will be created, 1 for both primary and secondary, 2 for primary, 3 for secondary

settings.name: whatsappTemplate
settings.description: This seting is used for send a message to outlet mobile number via WhatsApp messaging feature in Bizom app. Default value will be empty string(space). Below two links will be supported to handle frammed message for Distiman app link. 1. https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=mobisy.bizom.retailapp&hl=en_IN. 2. https://link.distiman.app/install/*** (link format). Any other frammed message can be set.

settings.name: complaintWorkFlow
settings.description: Setting to enable complaint workflow, where user can place a complaint in app and the same can be viewed and actions can be taken from the web portal and mobile app as well. Default value is 0, Set this value to 1 to enable complaint workflow.

settings.name: retailersms
settings.description: This setting is used to sending the sms to salesamn on placing order

settings.name: showoutletwisetasks
settings.description: Default value is 0, If this set to 1 shows the list of task assigned outlets in My Task tab. Prerequisite: Enable the user work flow 'tasks'

settings.name: sumTourChildBudgets
settings.description: If the value is set to zero, the sum of all child budgets should be equal to the parent budget. If the value is set to 1, the sum of child budgets can be less than the total parent budget.This setting used by anmolpragati,please contact R&D or company POC before enabling this setting

settings.name: autocreatingbeat
settings.description: IF this setting is enable then it will show a tab auto beat creation in pjps/pjpupdate url where beat will automatically created based on some parameter.This setting used by USFA,please contact R&D or company POC before enabling this setting

settings.name: schemereversal
settings.description: This setting is used to display and enable the scheme and discount reversal calculation during sale return. This is a company level setting, default value is 0, set it to 1 to enable the feature. (Note: For discount reversal feature, setting schemereversalwithoutinvoice also should be enabled along with this setting).

settings.name: groupreplacementapproval
settings.description: This setting is used to enable replacement of skunit in a group(for a specific transaction grouped by subbrands), default value is 0, to enable this set this to 1. will work only when enablesalereturnreplacement is set to 2.

settings.name: greenCallUrl
settings.description: This configuration provides the API URL to get Green call data for a given outlet. App displays the Green call data in the Order Summary screen. (Refer bug 55239).This was built for Jyothylabdms so please contact R&D before enabling this setting

settings.name: hideNonPresentAsset
settings.description: Setting to hide the non-present assets in the app. If the value is set to 1, it will not display the non present assets.

settings.name: isApprovalToShipping
settings.description: Setting to decide whether the stock transfer approval should be done by the billing-to warehouse or the shipping-to warehouse. If the value is set to 1, the approval will be made by the shipping-to warehouse, else will be made by the billing-to warehouse. Please contact R&D or account manager before enabling this setting

settings.name: inventoryAuditRestriction
settings.description: This setting is used to restrict inventory audit. In skuType support is "all/focus" only. Value support is "1wee/2week/3week/4week/5week/alldays".

settings.name: showPrimaryStock
settings.description: This setting is used only APP. To show the primary stock column in Inventory Audit screen. For enable set as 1. Default is "0".

settings.name: showOpeningAuditStock
settings.description: This setting is used only APP. To show the openint audit stock column in Inventory Audit screen. For enable set as 1. Default is "0".This setting was implemented for GCPL,please contact R&D before enabling this setting

settings.name: enablechatboardforsupport
settings.description: If this setting value is 1 means chatboard will display. default value is 0

settings.name: enableDesignType
settings.description: This Setting is used to enable company level Design type or Group Skunits. It should be company level only. This setting is implemented only for GCPL and Hersheys with limited support.

settings.name: showOnlyGroupedSku
settings.description: This setting is used to show the grouped skunits lit only grouped or mix or skunits only. Default value is 0 for mixed skunits, 1 for show only grouped skunit both for primary and secondary. In Orders page. This setting is implemented only for GCPL and Hersheys with limited support.If Setting Value set to 2 then for primary orders show only grouped skunit.If Setting Value set to 3 then for secondary orders show only grouped skunit.If Setting Value set to 5 then for primary orders show only normal skunit.If Setting Value set to 6 then for secondary orders show only normal skunit.

settings.name: minimumBillSequenceLength
settings.description: Setting to make the bill number to be of a specific minimum length excluding the prefix and suffix to the number. Default value is 0, which means the sequence will be unaltered. To make a bill number have a minimum of N characters, set the value to N.

settings.name: skuAttributePriority
settings.description: This setting to set the priority of skunits attributes or properties. Supported values are "1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8,9". 1 for Category, 2 for sub category, 3 for brand, 4 for sub brand, 5 for erpgroup, 6 for variant, 7 for packaging, 8 for size, 9 for subpacks. Value should be set as priority wise lik, If brand is high priority, then values are "3,4,1,2,6,7,5,8,9"

settings.name: considerComplaintForAudit
settings.description: This setting is used to determine if the complaint is to be considered as an asset during asset audit.

settings.name: enableOMS
settings.description: Setting to toggle the Lead/Opportunity Management System (LMS/OMS) in Bizom. To enable the feature, set the value to 1, else to 0 to disable.

settings.name: showskuform
settings.description: If set to 0, the skuform will be disabled. If set to 1, the skuform will be enabled for primary, secondary, and tertiary. If set to 2, the skuform will be enabled for primary only. If set to 3, the skuform will be enabled for secondary only. If set to 4, the skuform will be enabled for tertiary only. The default value is set as 1.

settings.name: resetPrice
settings.description: This setting determines if the latest SKU pricing needs to be considered when fulfilling an order directly. To enable this feature, set the value to 1 or 2. If the value is 1, the price will be reset automatically, and when the value is 2, the price will be reset based on the confirmation asked to the user if the price needs to be reset. This functionality will work only if the setting: enterskuprice is 0 for the user/company. Note: Please set this value to 1 to enable the functionalities in app such as "apply n times", "enableOnlineInvoiceAndSkuCappingCalculation" (ref: https://bugzilla.bizom.in/show_bug.cgi?id=67506#c19). This setting will not be supported in offline mode.

settings.name: claimInvoice
settings.description:
Setting that enables the functionality of Claim invoices.
frequency is the time duration (eg: 2 weeks or 3 months etc) for which a distributor has to upload the Claim Invoices.
autoApprove decides if the uploaded Claim Invoices should be auto approved automatically or not.
approvalRoleIDs is a comma separated value that decides users of which roles can approve/disapprove NOCs.
Enable submitClaims (1) to select the claims that are to be included along with the Claim invoices.

settings.name: claiminvoicesequence
settings.description: This settings value = 0 then system will auto generate Claim invoice sequence number. If value = 1 then user will enter manually.

settings.name: showBeatDistributors
settings.description: Setting to toggle the display the name of the distributor in the beat screen in the app. To enable this, set the value to 1 and to disable, set the value to 0.

settings.name: isAddLeadPermission
settings.description: Setting to toggle the permission for a user to add leads into the Lead/Opportunity Management System in Bizom. To enable, set the value to 1, else to 0 to disable.

settings.name: firstOrderDiscountPercent
settings.description: This setting is used in the retailer application. When an outlet places an order for the first time, this value of the discount will be applied on the bill amount. To enable, set a value between 0 and 100. To disable, set the value to 0.

settings.name: firstOrderDiscountCapping
settings.description: This setting is used in the retailer application. When an outlet places an order for the first time, this value of the discount capping will be applied on the bill amount when the setting: firstOrderDiscountPercent is enabled. To set a maximum discount limit, set the value to a non-zero positive integer. To disable maximum limit, set the value to 0.

settings.name: isskucustomized
settings.description: Setting to determine if Custom SKU Form needs to be displayed across the portal.

settings.name: syncFileThroughServices
settings.description: This setting is used to gradually migrate  syncing of files. Please enable/disable if resumable upload service is running.

settings.name: allowDiscardQPSScheme
settings.description: This setting is used to determine if the user will have access to manually close/end a currently running QPS for a particular outlet. To disable, set the value to 0. To enable for secondary transactions only, set the value to 1, to enable for primary tranactions only, set the value to 2, and for both primary and secondary, set the value to 3.This was built for GCPL,please contact R&D before enabling this setting

settings.name: autocashapprove
settings.description: if the value is 1, collection cash will automatically get approved

settings.name: enableSmartBasket
settings.description: Setting to enable the smart basket functionality

settings.name: salereturn_deduct_fromotherinventory
settings.description: Setting to deduct inventory based on the reason tag such as "nonsaleable","empty"

settings.name: schemediscountbufferdays
settings.description: Setting to provide the bufferdays for scheme and discount to apply for orders when they are fulfilled after the scheme/discount has been ended.

settings.name: enableTCS
settings.description:
This setting is enable to Apply TCS in company. Values can be supported is 
"0" For do not apply TCS.
"1" For apply TCS on current Year Sale amount of seller & buyer exceed to 50L(> 50L).
"2" For apply TCS on two condition Current year sale amount of seller & buyer exceed to 50L(>50L) and Only seller previous year sale amount exceed or equal to 10cr(>= 10cr).

settings.name: uniqueSkuCode
settings.description: A company level setting to define if the skunit code should be unique throughout the company. Which will stop user from adding duplicate skunit codes with different sku names. Default value is 0, which allows duplicate skunit codes with other skunit names, to make the skunit codes unique throughout the company please set the value to 1.

settings.name: show_outlet_wallet_share
settings.description: Possible values 0 or 1, IF 1 then this setting is used to show outlet's wallet share on outlet info screen in app. Default value is 0.

settings.name: restrictCollectionWithoutBill
settings.description: This setting will restrict users to add money without selecting invoice/bill on the collection screen. If enabled then users are not allowed to add money until not selecting at least single invoice.

settings.name: getmybeats
settings.description: Possible values 0 and 1 if value is 1 then logged in users beat will show otherwise it will show beat based on zone.

settings.name: customCalendar
settings.description: If any company wish to use custom calendar in oneview, this setting should be set to 1.If any company is using normal calendar, then this setting should be set to 0.By default, this setting should be set to 0.

settings.name: suggestedLoadout
settings.description: enabling this setting give suggested loadout quantity of SKU. Set the number of days for suggested loadout qty. 0 will be considered as setting disabled. (days should be between 30 to 90).This setting is used in App

settings.name: printCollectionInvoice
settings.description: This setting is used for printing collection invoices and sale return invoices separately in the mobile application. If the value is set to 1, then users can print only collection invoices separately. If the value is set to 2, users can print only sales return invoices separately. If the value is set to 3, users can print both collection invoices and sales return invoices separately(Note:Sale Return data will appear under Sale Invoices Tab. Displaying of data in Print will be as per Printer Configuration in the company)If the value is set to 0, user will get sale, sale return, and collection in a single invoice.

settings.name: permission_to_update_userworkflow
settings.description: This setting is userwise/rolewise so if this setting value is 1 means that user/role can update the userworkflow which reports to that user. NOTE** this setting should be enable role/userwise so don't enable companywise otherwise everyuser can enable the userworkflow.

settings.name: cashback
settings.description: This setting used retailer app - This is used for the new cashback functionality

settings.name: cashbackRedeemType
settings.description: This setting used retailer app - the redeem type can be (amount or percentage) this defines the type of cashback redemption

settings.name: maxcashbackValue
settings.description: This setting used retailer app - this is the max value per order

settings.name: cashbackValue
settings.description: This setting used retailer app - this is the value can be percentage or an amount will be checked based on type

settings.name: salereturnRetailer
settings.description: This setting is use to activate deactivate salerturn request feature from retailer app

settings.name: schemereversalforfreesku
settings.description: A company level setting, which is used to enable return of free skunits during scheme reversal. Please note all sale return placed will be considered as approved to calculate the correct value for returning free skunits. Prerequisite schemereversal should be enabled. To enable set the value to 1, Default value is 0.

settings.name: schemereversalwithoutinvoice
settings.description: A company level setting, which is used to enable the scheme and discount reversal calculation during sale return without invoice. To enable set the value to 1, Default value is 0. Prerequisite schemereversal should be enabled. Discount reversal feature is also enabled when this setting is enabled.

settings.name: isSaleReturnApprovalSequence
settings.description: This setting determines if the sale return approval sequence needs to be followed or not. To enable, set the value to 1. To disable, set the value to 0. This will work only if the manual approval process is enabled.

settings.name: cutoffeditinvoicemonthend
settings.description: Invoice cutoff days when editing invoice at the end of month or beginning of invoice's next month. Default value is 0 and possible values can be anything greater than 0. Here values are the number of days. If this setting is greater than 0, this cutoff is considered automatically while editing invoice at month end or beginning of next month.

settings.name: paymentmodes
settings.description: This setting is used to set the drop down values for all payment modes on sale / indirect order fulfilment. It is a comma separated value which will let us configure the modes of payments which are to be displayed. The default value is "credit,cash,cheque,online"(without quotes). EX: if only cash and online is accepted, "cash,online"(without quotes) should be configured.

settings.name: tourbudget_add
settings.description: This setting is used in APP for tourbudget for only two or three companies. To be deleted.

settings.name: tourbudget_edit
settings.description: This setting is used in APP for tourbudget for only two or three companies. To be deleted.

settings.name: pjp_plan
settings.description: This setting is used in APP for tourbudget for only two or three companies. To be deleted.

settings.name: pjp_approve
settings.description: This setting is used in APP for tourbudget for only two or three companies. To be deleted.

settings.name: beat_add
settings.description: This setting is used in APP for tourbudget for only two or three companies. To be deleted.

settings.name: beat_edit
settings.description: This setting is used in APP for tourbudget for only two or three companies. To be deleted.

settings.name: task_assign
settings.description: This setting is used in APP for tourbudget for only two or three companies. To be deleted.

settings.name: task_edit
settings.description: This setting is used in APP for tourbudget for only two or three companies. To be deleted.

settings.name: captureDummyAudit
settings.description: possibale values 0 or 1, If this setting value is 1 then it will capture the dummy aduit without sku id on that warehouse, this setting for app.

settings.name: customizescheme
settings.description: A Company Level setting which enables the customization of the scheme, If the setting is enabled (value = 1), then the user will be allowed to change the applicable schemes and the applicable times. This is supported in App and Web(In Web this feature is supported for multischemeenable only). Default value is 0.

settings.name: blockTransactionAfterEOD
settings.description: Enabling this setting will not allow transaction after EOD

settings.name: availablequantitydisplay
settings.description: This setting is used to display the available inventory of the mapped warehouse/distributor ONLY in the order screen of the Bizom App. Along with this setting, 'stock at warehouse' MUST be enabled.Setting Value 0 -> Display availability inventory in primary and secondary order screens. Value 1 -> Display available inventory only in primary order screen. Value 2 -> Display available inventory only in secondary order screen. 3 -> Don't show in primary and secondary order screen both. Note: To ensure the above settings work, either 'stockatwarehouse' or 'captureclosingstock' must be enabled.

settings.name: eInvoiceStartDate
settings.description: This setting decides the date (DD-MM-YYYY) from which the warehouse which has the setting: isEInvoiceEnabled to be able to generate and cancel IRNs via GSP.

settings.name: multipleoutletsforarea
settings.description:
For value 1 --> One outlet mapped to multiple distributor/warehouse. 
                     For value 2 --> One outlet can be mapped to multiple areas under same distributor/warehouse, but at a time all selected areas must belongs to same distributor/warehouse, areas from multiple distributor/warehouse can not be selected 
                     For value 3 --> One outlet can be mapped to any area under any distributor/warehouse, no restriction at all on area selection

settings.name: addDistributor
settings.description:
This setting is used only in APP. Accepted values are 0,1,2.
If 1 --> Add Distributor option will show in beat and stock at warehouse screens
If 2 --> Add distributor only in stock at warehouse screen. This setting is used to provide the access for user to create the distributor, where this setting support cannot be provided in Web as ACL is in place. Default value is "0"

settings.name: generateewaybilljson
settings.description: Used to provide eway bill json support in payments page. Values are 0 or 1. By default it is set to 0. 1 will provide a button in payments UI for generating the eway in JSON format which can be used to submit in the Eway Bill Govt. Portal.

settings.name: creditnotetransactionunique
settings.description: This setting will to use for company level where the salesreturn approval basis it will create new credit note. If disable will work as old. By default it disable(0).

settings.name: autowarehouseapprove
settings.description: This settings is used to auto approval of distributors. By default value is 1. If 0 manually the Distributor has to be approved from warehouses unapproved screen.

settings.name: enterSKUMargin
settings.description: Setting to enable user to enter the SKU margin. enterSKUMargin will have higher priority than enterskuprice.

settings.name: adddistributorwithvilllage
settings.description: Add distributor with villages as area

settings.name: schemeDiscountOnInvoiceDate
settings.description: A Company Level setting which applies the scheme / discount on the actual schemediscount date when invoices are edited. The default value is 0, set this value to 1 to apply scheme / discount of the actual schemediscount date.

settings.name: sendmailaftercollection
settings.description: This setting is used to send mail after collection from APP. By default is 1 enabled, disabled set 0.

settings.name: etisalat
settings.description: Accepted values are 0 or 1.New sms vendor for UAE

settings.name: damageClaimAudit
settings.description: This setting determines if the Damage claim audit functionality is enabled / disabled for the user.This is GCPL specific so please contact R&D before enabling this setting

settings.name: approveLoadoutLoadin
settings.description:
If the value is set to 0, then the loadout & loadin tabs are disabled in app only.
If the value is set to 1, then the loadout & loadin tabs are enabled in both app and web.
If the value is set to 2, then the loadout & loadin tabs are disabled in both app and web.
The default value is 0.

settings.name: stockatwarehouse
settings.description: This setting is used to enable the Stock at Warehouse workflow for users. The default value is 0, set this value to 1 to enable Stock at Warehouse workflow for users.

settings.name: captureclosingstock
settings.description: This setting is used to enable the Capture closing Stock workflow for users. The default value is 0, set this value to 1 to enable Capture closing Stock workflow for users. Value 2 is for offline Warehouse Stock edit functionality in app.

settings.name: cutoffeditordermonthend
settings.description: Order cutoff days when editing order at the end of month or beginning of order's next month. Default value is 0 and possible values can be anything greater than 0. Here values are the number of days. If this setting is greater than 0, this cutoff is considered automatically while editing order at month end or beginning of next month.

settings.name: expiredBatchDays
settings.description: This setting allows displaying the expired batch SKU while auditing the inventory. The value represents the number of days for which an expired batch date range can be fetched in one request. The default value is 0 and the max value is 90. In the case of a value greater than the max value(90), the batches will be displayed which got expired in 90 days from the start date.

settings.name: requiredPasswordLoginMinutes
settings.description: This setting is used in APP only. Default value is 0. For values can be set as minutes basis if company wants to required password every 1 hours then set as 60.

settings.name: showgstoptionincreditnote
settings.description:
If this setting is set to "0", then GST option will not be shown while creating Credit Note.
If this setting is set to "1", then GST selection option will be shown to the User in the UI.

settings.name: contactsupportRetailerapp
settings.description: Default value is empty.If value is empty all the support contact details will be shown. If add values that contact will not be shown.Values supported DISTRIBUTOR,SALESMAN,COMPANY,PJP_USER to be added comma separated.

settings.name: editviewaccesswarehousesandoutlets
settings.description: Setting allows user to edit/view warehouses/outlets based on depomappings or hierarchy based. Default value is 0 works as before, 1 will be depomappings, 2 will reportin to hierarchy and depomappings, 3 is a combination of both

settings.name: warehouseapprover
settings.description: Assign rolewise who can approve unapproved Warehouses

settings.name: gstregex
settings.description: Used to store regex for GST field validation.

settings.name: editDistributor
settings.description: This setting is used only in APP. Accepted values are 0 or 1. If 1 -> editDistributor functionality will be enabled and if 0 -> editDistributor will not enabled

settings.name: verifyWarehousePhone
settings.description: This Setting is used to enable/disable the warehouse outlet phone number validation via OTP on the app. Default value is 0. If value is 1, warehouse outlet phone number validation will be enabled and will not be mandatory. If value is 2, warehouse outlet phone number validation will be enabled and it will be mandatory.

settings.name: enableStorageService
settings.description: This settings help to use resumable upload in Bizom App.

settings.name: shwoInventoryByDesignType
settings.description: This is a warehouse-wise setting and defines the mode in which design type SKU is being operated. If the value is 0 means default mode, value 1 means manual mode, and value 2 means automatic mode. In auto or manual mode pricing of one of the mapped child SKU will be shown against parent SKU. In default mode pricing of only parent SKU will be shown. This setting is implemented only for GCPL with limited support.

settings.name: DIYinvoice
settings.description: To enable custom invoice generation from user

settings.name: newmenudesign
settings.description: This setting supports ONLY at company level. If the setting value is 1, then it will show new menu design. If 0, it will show old menu design

settings.name: isSelectVehicleInLoadouts
settings.description: Setting to decide if the vehicle has to be selected in case of a loadout. The default value is 0, where the user will not be prompted to select the vehicle. If the value is set to 1, the user will need to select the mapped vehicle. If the value is set to 2, the user will only be allowed to select vehicles based on validation on the total weight of the SKUs.

settings.name: showBeatInTourProgram
settings.description: Setting to decide if the beat selection should be available in the Tour Program module. Set the value to 1 to enable this feature, or 0 to disable.

settings.name: showEditedMTPForApprovalInApp
settings.description: Setting to decide if only the edited MTP requests needs to be displayed in the plan approval screen in the app. To enable this in app, set the value to 1. To disable this in app, set the value to 0.

settings.name: disableReporteeInTourTask
settings.description: Setting to decide if the user selection should be available in the Tour Program module for tour types with filters enabled. Set the value to 1 to enable this feature, or 0 to disable.

settings.name: cutoffrejectorder
settings.description: Order cannot be rejected after cutoff days

settings.name: minmaxdiscount
settings.description: This setting is used to configure the discount with Min and Max.  Where this will help with the setting "applyvariablediscountskuwise" where user can edit and give the discount what he can give according to rang basis. Default value is disabled(0). Enable set to 1.

settings.name: merchandising
settings.description: Below are the supported KPIS, please use them comma separated (Case sensitive)based on the requirement DIST,FACING,PROMO,PRICE,PLANO,merchandising,AUTO,VISIT,ASSET

settings.name: sortBillnoforLactalis
settings.description: This setting sepcific for Lactalis to update bill number based on the user.

settings.name: qpsschemeenrolment
settings.description: A Company setting which enables enrolment of qps type schemes, this helps the user to get information of the slab, the outlet has been enrolled. Default value is 0, to enable the same set this to 1.

settings.name: qpsSchemeRedeemDays
settings.description: A Company setting which allows you to redeem the qps scheme benefits manually, once the manual redemption qps schemes is ended, The benefit of the same can be redeemed within n days as per the configuration defined, The default value is 10, which allows to redeem the qps for 10 days after it's end date.

settings.name: reduceSchemeFromQpsQuantity
settings.description: A Company setting which allows you to reduce the qps qualifiable quantity / amount for which qps schemes are already applied, any skunit cannot get dual benefits, they will get only one qps benefit. the default value is 0, to enable this set the value to 1.This was built for GCPL,before enabling for other companies please cotact R&D

settings.name: showUserInTourProgram
settings.description: This setting will show reportingto user in tourbudget creation. Default value is 1

settings.name: otpMessage
settings.value: _code_ is your Bizom outlet verification code.
settings.description: The template used here should be DLT compliant and DLT registered. "_code_" will be replaced by the actual value of otp. So, make sure that the otp message template you insert here contains "_code_" keyword. For example, if you want the message to be "124565 is your otp"; then you should insert "_code_ is your otp." Here is the list of already approved DLT compliant templates : 1. _code_ is your Bizom outlet verification code. 2. _code_ is your Bizom outlet verification code. Please share it with _company_ person only.

settings.name: unmappedInvoice
settings.description: This setting is used for web to enable unmapped invoice visibility through a unmapped invoice button in payments index screen. Accepted values are userids which are of admin role and the values can be passed as comma separated.

settings.name: validateClaimLimit
settings.description: Setting to either allow or block claim requests based on the claim limit configurations at individual and/or grouped claim types. To disable the validation, set the value to 0. To block the transaction if the limit has exceeded, set the value to 1. To allow the transaction even if the limit has exceeded and the user to be prompted with a warning, set the value to 2.

settings.name: enableSkuvisibility
settings.description:
Default value is zero. 
0 - The module is disabled
1 - The support is available in Bizom web and retailer APP
2 - The support is available in Bizom Web, Bizom APP and Retailer APP.

settings.name: Send_formattachments_in_eodmail
settings.description: This must be set to 1 to send generic form data uploaded attachments in mail

settings.name: outletcallscolors
settings.description: This setting is only used in the app. This setting supports comma-separated color code value... Currently supporting for productive and non - productive color for last and current month in outlet list screen.

settings.name: segmentationModule
settings.description: Setting to enable/disable the Segmentation module in Bizom. To enable this feature, set the value to 1. To disable this feature, set the value to 0. Note: This is developed for GCPL, please reach to R&D team before configuration.

settings.name: isEditSegmentAccess
settings.description: Setting to decide if a user has access to make changes in the segment for any entity. Note: This is developed for GCPL, please reach to R&D team before configuration.

settings.name: approvalSegmentedEntities
settings.description: Setting that decides which entities (users, beats, outlets) needs approval process. By default, none of the entities are set for approval. If there are multiple entities required, provide the entities comma separated. Note: This is developed for GCPL, please reach to R&D team before configuration.

settings.name: enableTDS
settings.description: This is a company-level setting to enable TDS support. When set to 1, the TDS checkbox will appear on the add and edit screens for warehouses and outlets. If enabled at the buyer level, the suggested TDS amount will be displayed and can be modified.

settings.name: bulkfulfillmentmethode
settings.description: This setting is supported at company level. Default value is set as 0. If set 1 then it will support the Fair Share Method(FSM) in bulkfulfillment. For GCPL bug id: 52811.

settings.name: saledatafetchdays
settings.description: This setting is company level support. In this we pass the days to feth the total sales for outlet wise for priority or sort in bulk fulfillment.

settings.name: enable_whats_new
settings.description: This setting is to enable whats new feature, set to 1 to show new features or new about bizom.

settings.name: msltargeton
settings.description: This setting will work on company level. Default value is 0 it will work as msl wise trarget and If set 1 then it will work on msl entity level target basis.

settings.name: isEwayBillEnabled
settings.description: Setting for setup e-waybill system for GST filings. 0 to disable, 1 to enable the feature for sales, 2 to enable for sale returns and 3 to enable for damage claims. To enable for multiple modules comma seperated values can be used(ex: 1,3 for sales and damage claims).

settings.name: showtotallinetotalmargin

settings.description:
This setting is GCPL SPECIFIC. It MUST NOT be used for other companies.
Setting that enables the functionality of Merge Orders. The functionality merges the multiple orders of any Outlet for the given day into a single Outlet order.
This functionality just copies the multiple orders AS IT IS into a single order for that outlet. Recalculation of Scheme / discount / price does not happen. Final merged order user id will be saved from the first order id.
mergeOrderBUIds can hold the list of Business unit Ids. If empty, then it will consider orders of all the users. If not empty, then it will consider orders taken by users of the configured business unit ids. Valid values can be empty, (e.g., []) or list of Business unit Ids. (e.g., ["1", "2"]). Default value: [].
finalOrderBUId holds business unit id of the user to be saved in the final merged order user field. This is relevant if mergeOrderBUIds is not empty. Default value: "".

settings.name: skuappfilter
settings.description:
This setting supports four values: 0, 1, 2, and 3.
Default: 0
Value 0: Displays only the basic filters on the app (Default, Alphabetical, etc).
Value 1: Displays all filters on the app, including Brands, Sub-Brands, Categories, Sub-Categories, Variants, and Sizes.
Value 2: Displays only the Brand, Sub-Brand, and Variant filters. Shows Focus SKU as a radio button on the order/sales screen. This configuration is applicable only for the Bourbon app (custom-built for GCPL Indo).
Value 3: Introduces a new dropdown called SKU Type along with filters. The SKU Type dropdown includes All SKUs, Focus SKU, and MSL, while the filters section includes Categories and Sub-Categories. This configuration is only applicable to Bizom Next.
Note: To configure the filters and SKU type dropdown use the new setting BizomNextSKUAppFilter. This setting will only be applicable to Bizom Next and will overwrite the setting skuappfilter.

settings.name: addFrequencyOutlet
settings.description: This setting is used to enable add outlet in beat based on frequency and start date. This is a custom functionality built for ShellVN. Where outlet position in the beat depends on frequency, start date, and user. To enable this feature, you have to set all three values mentioned in the setting. For example, if you want to enable this feature from the date 2023-01-01 and the frequency of the user working days is 28, then you have to set the value like this: {"enable":1,"startDate":"2023-01-01","frequency":"28","approveBeatandOutletTogether":"1,2","addConfigPermission":"1,2"}. If you want that when the admin and zone manager approve the new outlet, the outlet's beat also has to be approved, then in the setting key (approveBeatandOutletTogether), you can define the comma-separated role IDs as mentioned in the example. The "addConfigPermission" key can be used to set role IDs that are to be shown in the settings/addConfig page. Input will be comma-separated role IDs. The "superUserApproval" key can be used to allow all users with role ID 1 (Super User) to approve or reject beat approval changes for all users, irrespective of the reporting hierarchy, on the screen: beatdetails/approveBeatChanges. Default value will be 0 and to enable set superUserApproval key to 1.  Additionally,The "weekend" key can be used to to display all days of week (along with Suday), on the screen: beatdetails/approveBeatChanges and if the "weekend" is set to 0 only the Sunday details will be excluded. Default value will be 0 and to enable set "weekend" key to 1.

settings.name: display_feedback
settings.description: This setting is used to display the bizom feedback form. Default value will be 0

settings.name: redeplyoment
settings.description: This setting controls the redeployment process. The default value is 0, and the supported values are 1, 2, and 3.Value = 1:Redeployment requests can only be initiated by the Sales Manager role. Distributor Salesmen are responsible for raising registration and deregistration requests for asset serial numbers. Redeployment is allowed only after 90 days from the assetâ€™s registration date. This is a custom development for Hersheyâ€™s, so please consult the product team before setting this value to 1.Value = 2:The user associated to the outlet can raise a redeplyment request irrespective of role/designation. Once a redeployment request is approved, the asset will be automatically deregistered from the current outlet and registered at the new outlet selected while raising the redeployment request. The usual approval process for registration and deregistration will be skipped.Value = 3:After raising a redeployment request, the user associated with the outlet must manually deregister the asset from the current outlet and register it at the new outlet.Note: The Redeployment Days setting is applicable only for values 2 and 3. For value 1, the redeployment period is fixed at 90 days by default.

settings.name: enableBlockInventory
settings.description: This setting is used for when multiple orders or bulk fulfillments are received simultaneously, this setting locks the required inventory for the first request received, ensuring it gets priority. Subsequent requests can only use the remaining available inventory after the lock. This prevents overselling and ensures a first-come, first-served allocation of stock across both individual orders and bulk fulfillments.

settings.name: mappingForEntity

The format of the value should be in JSON format, like: { "Outlet": "1", "Area": "1", "Distributor": "1", "PrimaryInvoiceCount": "1", "SecondaryOrdersCount": "1", "ActiveOutletsCount": "1" } The default value will be: { "Outlet": "0", "Area": "0", "Distributor": "0", "PrimaryInvoiceCount": "0", "SecondaryOrdersCount": "0", "ActiveOutletsCount": "0" } This setting is used in: - Web - APIs - MDM

settings.name: beatJumpRules
settings.description:
This setting is used to enable the beat jump restrictions as below.
{"BeatjumpRestriction":"0","NumberOfDays":"","BlockedTransactions":"call, copyTransaction, collections, saleReturnWithInvoice, phoneInOrder, tertiarySale"}

Where,
BeatjumpRestriction values can be 0,1,2,3,4,5.
0 -> Beat jump rules will be disabled. User can do beat jump (old flow).
1 -> beat_id will be restricted for the first call beat_id and he cannot switch to another PJP.
2 -> approval flow for the beat jump, User can do beat jump only after approval of beat jump by the direct reporting manager.
3 -> beat jump allowed for specific +/- N days and N days should pick from NumberOfDays key value of this setting.
4 -> Once the user visits all the outlets in a beat, then only the user will be able to choose any other beat in the assigned PJP. The user may or may not complete any chosen beat(s) here by visiting the outlets. In general, the beat jump would be allowed only when all the outlets in the assigned beat for the day are visited.
5 -> beat jump will be completely restricted. user should do transaction only in assigned beat.
6 -> Beat jump approval as per ../approvalConfigurations (Module-Name BeatJump):
Approval is finalized as soon as any one of the configured approvers takes action (approve or reject), without following any sequence.
The approver must be in the user's reporting hierarchy, and the setting 'userreportingtoforhiararchy' must be enabled (set to 1).

6 -> Beat jump approval as per ../approvalConfigurations (Module-Name BeatJumpÂ):
   Allows multiple approvers but no sequential flow: the request is finalized as soon as any one approver approves or rejects.

NumberOfDays -> Set this value only when BeatjumpRestriction value is 3. Input will be comma separated days. User can do beat jump only for +/- provided day's beats. For ex: when value is 3,4 then user can do beat jump for previous 3 day's and next 4 day's beats

BlockedTransactions -> Values will be comma separated transactions which are need to be blocked for restricted beats among all the conditions. Transactions can be call, copyTransaction, collections, saleReturnWithInvoice, phoneInOrder, tertiarySale. By default all transactions will be blocked.

Note: Approval flow will work only in online and rest are work both in online and offline.

If value is greater than 0:
- Trainer can start training only if they are within the configured radius from the outlet location.
