settings.name: validateGSTIN
settings.description:
This JSON setting enables GSTIN validation and auto-fill for outlets, distributors, and warehouses.
Separate enable keys are provided for outlet and warehouse. Set enable = 1 to activate the feature.
When enabled, a GSTIN validation popup is displayed on add/edit screens if the GSTIN is not validated. GST details such as Trade Name, Effective Date of Registration, GSTIN/UNI Status, PAN, etc., are fetched from the GST portal and auto-filled as non-editable by default.
To make fields editable after fetching data from the gst portal make key values as one in the json. For example I want only name to be editable
To allow editing of specific fields after auto-fill, set the corresponding is*Editable key to 1 in the JSON configuration (e.g., isNameEditable = 1 to make only the Name field editable).
Below is the json format

{
"enable": 1, Note: this will be enabled only for app
"outlet": {
"enable": 1, Note: this will be enabled only for web
"isNameEditable": 0,
"isTradeNameEditable": 0,
"isLegalNameEditable": 0,
"isPanEditable": 0,
"isUNIStatusEditable": 0,
"isEffectiveDateOfRegistrationEditable": 0,
"isTaxPayerEditable": 0,
"isGstAddressEditable": 0
},
"warehouse": {
"enable": 1, Note: this will be enabled only for web
"isNameEditable": 0,
"isTradeNameEditable": 0,
"isLegalNameEditable": 0,

"isUNIStatusEditable": 0,

}
}

settings.name: removeFromBeatOnOutletTransfer
settings.description: Default value is 0, if value is 1 then any area removed or changed from outlet mapping then active outlets beats will be inactive

settings.name: BeatVisibleForNumberOfWeeks
settings.description: This settings defines the number of weeks PJP will be visible in the app. For example, if you set the value to 5, the PJP will be visible from 5 weeks before the current day to 5 weeks after the current day.Same applies if the value is updated as 0 or less.

settings.name: disableCancelAEditActionForDeliveredONotDelivered
settings.description: this setting will be used to disable the cancel and edit operation on sale with delivered or Not delivered status. Values 1:to enable the setting ,0: to disable the setting.Default 0

settings.name: merchandising_timeout_interval
settings.description: This setting is used to set a timeout for merchandising detection results. An error message will be shown if the system fails to get a response within the specified time. NOTE: The value should be in seconds and multiples of 15 seconds.

settings.name: merchandising_session_images_count
settings.description: This setting is used to control the number of images a user can upload per session in smart merchandising.

settings.name: showSkucode
settings.description: If value is set to 1, then show SKU code along with the name in all the SKU screens. Default value is 0. Used in Bizom App only

settings.name: orderTypeClassification
settings.description: Controls Special/Normal classification for secondary Orders and Sales. 0 (Default): No classification applied. No change in system behavior. 1: Special/Normal classification enabled for both Orders and Sales. 2: Special/Normal classification enabled for Orders only. Sales classification disabled. 3: Special/Normal classification enabled for Sales only. Orders classification disabled. For Special Orders: only discounts applicable. For Normal Orders: scheme and variable discounts apply. Partial fulfillment not allowed for Special Orders.

settings.name: disableOrderEdit
settings.description: If the setting is at 1, users will not be able to edit special orders. This rule is based on the users orderTypeClassification, set to 1. Default value is 0

settings.name: paymentservicevendor
settings.description: This setting used to call bizompayment service to process payment after invoice generation. Vendor Value should be , separated EX : KREDMINT,NEARPAY

settings.name: otpMessageForTwoFactorAuth
tourBeatWithOutlet
settings.description: When the setting value is 0, the user can add a beat to the tour program without adding an outlet. When the setting value is 1, an outlet is necessary to add a beat to the tour program

settings.name: enableDesignTypeInventoryAudit
settings.description: Default value is 0, if value is 0 then Skunit filter dropdown will display inventory audit page, user can select all,skunit or group option. if value is 1 then only grouped(Parent) skus will display. if value is 2 then only child skus are display. if value is 3 then both parent and child skus will display with summation

settings.name: RestrictDuplicateOutletErpid
settings.description: When this setting is set to 1, the system will verify that the entered outlet ERP ID is unique and not a duplicate. If the setting is set to 0, the system will skip this verification and allow duplicate ERP IDs

settings.name: disableOutletAreaTransferInPjpUserArea
settings.description: this setting will be used to restrict transfer of outlet to another area if the outlet is mapped in active users current or future date pjp. Values 1:to enable the setting ,0: to disable the setting.Default 0

settings.name: singleCategoryPrimaryOrder
settings.description: If enabled, this setting ensures that primary order selection for a single category remains consistent across all screens.Default value: 0 (disabled).To enable: set the value to 1. Additional Behavior: If the retailer_exclusive_outlettype setting contains outlet type IDs, and singleCategoryPrimaryOrder is set to 1: Primary Orders: SKU category-wise order restriction will apply to all distributors. Secondary Orders: SKU category-wise order restriction will apply only to the outlet types specified in retailer_exclusive_outlettype. Note : This will not have any impact on order fulfilment / sale flow. Both will work as it is.

settings.name: OutletBeatRestrictionByUserBuMapping
settings.description:
This setting restricts the beat assignment of an outlet based on the user's business unit mapping. If a beat is already assigned to one user's PJP and contains the same outlet that is being mapped to another beat in another user's PJP, the following conditions must be met before adding.
1.If both users have the same designations and the same business units, the outlet cannot be added.
2.If both users have the same designations but different business units, the outlet will be added.
3.If both users have different designations but the same business units, the outlet cannot be added.
4.If both users have different designations and different business units, the outlet will be added.
Note: For using this setting In company One beat should map to only one user. If one beat is mapto muliple user this feature will not work preperly and you might face some inconistancey in
data

settings.name: draftDataCount
settings.description: This company-level configuration determines the number of outlet drafts allowed. By default, the setting is 0, meaning multiple drafts are disabled and all the flow as existing. Setting it to 1 enables the feature. When draftcount is more than zero we will pick the last start time. All saved drafts for the day will be cleared only after the user marks the End of Day (EOD) or if the auto EOD mark feature is enabled. If EOD is not enabled, drafts will be wiped out at 12 A.M.

settings.name: enforceCallSubmission
settings.description: allow setting value 0,1 and for enable 1 disable 0. If this setting is enabled, the user will be forced to submit the draft call. The user will not be able to start a new call until the current call is submitted.

settings.name: enforceFirstCall
settings.description: allow setting value 0,1 and for enable 1 disable 0. If this setting is enabled, the user will be redirected to the start call screen directly without showing the first transaction confirmation popup and will not be allowed to go back , Transaction submission is mandatory.

settings.name: noOfPastDaysAllowedForLeave
settings.description: This is a company level setting.This setting will store  count of days. Based on this count, a user can apply leave requests for past working days. By default it 5 is store which means user can apply leave for past 5 working days

settings.name: isHalfDayLeaveSupported
settings.description: This is a company level setting.When value is set to 1 this setting is enabled and user can apply leave request for half day.

settings.name: priorityBasedApprovalConfiguration
settings.description: This setting controls the priority order for the approval configurations within the company, with a default value of 0 (no specific priority) and an enabled value of 1 (specific priority order applied). When set to 1, the approval process will follow a sequence prioritizing users first, then designations, and finally roles.

settings.name: allowZeroPriceSkuOrderEdit
settings.description: if this setting is 1 then we will allow edit the qty for skus with price 0 in "orders/editfromindex/" page. it will only work when editing the order in web. Values 1- enable ,0- disable. Default Value-0

settings.name: orderTimeConstraint
settings.description: This setting is used to allow orders within a specified time period. Provide the time in 24-hour format (HH:mm:ss). The status field has four possible values: 0 to disable the setting, 1 for primary orders, 2 for secondary orders, and 3 for both primary and secondary orders. By default, the status is set to 0. This configuration ensures orders are placed within the defined timeframe for different order types.

settings.name: enableEod
settings.description: This setting controls whether the EOD (End of Day) button is visible in the hamburger menu of the app. By default, this setting is enabled (value 1), allowing all users to access the EOD button.</br>Supported values are:</br>0: Hides the EOD button.</br>1: Displays the EOD button.

settings.name: VehicleWeightMinMaxRange
settings.description: This is used to set Minimum percentage and Maximum percentage vehicle capacity (weight) required for each order placement. The values should be comma separated for Minimum and Maximum. Eg 1: 90,92 means minimum is 90 and maximum is 92 and it depends only the setting value enableVehicleVolumeValidation should be 2 or 3. It is use for only primary order.

settings.name: placeorderfordistributorvariablediscount
settings.description: A setting that enables users to apply variable discounts during placeorderfordistributor. This functionality requires the applyvariablediscountskuwise setting to be enabled for proper operation. Default Value is 0, Supported values are  0 - User cannot edit the discount, 1 - The user can edit the discounts during the placeorderfordistributor process.

settings.name: visperaAutoClosable
settings.description: This is a custom company specific setting. 0 means user will not remain on blue shark app after pressing back button. and 1 means user will remain on blue shark app after pressing back button.

settings.name: showSystemDataForClaimTypes
settings.description: The value will contain a list of claim type IDs, separated by commas. For these specified claim type IDs,  calculate and display the corresponding distance traveled and worked hours on the claim add and approval screens. The distance and worked hours will be computed based on attendance and endofday data for the specified date.

settings.name: moveMappingsOnHqTransfer
settings.description:
This settings is allow to move user mapping of module on the headquarter transfer. allow value 0 and 1 for the respective modules
PJP:Default value is 1. When the setting value is set to 1 then allow to swap of replace the user pjp on headquarter transfer.
Target:Default value is 1. When the setting value is set to 1 then allow to swap of replace the user target on headquarter transfer.
Role:Default value is 1. When the setting value is set to 1 then allow to swap of replace the user role mapping on headquarter transfer.
ActivityFormMapping:Default value is 0. When the setting value is set to 1 then allow to swap of replace the user activityform mapping on headquarter transfer.
GenericFormMapping:Default value is 0. When the setting value is set to 1 then allow to swap of replace the user genericform mapping on headquarter transfer.
Reporting:Default value is 0. When the setting value is set to 1 then allow to swap of replace the user reportingto on headquarter transfer.
Businessunit:Default value is 0. When the setting value is set to 1 then allow to swap of replace the user businessunit mapping on headquarter transfer.
Workflow:Default value is 0. When the setting value is set to 1 then allow to swap of replace the user workflow mapping on headquarter transfer if setting apptabwithworkflow is enabled then workflow for user level will swap or replace.

settings.name: enable_ship_to_primary_orders
settings.description: This company-level configuration to enable distributor to create ship to primary order. in which we will allow distributors with shipToOrder flag true. will be able to create primary order where ship to will be outlet and bill to will be distribitor. Values 0. Disable 1. Enable . Default: 0, Note:- this is implemented for only for JKC customer.

settings.name: showOpeningAuditStockWithCurrentDate
settings.description: This setting is used only when the setting showOpeningAuditStock is enabled. This setting is used to show the latest audited inventory( Audit dates considered till the today ) in the audit stock column in Inventory Audit screen of APP. To enable set as 1. Default is 0.This setting was implemented for GCPL,please contact R&D before enabling this setting

settings.name: damageClaimProcess
settings.description: This setting is used to manage dump inventory in damage claims. When set to 1, the warehouse/distributor can place a damage claim. If set to 2, they can accept a damage claim. If set to 3, they can both place and accept damage claims. Inventory will only be deducted if the warehouse/distributor places a damage claim with the setting at 1 or place and accepts a damage claim with the setting at 3.

settings.name: enableSingleDeviceValidationForUser
settings.description:
This setting is used in the app to restrict users from logging in on multiple devices. It supports two values: 0 or 1. When set to 1, the user will be allowed to log in on only one device. The device information is captured during the first login, and subsequent logins will be permitted only from that specific device.

Note 1: iOS Login: Reinstalling the app on iOS may block login due to device ID restrictions. To resolve this: a. Go to the web User View/Edit screen b. Remove the existing IMEI/Device ID c. Attempt login again from the iOS device

Note 2: Offline Data Sync: Syncing offline data from an old device will be restricted after updating the IMEI/Device ID in the backend. This prevents inconsistencies in user performance data (e.g., syncing older unsynced data after switching to a new device).

Note 3: IMEI/Device ID Updates: Updates to IMEI or device ID are supported only through the UI. Changes via MDM or integration APIs are restricted, as bulk updates can significantly impact user activity. Additionally, users whose device ID is updated will be required to log in again on the new device.

settings.name: merchandisingShelfEvidence
settings.description: This settings use for Merchandising Shelf Evidence for No-Stock. if value is 1 then the evidence is mandatory for No-stock in merchandising

settings.name: SpecialOrderforCreditExceptions
settings.description: 0 - No special credit orders are allowed. 1 - Only Credit Limit bypass. Enable special order processing for outlets on Bizom (SFA) when the credit limit is exceeded. The order will go for approval. 2 - Only Credit Days bypass. Enable special order processing for outlets on Bizom (SFA) when the credit days are exceeded. The order will go for approval. 3 - Both Credit Limit and Credit Days bypass. Enable special order processing for outlets on Bizom (SFA) when either the credit limit or credit days are exceeded. The order will go for approval.

settings.name: SpecialOrderforDiscountExceptions
settings.description: 0 - Disabled. 1 - Displays "Special Discount" option while punching order for outlets on Bizom (SFA) which allows users to give discounts above the variable discount limit set. The order would then go for approval.

settings.name: ignoreRejectedOutletsInDuplicationCheck
settings.description: This setting is used to ignore the rejected outlet from the outlet duplication check. This setting can have two values 0 and 1. Value 1 indicates that you can ignore the rejected outlet during the duplicate check

settings.name: newviewApprovalConfigurationsforSetrules
settings.description: if newviewApprovalConfigurationsforSetrules is enabled then it will allow the set Rules for salereturn approvalconfigration date and amount wise, this setting bydefault enable for all companies

settings.name: salereturnWarehouseTypeids
settings.description: This setting is used  to store the warehouse type IDs for returning warehouses. The warehouse type id of the sub-distributors placing salereturn should be passed here comma spareted at warehouse level. Credit and debit note will not generate for such sale returns. This is dependent on damageClaimProcess setting.

settings.name: newAssetFlow
settings.description: If value is 0, then old asset flow will be work. If value is 1, the new asset flow will work. if value is 2 then work with global warehouse concept. adding the global warehouse id to the setting assetGlobalWarehouse must

settings.name: summaryScreenNewUI
settings.description: This setting is used for the Bizom Android app (Bourbon) to enable the new UI on the Summary screen. If the value of this setting is 1, the new UI will be enabled; otherwise, it will be disabled.

settings.name: enableLeaveApprovalConfiguration
settings.description: This setting has two possible values: 0 and 1. If the value is set to 1, the approver can only approve leave requests based on the leave management approval configuration, and it is not dependent on the approval sequence. If the value is set to 0, the approver can approve leave requests for all users under their supervision. By default, the value for this setting is 0

settings.name: blockAfterInsufficientInventory
settings.description: This is setting is used in app ,when enabled , If inventory is insufficient then app will show pop-up and submission will be restricted. if disabled submission will be allowed. The setting works for normal sale ( sale_without_loadout = 1 ) and order fulfillment.

settings.name: enableSKUSerialNumberValidationMandatory
settings.description: This is setting used in app,If the enableSKUSerialNumberValidationMandatory setting is enabled, users will need to enter the serial number on the apps tertiary screen, making it mandatory.

settings.name: paymentmodescheme
settings.description: This is a company level setting. When the value is 1 then schemes will be applied based on payment modes. 0 means the setting is disabled.</br> For example : If the scheme is configured for cash based payment mode then at the time of sale / order fulfillment we will apply the scheme if the conditions mentioned at the time of scheme creation is satisfied for cash based invoices. Collection for Cash outlets will be manual when this setting is enabled in app

settings.name: disableBackCameraRotationForAttendanceMark
settings.description: This setting is used to restrict user from changing to the back camera, while marking the attendance. By default we are using front camera when user mark the attendance. Allowed value for this setting is 0 or 1, and default setting value is 0. For value 0 --> User can change/rotate camera to front or back both. For value 1 --> We restrict user to only use front camera, user will not be able to rotate to back camera.

settings.name: enable_additional_tax
settings.description:
This functionality helps in applying additional tax in order/sale and order fulfilment from web.
Supported values:
0 - Functionality is disabled (default).
1 - Additional tax is applied before GST, but after scheme & discount (fixed or variable at SKU & invoice level).On Discounted Price additional tax is applied & on top of it GST is applied.
2 - Additional tax is applied after GST, but after scheme & discount (fixed or variable at SKU & invoice level).On Discounted Price GST will be applied & on top of it additional tax applied.
3 - Additional tax is applied before GST and also before scheme & discount (fixed or variable at SKU & invoice level).
4 - Additional tax is applied after GST, but before scheme & discount (fixed or variable at SKU & invoice level)
5 - Additional tax is applied before GST & additional tax needs to set for warehouse against the SKU.On Discounted Price additional tax is applied & on top of it GST is applied row wise.
6 - Additional tax is applied after GST & additional tax needs to set for warehouse against the SKU.On Discounted Price GST will be applied & on top of it additional tax applied row wise.
Note: Setting showgstintransaction value should 1. Tax percentage must be configured at the Seller level (warehouse / distributor). Enabling this setting will show pre-GST and post-GST breakdowns in transaction screens (order, order fulfilment, sale, etc.). Values 3 and 4 are not supported here. They will be supported for primary, depending on the additional_tax_on_primarypurchase setting. For setting values 1,2,3,4 additional tax is set at the warehouse, for setting values 5 & 6 additional tax is set at the warehouse & SKU combination.

settings.name: additional_tax_visibility
settings.description: Dependent on setting enable_additional_tax_warehouse. 0 - Additional Tax field will be readonly. 1 - Additional Tax field will be editable.

settings.name: enableLddSupport
settings.description: The enableLddSupport setting determines how License Dependent Drugs (LDD) are managed in the system. If set to 0, LDD support is disabled. When set to 1, it allows users to mark SKUs as "LDD." With a value of 2, it permits both marking SKUs as LDD and uploading license details, as well as updating or uploading mappings between these licenses and entities. If set to 3, it provides full functionality, allowing both LDD marking and license management while also enforcing restrictions on purchasing LDD products based on licenses.

settings.name: isWarehouseLocationSet
settings.description: Default value is 0.If value is 0 then Warehouse whose location is not available will be allowed to do transaction. if value is 1 then Warehouse whose location is not available will not be allowed to do transaction.

settings.name: merchandising_image_upload_timer
settings.description: This setting allows the company to configure a specific wait time in seconds for the merchandising images uploads. If an image upload is not completed within the designated timeframe, the application will trigger a popup notification, advising the user to switch to offline mode for merchandising activities. The value added should be "more than 0" if the company is interested in using this setting, or else the default time to throw an error is after the 60 second

settings.name: submitEodWeb
settings.description: This setting is used in web only.This setting has to set for user/role/designation.If setting value is set as 1 then Admin can submit eod for that user from web for previous date if attendances is marked.If setting value is set as 2 then eod time can be edited for user from web if attendance is marked with mandatory remarks for editing.

settings.name: creditLimitCalculationConfig
settings.description: This setting is for credit limit calculation when setting userbalancecheckinloadout is 1 and we are checking user credit limit with loadout amount for loadout approval. values 0. we will use users credit limit only 1. we will subtract outletbalance from user credit limit and then verify loadout ammout with that. Default will be 1.

settings.name: enableSearchtypeDropdown
settings.description: When this setting is enabled, a dropdown will appear next to the search bar, allowing users to choose between "User" or "Outlet." This selection determines the search type either user or outlet. If the setting is disabled, the dropdown will not be displayed, and both user and outlet searches will be performed without the option to select. This configuration is applicable only for universal search.

settings.name: outletsInRadius
settings.description: The setting value should be in meters. By default, it will be set to 0 and disabled. You can enable it by specifying a value in meters. This setting will display all nearby outlets when the "Add Outlet" button is clicked in the app. If the setting value is greater than 0, all outlets within the specified range will be fetched and shown in a popup.

settings.name: enableFormSubmissionFrequencyInInterval
settings.description: Controls how often a form may be submitted within a configured interval. 0 = disabled, 1 = frequency counted per user for an outlet (existing behaviour), 2 = frequency counted per outlet irrespective of which user submits. Supported for Activities (Secondary forms), Primary Order forms and Tertiary Sale forms.

settings.name: auto_fill_activity_form
settings.description: This setting has two possible values[only for app]: 0 and 1. If the value is set to 1, this activity form will be auto fill. If the value is set to 0, this will be disabled. By default, the value for this setting is 0

settings.name: trainerModuleConfigurations
settings.description:
This setting is used to configure trainer module, it contains multiple settings used to configure trainer module. To modify/add/edit this setting, go to following url /tasks/configureTrainerModule. DO NOT DIRECTLY PUT ANY VALUE INSIDE THIS SETTING, USE GIVEN URL TO MODIFY IT
Note: Only version 2 is supported. Version 1 got depricated.

settings.name: okta_signin
settings.description: This setting is used to enable the OneLogin setup with Okta. If the setting value is set to `1`, an Okta login button will appear on the login page of the web application. Before enabling this setting for your company, please contact the R&D team to complete the necessary Okta configuration.

settings.name: syncInventoryBeforeTransaction
settings.description: It is a company level setting.If enabled then will sync latest inventory based on internet availability before order/sale summary so inventory validation happens based on latest inventory availability

settings.name: updateClaimAmountAfterApproval
settings.description: This is setting default value is 0.when this setting enable then it will allow to edit the appproved claim amount for the admin role users before no due genarate. for old claim it will dependent on setting  editclaimapprovalamount

settings.name: removeRestrictionWhenNonTransactional
settings.description: When setting removeRestrictionWhenNonTransactional is enabled, during non-transactional warehouse creation,all fields are made non-mandatory except for the Warehouse name. If this setting is disabled, all fields will follow  existing flow and restrictions, even in a non-transactional process. This setting is used in web,APIs & MDM.

settings.name: nearbyoutletsdistance
settings.description: This setting is used to set radius (in meter) to display near by outlet in "near by outlets tab" in App. This setting will work if and only if setting "outletsdisplaymode" is set as 3. Default value is set to 1000 meter

settings.name: restrictClaimTypeAndOptions
settings.description: The default value is 0. This setting has a JSON value containing the keys claimTypeIds, claimFieldIds, and claimOptionIds. The claimTypeIds key specifies claim type IDs that will not be visible when raising a claim, and corresponding cart items will also be hidden. Similarly, claimFieldIds and claimOptionIds specify the IDs of claim fields and claim options, respectively, that will not be visible. All keys operate independently. ex format {"claimTypeIds":"1,2","claimFieldIds":"1,2","claimOptionIds":"1,2"}

settings.name: apply_gst_on_mrp
settings.description: Default value 0. If value set to 1 MRP value will be displayed by reducing gst.

settings.name: IgnoreRejectedClaimsFromLimitValidations
settings.description: Default value is 0, this setting value 1 then it will ignore the Rejected claim count and amount from validation while submiting the claim.

settings.name: allow_multiple_active_loadout
settings.description: Default value is 0. This setting allows salesmen to have loadouts from multiple warehouse/distributor on same day if set to 1. Salesmen can have loadouts from only one warehouse/distributor at a time if set to 0, need to settle the loadout from distributor A to add the new loadouts from distributor B. To enable, the setting has to be created with the warehouse-type.

settings.name: settle_loadout_at_parent_distributor
settings.description: Default value is 0. Please note that this setting has to enabled on those warehouse/distributor which is mapped to any parent warehouse/distributor. On APPROVAL of all the loadouts raised on this child for the day & when there are no pending/unsettled loadouts on any of the previous days, SETTLEMENT will be done on child for current day. Additionally, same set of loadouts will be created in the parent warehouse or distributor.

settings.name: reCheckStartCallLocation
settings.description:
This is a company level setting used in mobile application, to recheck user location while starting transaction. Allowed values for this setting is 0 or 1, By default value will be 0. Pop up will show when user clicks on start call or phone order, then we refresh and recheck user's current location.

Case 1 : If the distance between users current location and outlet location is lesser than outlet allowed varaince Then pop up will be visible :
"You are X meters away from the outlet. Would you like to continue with start call." with proceed button.

Case 2 : If the distance between users current location and outlet location is greater than outlet allowed variance metre. Then pop up will be visible :
"You are X meters away from the outlet. Would you like to continue with Phone in order" with a proceed button

settings.name: ConfigureAItasksforCompany
settings.description: This setting is used at the user level, with the following options: 0: Disabled 1: Enable Regular Sales/Order (mandatory when enabling other options) 2: Enable Upsell (optional) 3: Enable Cross-Sell (optional) 4: Enable Product Recovery (optional) To enable these features, provide a comma-separated list of values (e.g., 1,2,3,4). The value 1 must always be included when enabling any combination of 2, 3, or 4

settings.name: DontMissThesePSC
settings.description: Default value is 0. This user-level setting determines the PSC items displayed under the "Don`t Miss These section": 0: Disabled 1: enabled

settings.name: sellTypeSequencing
settings.description: This company-level setting is used to determine the sequencing of sell types in the App or Web UI. The value should be comma-separated, with the following mapping: 1: Regular Order 2: Upsell 3: Cross-Sell 4: Product Recovery The default value is 1,2,3,4, which means the sequence is: Regular Order, Upsell, Cross-Sell, Product Recovery. If the value is 2,3,4,1, the sequence will be: Upsell, Cross-Sell, Product Recovery, Regular Order.

settings.name: outletimagededup
settings.description: This is a user-level setting used to enable outlet image dedupe. Default value is 0. If value is 0 then disable,1 Only outlet image validation,2 image validation and deduplication.

settings.name: eligibleoutletimagededup
settings.description: This is a user-level setting used to check eligibility of outlet based on image for image dedupe. Default value is 0. If value is 0 then disable, If value is 1 then only all valid image outlet eligible for dedupe,2 partial valid image outlet eligible for dedupe.

settings.name: allowDuplicateClaimtypeName
settings.description: Default value is 0. If the setting is enabled, duplicate claim type names will be allowed while creating a claim type. Otherwise, duplicate names will not be allowed.

settings.name: cutofffulfillordermonthend
settings.description: Order cutoff days when fulfilling order at the end of month or beginning of order's next month. Default value is 0 and possible values can be anything greater than 0. Here values are the number of days. If this setting is greater than 0, this cutoff is considered automatically while fulfilling order at month end or beginning of next month. Please note that the setting cutofffulfillorder should be enabled.

settings.name: creditLimitValidationMode
settings.description: defaults to 0, meaning a hard block. If set to 1, it allows a soft block, where the user can proceed after seeing a warning message. Please note, this setting is only applicable if the "checkoutletbalanceinorder" is set to 1 or 3, and applies only to Primary orders.

settings.name: ManualSNinputtoMapSNwithInventory
settings.description: The ManualSNinputtoMapSNwithInventory setting allows you to manually enter serial numbers. When set to 0, this feature is off. Setting it to 1 enables typing, while 2 enables scanning (with typing as a backup if scanning doesnâ€™t work).

settings.name: hide_mrp_price_loadout
settings.description: This settings is used to hide mrp and price on loadout module (loadout sku, loadout summary and van stock, transaction screen) in Mobile app. Default value is 1- to hide the mrp and price in loadout module 0- To display mrp and price in loadout module. default value will be 0.

settings.name: enable_pricing_approval
settings.description: This setting has two possible values: 0 and 1. If the value is set to 1, Approval flow for the pricing will be enabled with date-range. By default, the value for this setting is 0

settings.name: addFreeSkuRestrictionOnSchemeGroupForBuyer
settings.description: This setting is used to apply restrictions at the scheme group level, defining how many free SKUs can be allocated to a buyer within that scheme group. Once the specified number of free SKUs has been given, the scheme will no longer be applicable to that buyer. Setting will have two value 0 and 1. If setting value is 1 then restriction will be applied for the buyer

settings.name: enableOnlineInvoiceAndSkuCappingCalculation
settings.description: This setting is used in the app to enable the calculation of invoice count and to enforce the maximum free SKU capping restriction at the scheme group level  on the order/sale summary screen

settings.name: Serialization
settings.description: Default value is 0, which means it is disabled. Setting the value to 1 enables serialization in Bizom. If this setting is enabled then auto order, bulk fulfillment will not be supported. Similarly the setting value should be zero for qtyincases, qtyincasesformobile & qtyincasesformobile_pri.

settings.name: enableMultiTownForPincode
settings.description:
The setting Default Value: 0
0 - Disabled
1 - Enabled
If the setting is enabled, multiple towns can be assigned to the same pincode.
If the setting is disabled, only one town can be assigned per pincode.

settings.name: schemeCappingForSchemeGroup
settings.description: This setting is used for storing scheme group id for schemecapping table if value is set to 1 By default Value is zero.This setting is used for both app and web.This Setting Dependent on multischemeenable setting.multischemeenable setting must be enabled

settings.name: enableCollectEmptyPacks
settings.description: This setting is used for to collect the empty pack collection from retailers of sale and order and get scheme benefits for this kind of promotions. Default value is 0 and by value 1 we enable the empty pack collection functionality.

settings.name: displayEmptyPackCollection
settings.description: This setting is used for to display and collect the empty pack collection from retailers of sale or order in web and get scheme benefits for this kind of promotions. Default value is 0 where the empty pack collection will be displayed in both order and sale workflow and by value 1 we display the empty pack collection functionality only in the order and by value to 2, It will be displayed only in the sale screen.

settings.name: advanced_image_capture
settings.description: The default value is 0. If the value is set to 1, additional details such as the Address Stamp, Date and Time Stamp, City, Pincode, District, Latitude and Longitude will be displayed on the image.

settings.name: AfterVisit_OffLocationTransaction
settings.description: If user has done the at least one call for the day, AfterVisit_OffLocationTransaction setting is enabled, outlet location is available,  off_location_orders reasons are configured then off location transaction/phone in order plus icon will be visible to do transaction for secondary  in app

settings.name: blockSaleForSubstockist
settings.description: This is a company based setting developed for GCPL. The setting only works for direct sale. When the setting is enabled the it allows the super stockist to make the first sale to a new sub-stockist. From the second sale onward, the sub-stockist must have at least one outlet linked otherwise, further sales will be blocked.

settings.name: creatorNewlyAddedDistributorToTheManager
settings.description: This setting can include comma-separated designation IDs representing the users who create distributors. When a user with a designation ID listed in this setting creates a new distributor, the new distributor will be assigned to the immediate manager of that user. Also managers designation ID must also be specified in the assignNewlyAddedDistributorToTheManager setting and usereportingtoforhiararchy setting should be enabeled.

settings.name: enableDistributorLevel
settings.description: This is a company level setting. Supported values are 0 and 1. Default value is 0. When the setting value is set to 1 then distributor level will be credit level.

settings.name: OutletVisitedColor
settings.description:
This setting determines the color for the outlet name and the double-tick icon, which will appear when a call is made for that outlet on the current date.
The setting value can be a hex code, e.g., #003FA4.
If empty, the default color will be used.
Note: The selected color should not match the one defined for KPIs in the outlet color coding.

settings.name: reCAPTCHAVerification
settings.description: This setting used for enabling/disabling reCAPTCHA verification

settings.name: blockTransactionAfterStockSettlement
settings.description: Default value is 0, if value is 1 then after the loadin settlement tranasction will be block.

settings.name: checkForUniqueFieldInWarehouse
settings.description:
This is user/role/designation specific setting.To enabling this feature you have to set for enable field.If the setting is enabled and phonenumber is set to 1 then it will check unique phone number, if gstinno is set to 1 it will check unique gstinno, if panno is set to 1 it will check unique panno. If multiple fields are set to 1 it will check combination of that fields uniqueness.By default this setting is disabled and having sample value like {"enable":0,"phonenumber":0,"gstinno":0,"panno":0}.This has been handled in App and Web

NOTE :: If you are enabling this setting then make sure you are setting enable field as required in basic outlet formwarehouseadd,warehousedit,adddistributor formdefintion. Also the field you want to check duplicate should be enabeled in this setting.

settings.name: checkDuplicates
settings.description: This is user/role/designation specific setting.By default value is 0 to enable this feature you have to set value to 1.If the setting is enabled then it will check unique filed in warehouses and outlets based on settings checkforuniqueoutletmobilenumber and checkForUniqueFieldInWarehouse

settings.name: VerifyOutletException
settings.description: Please enter the comma separated Outlet Type Ids for which the otp verification will be skipped on outlet add & outlet edit

settings.name: minimumInvoiceAmountforVariableDiscount
settings.description: This Setting is dependent on applyvariablediscount if this setting enabled then only this setting will work. This setting used for Minimum Invoice amount if this setting is enabled then user will able to add Minimum Invoice Amount for Variable Discount. Varibale Discount will apply only if Bill amount is greater than or equal to Minimum Invoice Amount. By default Value is set to Zero.To enable It set to 1.

settings.name: onlineFlowEnabled
settings.description: Default value 0. This setting is used for custom data sync in app, used by specific company to reduce the sync time, where sku data is present in huge number.

settings.name: tourProgramVersion
settings.description:
This user level setting is used to enable revamped tour program module in your company. Allowed setting values are 3, 2 and 1, default value is 1.

version value 1 will run old tour program feature.
version value 2 will enable entirely revamp tour program UI and its new feature in app and web both.
version value 3 will run revamped tour program version on top of version 2 only for app, no web portal support is there to create tour plan or execute anything from web for version 3, all task creation and execution is fully app based ( It is developed for DSM - District Sales Manager ).

So please set version value as per your requirement.
NOTE : This setting will work iff "tourProgramWithoutBudget" is enabled.
Only version 2,3 is supported. Version 1 got depricated.
Version 3 is build for GCPL Indo.

settings.name: tourProgramWithoutBudgetCalendarMonthLimitInSFA
settings.description: This is a company level setting. Value of this setting will restrict how many months in future or in past user can go. For example if setting value is 3 and assume current month is May,2025 then user will be able to see calendar in future till august,2025 and in past till february 2025. We are setting default value of 3 months. So current range will be current month + 3 months and current months - 3 months.

settings.name: allowPreSaleLoadin
settings.description: This is for sadafco as they have the presale designation users where the loadin will be allowed with only salereturn transactions. The value 1 will be used to display the data in loadin screen for the settlement for presale users with designation id 28 and 29.

settings.name: restrictLoadoutForLongRoute
settings.description: supported values are 0 and 1. Default is 0. 0: No restriction. Long Route users can create new Loadout Requests even after starting their Long Route Journey. 1: Restriction applies. Once the Long Route Journey has started, Long Route users cannot create new Loadout Requests until the route is settled.

settings.name: longRouteVansale
settings.description: 0 means the Long Route process is disabled, and users will follow the standard Van Sales process. 1 means the Long Route process is enabled for the company, and a user will be eligible to perform Van Sales with the defined start and end dates based on the Loadout Plan and Loadin Settlement. Note: Long Route applies to a user only when all of the following are configured: this setting is enabled, the feature_loadout_setting setting is enabled for the user (the user has to accept the approved loadouts to start the route), and the user is marked as Long Route User.

settings.name: enableClaimKpiMapping
settings.description: Default value will be 0, if its enabled then claim kpi option will be visible in claim type add and edit UI. it will show the system calculate values while user adding the claim.

settings.name: SmartAssetFlow
settings.description: By default, this setting is set to 0, which means the Smart Asset flow is disabled. Setting this to 1 enables the Smart Asset flow. The Smart Asset tab will appear in the Outlet Call flow, displaying assets that are mapped with the â€œis Smart Assetâ€ flag.

settings.name: revertClaimFlowToClaimant
settings.description: Default value is 0. When enabled (value = 1), rejected claims are reverted to the claimant. If disabled (value = 0), the claim follows the default flow and is reverted to the previous level approver.

settings.name: manualplanogram
settings.description: default value  0. If the value is 1, then the  camera icon will be hidden from the planogram in merchandising module

settings.name: splitOrder
settings.description: This setting allows an order to be split into multiple orders based on the number of warehouses assigned to the logged-in user who has the necessary permissions, as well as the available inventory of the order line items. Set to 1 to enable. The default value is 0

settings.name: apienabledfordeltasync
settings.description: This is an internal setting used to enable delta synchronization in APIs. It is strictly for internal use and should not be modified or used directly, as it may impact the application's functionality.

settings.name: outletlevelworkflows
settings.description: This is a company level setting. Accepted values are 0, 1 and 2. Default value is 0. If value 1 is passed then we will be able to restrict activity based on outlet level configuration. If value 2 is passed, it works as 1 and additionally (when enableAccountingParentBilling is 1) every child outlet of an Accounting Parent (Key Account) inherits the workflows restricted at that parent: the effective restriction of a child is its own restrictions plus the parent's, the inherited ones cannot be edited at the child, and a change at the parent applies to all its child outlets.

settings.name: cashAtCreditOutlet
settings.description: default value is 0, if value is 1 then it will allow the credit outlets can be do the cash collections. this setting will be the warehouse level setting.

settings.name: damageClaimTypeWiseApproval
settings.description: default value will be 0, when damageClaimTypeWiseApproval enabled at the time of damage claim approval configuration damageclaimtype_id will be mandatory. and whole damage claim approval flow will work based on damageclaimtype_id

settings.name: enableLatestBatchPriceAndInfo
settings.description:
Default Value:
0: Feature is disabled.

Enabled Values:
1: Supports in the Primary Order only.
2: Supports in the Secondary Order only.
3: Supports in both Primary and Secondary Orders.

Description:
When this feature is enabled (value set to 1, 2, or 3), users will see batch-related details alongside inventory on the orders screen. The price and MRP for items will be calculated based on the latest batch (most recently created).Note :- IF enableLatestBatchPriceAndInfo and nearestBatchwisePrice both are enabled enableLatestBatchPriceAndInfo will be prioritized

settings.name: showDefaultSkuListForDesignType
settings.description: This setting controls whether a default SKU list is displayed on the design type screen for secondary orders, primary orders and sale. When set to 0, the feature is disabled, and no SKUs are listed by default. When set to 1, the first 50 SKUs will automatically be listed based on bu mapping of the user or else as per inventory on the design type screen.

settings.name: enableHttpRequestCollection
settings.description: Set as 1 to enable capturing Http request as postman collection

settings.name: rejectedoutletcheck
settings.description: This setting has two possible values: the default value is 0 (disabled). When enabled (value = 1), if the user clicks on "check duplicates" for phoneno, GSTIN, etc., all active and inactive outlets will be displayed in the popup. If inactive outlets are present with a REJECTED status, users will be allowed to edit and re-submit these outlets, triggering an approval process again. If disabled, the normal flow will apply, displaying both active and inactive outlets in the same popup without any option to edit the outlets. Note: This setting is dependent on the "checkforuniqueoutletmobilenumber" setting, which determines if outlet phone numbers, GSTINno, etc., must be unique across outlets.

settings.name: smartSearch
settings.description: To Use this feature please get your company configured on smartsearch skunit service TO change the Search technique use skunitSmartSearchType setting . Default value 0. This setting is used to enable smart search on sku in order screeen in app.value 1: enable 0: disable

settings.name: skunitSmartSearchType
settings.description: To configure the search mechanism in smart search for skunits. Values FUZZY: to enable Fuzzy search logic, SEMANTIC: to enable Semantic search logic. Default: FUZZY

settings.name: InactivateBeatValidation
settings.description: This is a company-level setting. The default value is 0. Set it to 1 to prevent beats from being deactivated if they contain active outlets.

settings.name: assetGlobalWarehouse
settings.description: Default value is 0, this setting has json value. inside the json notation mention the Global warehouse id.this global warehouse id will consider when setting newAssetFlow value 2. only one global warehouse id should be allowed.ex: {"GlobalWarehouseId":1}

settings.name: businessTypeUserMapping
settings.description: This is a company-level setting. By default, the setting is disabled with a value of 0. Enabling this setting by changing the value to 1. When the setting is enabled, a Business Type filter will be added to the userâ€™s add and edit screens, and warehouses will be displayed based on the Business Type filter

settings.name: showHideDocumentUploadforClaimApproval
settings.description: default value is 0, if value is 1 then it will allow to upload document at the time of Claim approval otherwise document upload option will not visible , it will work for both old and new claim approval

settings.name: feature_loadout_setting
settings.description: 0 - Disabled : When this setting is disabled, only the manager's approval is required, and the van salesman can't approve or reject the loadout. 1 - Enabled : When this setting is enabled, the van salesman has the authority to approve or reject the loadout after the manager's approval.In current stock screen print icon will be visible only when this setting is enabled.The user can settle the stocks for the previous days and accept for the current date. 2 - If any previous settlements are pending, restrict the user to approve the loadout in app, else allow the user to approve or reject the loadout in app.

settings.name: salereturnapproverqty
settings.description: If set to 1, it enables the edit option for all approver levels when salesreturnmultilevelapproval is also set to 1. However, if set to 0 while salesreturnmultilevelapproval remains 1, only the final level can approve. This setting functions based on the value of salesreturnmultilevelapproval.

settings.name: outlet_month_colour_on_transaction_type
settings.description: Default value is 0, when set to 1 then we will show outlet month colour based on van sale or sale amount in app. When value is 0 then it will work as per existing flow which is shown based on order data.

settings.name: selfpayment
settings.description:
Setting Default Value: 0 </br>
    0: Disabled </br>
    1: Enabled the selfPayment for Role id 3 and Role id 6. The user can do selfPayment from himself to seller. </br>
    3: Enabled with Partial Self-Collection Amount Support for invoices and debit notes with the invoice type. This option provides partial support for the amount only. </br>
    If enabled, the self-payment option will be applicable only to role IDs 3 and 6. This feature is not supported for any other Bizom role IDs. </br>
    Please note that setting values 2 and 3 will provide partial support only for invoices. Without an invoice, all cases will function with the same behavior.

settings.name: addLoadoutNextWorkDay
settings.description:
This setting is used when adding a loadout to the next day.
0 - By default, disabled.
1 - Confirmation prompt will appear, asking whether the loadout should be moved to the user's next working day. This feature is implemented only on the web.
2 - User's Next working day based on the Holiday calendar to be expended on App.

settings.name: allowZeroCasesInOrderScreen
settings.description: This is a company-level setting used in the mobile app. On enabling (value = 1), entry of 0 as quantity SKU in the Case field on the Order screen will be allowed. On disabling this setting, entering 0 in the Case quantity field will not be allowed. Default value is 0 (disabled). Note: Reference ID: PR1-T7646

settings.name: breakSerializedCase
settings.description:
Supported Values:
0 -Allows serialized cases to be sold in individual units.
1 -Serialized cases can only be sold as a complete case.
Description: This setting applies only if the "Serialization" setting is enabled. It determines whether serialized cases can be broken down for individual unit sales or must be sold as a whole case.

settings.name: split_order
settings.description: Default value is 0, if value is 1 then it will allow to split the primary orders.

settings.name: creditLimitSoftBlock
settings.description:
The setting enables soft blocking when the sale amount exceeds the allowed credit limit. By default, the setting value is 0. Supported values: 0 - Default setting (current flow) - Normal credit limit validation without soft blocking.
1 - Enable soft blocking - Users can proceed with the sale even if the outstanding balance exceeds the credit limit, but a warning message will be displayed and allows proceed further.
2 - Enable soft blocking - Users can proceed with the sale even if the outstanding balance exceeds the credit limit / credit days, but a warning message will be displayed and allows proceed further

settings.name: PJPFilter
settings.description: Default value: 0. If the value is set to 1, a filter will be available on the /pjps/pjpupdate screen, allowing beats to be filtered based on the distributor mapped to the user whose PJP is being updated. Setting: multipleoutletsforarea must be set to 2 for this setting to function. Note: PJP should not be set for users mapped to more than 50 distributors using this filter or any user having role ID greater than 4, as it will impact performance.

settings.name: deliveredInvoiceValidation
settings.description:
Default value is 0. If value is 1, then delivered invoices cannot be modified in system. Delivered & Dispatched status bills will not be shown in ../orders/fulfilledorderloadoutsheet.  Dispatched or Invoice status bills cannot be settled in system.
This is specifically Built for BAT. Please reach out to R&D before enabling this setting

settings.name: sync_tertiary_with_external_service
settings.description: [Only for Livpure] Default value will be 0, 1 will be syncing the tertiary data with external service

settings.name: EnableBluetoothSaleDIG
settings.description: If you want to use Bluetooth Sale DIG setting you need to add 1 for active and 0 for inactive DIG.

settings.name: showskuform_forStockAtOutlet
settings.description: This setting determines the visibility of the SKU form for stock at outlets and has a default value of 0. When the value is set to 1, the SKU form for stock at outlets will be visible. If the value is set to 0, the SKU form will not be visible.

settings.name: alloweditqty_skuform_forStockAtOutlet
settings.description: This setting is managed exclusively within the app and has a default value of zero. When the setting is enabled (value set to 1), users dealing with custom SKU stock forms will only need to fill out the form once, regardless of the quantity they are filling in stock at outlet.

settings.name: failed_delivery_reason
settings.description: This setting supports two values: 0 (disable) and 1 (enable). When set to 1, reasons for a failed delivery attempt will be displayed. When set to 0, the reasons will remain hidden.

settings.name: ignoreavailableinventoryforfreesku
settings.description: When this setting is enabled (set to 1), free SKUs will be excluded from inventory checks. This means that even if a free SKU has insufficient inventory, the sale will not be blocked, as long as checkcheckavailableinventory is enabled.

settings.name: enableReportGroup
settings.description:
This setting is used to group the reports. Support is added in Apptab sequence to show "report" or "reportgroup" in the Bizom app (in Home/main screen).
This setting is relevant for Bizom mobile app only.
Default value is 0. Report grouping will be ignored and reports will be shown as shown now.
If value is 1, "report" app tab sequence will be shown as a single report. "reportgroup" app tab will be shown as a set of reports grouped by the reportgroup id.

settings.name: Salecheck
settings.description: Default value is 0. If the value is 1, then in the app for any VanSale user (sale & sale return workflow [with or without invoice enabled] then we will add a validation on submit call click, which will check if sale value is greater than sale return value.

settings.name: Netsalecollection
settings.description: Default value is 0. If the value is 1, then on call submission the bill will be generated in the system and that bill will be displayed in the collection screen with the return amount & any selected credit notes automatically adjusted against the balance of the bill. Applicable when Sale/Van Sale with Order, Sale Return, collection,2 - This value will be supported to make collection on cash outlets without the logic,3 - This value will be supported to disable the collection flow on cash outlets  enabled in App.

settings.name: EnableCreditLimitVanSale
settings.description: Default value is 0. If the value is 1, when Van Sale user [with sale workflow enabled] does a transaction at credit outlets system will check if the sale - sale return - credit note value punched in the call crosses the existing outlet balance or not, when Net Payable > Available outlet balance. Applicable only from app.

settings.name: allow_creditnote_for_cash_outlet
settings.description: Default value is 0, when set to 1 we will be displaying credit note selection for outlet level is cash. This is supported at warehouse level and functionality is supported in Bizom app only.

settings.name: vatRegex
settings.description: Please utilize this setting to restrict the tax number using a regex pattern. It will impact the add/edit operations for outlets, warehouses, and distributors. Ensure that the provided values adhere to a valid regex format. This is a company-level setting and its default value will be ^[0-9a-zA-Z]+$, which allows numbers and alphabets.

settings.name: MandaroryToOpenAttachmentForClaimApproval
settings.description: This setting ensures that viewing mandatory attached documents is required before claim approval. If the value is set to 1, all documents must be reviewed before approval. The default value is 0, meaning document review is not mandatory. This setting applies only to new claims

settings.name: enableFocWorkflow
settings.description: This settings is used to enable FOC workflow (This is developed for BAT) please enable setting RestrictLoadoutApprove to use this functionality. values are 1- to enable 0- To disable. default value will be 0.

settings.name: EditOutletWithReverseGeocode
settings.description: The default value is 0. Setting it to 1 enables Reverse GeoCode for the Edit Outlet flow in app, overriding the existing address, pincode, state, district, and city based on the users geo-location at the time of editing.enabledpincodemapping & FetchLiveAddressUsingApi settings need to be enabled to get the Pincode & Address at the time of edit outlet.

settings.name: numberOfPayeesAllowed
settings.description:
This is a company-level setting with two keys: outlet and distributor.
By default, both keys are set to 0, meaning the setting may have any number of payees allowed for both outlet annd distributor.
If you want to limit number of payees allowed than pass the limit you want for outlet and distribuitor
Note: Here key outlet will work if setting enablePayeeForOutlet is enabled, distributor will work if setting enablePayeeForDistributor is enabled

settings.name: defaultApprover
settings.description: This is a Role, Designation, or User-based setting, used only by the admin.</br> By default, the value is set to 0, meaning the setting is disabled.</br> To enable this setting, set the value to 1.</br> If the setting is enabled, the admin can approve outlets, tasks, and MCP independent of who is the approver in configuration. This feature is designed for approval configuration.</br>

settings.name: showInfluencer
settings.description: This setting is used to show influencer in app. If setting value is 1 then influencer will be show in app. values are 1- to enable 0- To disable. default value will be 0.

settings.name: NewDeliveryCollection
settings.description: Enable new delivery collection flow and disable auto collection creation from Backend on sale/order fulfillment creation ,Values 1: enable, 0:disable.Default value 0.

settings.name: showMappedChildSkusInOrder
settings.description: This setting is used to show child skunits for the parent SKU in the order edit and view screens. Default is 0 (disabled), set to 1 to enable.

settings.name: Paymentmodesforcollectnow
settings.description: This will be used to decide which payment mode to display In collection screen in mobile. 1-Net Banking, 2-Credit card, 3-Debit Card, 4-UPI, 5-Wallet, 6-Cash. Default Value "6". To set multiple payment modes you can put comma seprated values. ex. "1,2"->Net Banking and Credit card,"1"->Net Banking. you cannot put this setting empty, Applicable only from app.

settings.name: Paymentmodesforcollectlater
settings.description: Default value is 0. If the value is 1, then in users can collect a post-dated cheque only for the available credit value and remaining value using pay now. Applicable only from app.

settings.name: Collectiononcreditoutlets
settings.description: The default value for Collectiononcreditoutlets is 0, supported values will be 0 & 1 if 1 - Supports invoice generation by making a Collect Now payment (partial or full invoice value). Applicable only from app.

settings.name: creditrulesForAllOutletLevels
settings.description: This setting is supported only at the web level, specifically on the Order Fulfillment and Direct Sale screens. Supported values are 0 (default) and 1. When set to 1, it restricts transactions if the payment mode is credit or cheque and the amount exceeds the credit limit, even when the outlet is configured for cash payments.

settings.name: damageclaimreturnsequenceflow
settings.description:
This setting will enable different credit note sequence numbers for Damage returns. Default value of this setting is 0 and to enable this set the value to 1. 

NOTE: This is built specifically for Haleon. Please reach out to Engineering/product team before you enable this setting.

settings.name: markOutletAsClosedAndNotVisited
settings.description: This is Company-level setting and used only in APP. Accepted values: 0 (disabled), 1 (enabled). If enabled, users can mark outlets as Closed or Not Visited.

settings.name: setoutletStatusOption
settings.description: This is a company-level setting used only in the app. Its value includes two keys: "Outletclosed" and "OutletNotVisited". Enabling either will allow users to mark an outlet as closed or not visited(based on this setting we will provide options to select in app). For example value of setting : {"Outletclosed":1,"OutletNotVisited":0} will show only the "Outlet Closed" option. By default, both values are 0.

settings.name: uomalias
settings.description: Controls the App UOM alias functionality: 0 = disabled; 1 = enabled (overrides UI alias to cases/units on the Bizom Next App screens ). Does not affect existing case/unit hiding settings (e.g. qtyincasesformobile), which take precedence (e.g. if units are hidden on primary order screen, UOM alias will not display).

settings.name: editDistributorPayments
settings.description: The default value is 0. When set to 1, the approver will have permission to edit the selfPayment collection. This includes modifying selected invoices and adding new invoices, credit notes, and debit notes. This setting is only applicable when selfpayment is enabled.

settings.name: skipwarehouseskuinsert
settings.description: Setting build for JLL to skip warehousesku insetion from Inventory MDM, if setting value is 1 then after inventory upload/audit need to upload warehousesku from  Update state_cess and allowmorethan inventory MDM.

settings.name: enableBatchWiseScheme
settings.description: This settings is used to enable batch wise scheme in the company. Setting will have two values 0 and 1. If value is 1 then batch wise scheme will be enabled in the company

settings.name: pastdateqpsscheme
settings.description: A setting which allow you to create qps schemes with support of past start date, Default value is 1, 1 - Allows to create past dated start date for qps schemes only( settlement of qps after the scheme is expired), 0 - Prevents the user to create the scheme with past dated start date for qps schemes only

settings.name: sale&salereturninqpsscheme
settings.description: A setting which allow you to exclude the free skunit and rejected / inactivated sale return considertion while qps settlement this setting is dependt on the qpsscheme setting, Default value is 0, 0 - Considers the free skunits as part of qps scheme for sale and sale return, considers all sale returns placed / rejected in the qps scheme calculation, 1 -  Does not Considers the free skunits as part of qps scheme for sale and sale return, does not considers any sale returns in rejected or inactive state and free skunit in the qps scheme calculation

settings.name: CurrentStockPrint
settings.description: Controls the Current Stocks print icon. 0 = disabled; 1 = enabled with a single invoice template; 2 = enabled with two invoice templates (only if BlockTransactionAfterEOD is enabled). When value=1, users see one â€œPrintâ€ icon and use the default template. When value=2, users (and admins) can configure two separate templates for Current Stock printing.

settings.name: newOMSv2
settings.description: This is a new setting which is used for the new lead type wise mapping where lead is extending for the consumer,distributor, influencer and outlet in OMS/LMS module

settings.name: schemenudge
settings.description: setting value - 0 - disabled 1 - web 2- app 3- Both

settings.name: schemenudgethreshold
settings.description: This is a company-level setting defined as a percentage value. When a user places an order, this percentage is used to determine if the ordered SKUnit quantity or amount is close to qualifying for a particular scheme slab that has not yet been applied. If the order value (quantity or amount) falls short but is within the specified percentage range of the next eligible scheme slab, the system will trigger a scheme nudgeâ€”a prompt or alertâ€”to inform the user that they are close to availing an additional benefit.

settings.name: schemenudgeconfig
settings.description: This is a company-level setting. By default, the setting is disabled with a value of 0. To enable this setting, change the value of isActive to 1. The value should be in the following format: {"isActive": "1"}. When enabled, this setting will trigger an asynchronous API call for the scheme nudge to the B2b2cService.

settings.name: tdsredeemoninvoice
settings.description: This setting controls how TDS is redeemed on invoices and supports values 0, 1, and 2, where 0 allows the user to manually enter any TDS amount, 1 sets a prefilled non-editable TDS value, and 2 sets a prefilled editable TDS value. It is mandatory that the enableTDS setting is enabled for this to be applicable. This setting is supported at the Company, Warehouse, and Distributor levels.

settings.name: additional_tax_on_primarypurchase
settings.description: 0 - Disabled. 1 - This is extended from setting enable_additional_tax_warehouse, where additional tax was considered based on seller warehouse/distributor during primary & secondary sale. When this setting is enabled additional tax will be considered based on buyer warehouse/distributor. Also for this setting to work enable_additional_tax_warehouse setting should be enabled. Note : additional_tax_on_primarypurchase is applicable for primary orders as well. Default value is 0.

settings.name: crdrnoteredemptioninapp
settings.description: The crdrnoteredemptioninapp setting enables credit and debit note redemption within the Bizom App during collections. It supports the following values: 1 for primary credit notes, 2 for primary debit notes, 3 for secondary credit notes, 4 for secondary debit notes. Multiple values can be configured as a comma-separated list to allow a combination of redemption types. For example, if the entered values are 1,4, only primary and secondary credit note redemption options will be available in the app. The default value is 0, which disables this feature. This setting is applicable only within the Bizom App.

settings.name: blockpartialcollection
settings.description: This setting controls the ability to make partial collections against selected invoices pending balances. Value of 0 allows users to make partial collections. And value of 1 restricts collections to only the full pending balance of selected invoice amount, preventing partial payments. This is supported in both app & web. Note: This functionality will be supported only for Invoice Collections. Difference of 0.01 will be ignored. Default setting value is 0.

settings.name: showuniqueskusold
settings.description: This is a warehouse-level setting with a default value of 0. If set to 1, the "Unique SKU Sold" field will be shown in the outlet info screen, regardless of whether targets are active against the outlet. If set to 0, the field will not be displayed.

settings.name: restrictParentDistributor
settings.description:
This is a user-level configuration setting. By default, it is disabled (value = 0), allowing users to view all distributors and warehouses mapped to them in the User Master. When enabled (value = 1), the setting enforces access control based on parent-child distributor relationships and warehouse types configured for the user.

This setting restricts visibility on key screens like "Stock at Warehouse" and "Beat" screens. If a distributor's warehouse type is not mapped to the user, that distributor  will not be shown. For example, if a user has access only to warehouse type "Distributor", they will not see distributors with warehouse type "Super Stockist".

However, this restriction does NOT apply when adding outlets or distributors. In such cases, users will continue to see all distributors and warehouses regardless of the warehouse type mapping.

This setting is extendable via the existing "setDistributorDropDownValues" configuration.

settings.name: Creditcollectionflow
settings.description:
Supported values are 0 & 1 Default value is 0. Restrict the collection on new invoices (credit invoices will be generated)
. Applicable only from app.

settings.name: outletSmartSearchType
settings.description: This is a company-level setting that controls the outlet smart search mechanism. Valid values: {"FUZZY":"1","SEMANTIC":"0"} to enable fuzzy search, {"FUZZY":"0","SEMANTIC":"1"} to enable semantic search, or both 0 to disable. Default value: {"FUZZY":"0","SEMANTIC":"0"} .If both FUZZY and SEMANTIC are enabled, the system defaults to FUZZY search.

settings.name: Deliverysoftblock
settings.description:
Controls the soft or hard block behavior for the loadsheet.
Value 0 = disabled (default); 1 = soft block; 2 = hard block (requires Collection Screen before delivery).

settings.name: distributorOnboard
settings.description:
This setting is used to enable stage-wise distributor onboarding as below.
{"enable":0,"maxApprover":5, "finalreject":0, "allowdirectaddition":"1,2,3"}
Where,
enable values can be 0,1
0 - Stage-wise distributor onboarding will be disabled.
1 - Enables stage-wise distributor onboarding.
maxApprover values can be 0,1,2... Defines the maximum number of approval levels in the workflow.
finalreject values can be 0,1
0 - A higher-level approver can override the rejection made at a lower level.
1 - Rejection by any approver will be treated as final, and the distributor will be rejected.
allowdirectaddition accept comma-separated designation IDs
It allows adding distributors to designations even if the distributor onboard configuration (/approvalConfigurations/distributoronboardconfig) is not set for requester for stage 1. it will be considered approved by default and will not go through any further stages.

settings.name: whatsapp_support_business_screens
settings.description:
This setting controls whether the WhatsApp icon is shown on the outlet and distributor info screens in the app. It only applies to the app. Supported values:
0 - WhatsApp icon is enabled on both distributor and outlet info screens (default).
1 - WhatsApp icon is hidden on both distributor and outlet info screens.
2 - WhatsApp icon is hidden only on distributor info screen.
3 - WhatsApp icon is hidden only on outlet info screen.

settings.name: damageClaimDiscountEnabled
settings.description: This setting is used for enabling or disabling discount in damage claim amount calculation. If set to 1, discount will considered in calculation. If set to 0, discount will not be considered. Default value is 1

settings.name: guidedloadin
settings.description: If the value is 0: The "Settled Quantity" field will be blank. Users must manually enter the settlement quantity for each SKU. If the value is 1: The "Settled Quantity" field will be auto-filled using the following formula: Loadout Quantity âˆ’ Sale + Sale Return

settings.name: assetloccapture
settings.description: This is a company-level setting that controls whether salesmen are allowed to save asset audits without capturing location.By default, the value is 0. If set to 1, capturing location becomes mandatory at the time of audit.Note: This setting is applicable only on the mobile app

settings.name: autoReturnwithInvoice
settings.description: If this setting is enabled (value set to 1), the Auto Return with Invoice feature will be activated. This will add a new tab where users can enter SKU-wise quantity, and the corresponding invoice quantities will be auto-populated. By default, the feature is disabled (value set to 0)

settings.name: autoLastnDayInvoicesInReturn
settings.description: If a value is set, it will be used as the limit for the number of invoices shown in the popup for the Auto Return with Invoice feature. This setting is applicable only if the autoReturnwithInvoice feature is enabled. If set to 0 (or left unset), the system will consider invoices up to 90 days old by default.

settings.name: Employeeidregex
settings.description: This setting is used to validate employee id while adding/editing users. Its value should be regular expression that should validate the employee id.

settings.name: Roundoff_all_transaction
settings.description:
This is a company and distributor-wise setting. The allowed values are 0, 1 and 2 and the default value is 0.
0 (default) - Disabled. No rounding is applied.
1 - If enabled, all transactions (invoices, returns, scheme reversal amount, credit and debit notes) created for the distributor will be rounded off to the nearest whole number even if a decimal value is entered.
2 - All transactions are rounded to the nearest cash denomination for the country the company operates in (e.g. nearest 5 sen for Malaysia), applied company-wide regardless of distributor role.

settings.name: servicetaxonaddionaltax
settings.description:
Service tax will be applied on the additional tax, and this applies only to primary orders and sales when the additional_tax_on_primarypurchase setting is enabled.
Supported values are 0 and >0, where 0 means no service tax is applied. Enter the service tax percentage in this setting, and it will be applied accordingly on primary orders and sales. We can rename (alias) the field name, but making other fields editable or required is not supported.

settings.name: locationBasedOptimisation
settings.description: This setting will have 2 values, 0 and 1. If value is 1 then user will get tab at beatview for nearest outlets based on current location

settings.name: enableTjp
settings.description: This is a user/role/designation-level setting that determines which users can be assigned to Temporary Journey Plans (TJP). By default, it is set to 0 (disabled). When set to 1 (enabled), it allows temporary beats to be assigned to users with specified start and end dates (the start and end dates define the duration of the temporary beat assigned to user). These temporary assignments will expire once the end date is reached.

settings.name: OneDistributorOneSalesman
settings.description: This is a warehouse type level  setting. By default, it is disabled value = 0. If setting is disabled than one distributor can be mapped to multiple salesman or distributor salesman. Making value to 1 will enable the setting. If setting is enabeled than one distributor can only be mapped to one salesman or distributor salesman.

settings.name: OneSalesmanOneDistributor
settings.description: This is a Role / Designation / User  level  setting. By default, setting is disabled value = 0. If it is disabled than one salesman or distributor salesman can be mapped to multiple distributor. Making value to 1 will enable the setting. If setting is enabeled than one salesman or distributor salesman  can only be mapped to one distributor.

settings.name: custom_smart_asset_logic
settings.description: This is a company level setting. Default value is 0. Setting is made for mobile app. 0 - calculation for KPI will be sku detected in KPI category / total my sku facings. 1 - Calculation of KPI will be sku detected in KPI / (own sku detected in KPI + comp sku detected in KPI). Default value 0.

settings.name: userwisebillsequence
settings.description: This setting allows bill number sequences (like Invoice, Sale Return, Credit Note, Debit Note, and Collection) to be maintained at the user level instead of the distributor or warehouse level. It is useful for generating unique bill numbers per user and is mainly applicable to roles like Distributor Salesman. The supported values are: 0 (Disabled - default), 1 (Userwise Invoice Number), 2 (Userwise Sale Return Number), 3 (Userwise Credit Note Number), 4 (Userwise Debit Note Number), and 5 (Userwise Collection Number). Multiple values can be enabled together and should be stored as comma-separated values (e.g., 1,2,3). When enabled for a user role, filling bill sequence details becomes mandatory during user creation or editing. If not configured, the system will fall back to the bill sequence defined at the distributor or warehouse level. This will not be supported for role id 3 & 6.

settings.name: jointWorkingDistance
settings.description: This value in meters is used to set the allowed distance between two users for joint working, if the value is less than 20 meters, it means Joint Working is not enabled for that company.

settings.name: configurechequeandonlineCollectionfields
settings.description: Supported values are 0 and 1. 0 â€“ Uses the default configuration; customization is not supported. 1 â€“ Allows field-level configuration, including: Modifying UI field aliases, Defining field sequence, Marking fields as mandatory.
