Configuration can be managed via Settings â†’ Form Settings â†’ Basic Collection Form. All changes apply to both the app and the web where collections are submitted. Note: Customization is available only for Cheque and Online payment modes. Certain fields, such as Cheque Number and Transaction ID, are always mandatory and cannot be modified.

settings.name: onlinetransactionnoregex
settings.description: Default value [a-zA-Z0-9]{1,50}. This setting supports regex value.This setting is warehousewise

settings.name: newtaskassigner
settings.description: This is a user-level setting which is used to assign tasks by a manager to their reporting users and is used on the Bizom Next app only. (This depends on the kmmtourprogram setting and applies to the task module in the tour program). Possible values: 0 or 1. Default is 0. If value is 1, the manager can assign tasks to users under him.

settings.name: kmmTourProgram
settings.description: This is a company-level setting used exclusively by companies utilizing Bizom-Next. It has two possible values: 0 or 1 (The default value is 0). When set to 1, the Tour Program feature will be enabled for Bizom-Next. Enable this setting to use Tour Program in Bizom Next app. Along with this, enable Newtaskmodule, Tourprogram, autotaskassignmentapproval, tourProgramWithoutBudget, tourProgramWithoutBudgetCalendarMonthLimitInSFA, set app tab sequence, and enable task user workflows. Newtaskassigner & Newtaskstatus setting can be used to enable additional features.

settings.name: newtaskstatus
settings.description: This user-level setting controls task submission behavior on the BizomNext app when `kmmTourProgram` is enabled. If value is 0: only "Submit" is shown. If 1: "Submit" and "Follow-up" are available. If 2: "Submit", "Solve", and "Follow-up" are available.

settings.name: hideloadoutstock
settings.description: Controls the visibility of stock availability field in loadout request screen on mobile app. Default value is 0 (show stock). When set to 1, the stock availability field will be hidden for users.

settings.name: merchandising_category_mode
settings.description:
Configuration to control the category dropdown mode in IR Merchandising.

Possible values:
0 - All SKUs only (default)
1 - Category-wise only

This setting ensures the dropdown shows only the selected mode, aligning with partner data.

settings.name: EnableBluetoothLaodoutDIG
settings.description: If you want to use Bluetooth Loadout DIG, set it to 1 for active and 0 for inactive.

settings.name: EnableBluetoothSaleReturnDIG
settings.description: If you want to use Bluetooth Sale-Return DIG, set it to 1 for active and 0 for inactive.

settings.name: EnableBluetoothCollectionDIG
settings.description: If you want to use Bluetooth Collection DIG, set it to 1 for active and 0 for inactive.

settings.name: hideLoadOutSchedule
settings.description: default value of 0,  If the value is 1, then the Schedule option will be disabled for the app user. User can only add loadouts for the current date and option to schedule loadout for future dates will be removed from app, only for app

settings.name: direct_task_execution
settings.description: This setting controls direct task execution. Allowed values are 0, 1 and 2. 0 keeps it disabled, 1 allows direct execution , and 2 allows an adhoc direct execution that overrides the configured rules whether or not any rules are set.

settings.name: enableOneTapOnStartCall
settings.description: Default value 0. If set to 1, show One Tap View in app when user navigates to Call Outlet screen.

settings.name: enableSaleProductivityData
settings.description: Default value 0. If set to 1, Last three months average sale (L3M), Productivity data will be shown in outlet info(app).

settings.name: agentsWeb
settings.description: This setting is used in the web application.0 indicates that the Web Agent is Disabled.1  menase enabled in web

settings.name: newvariablediscount
settings.description: This setting will be used to calculate vriable discount on total order value

settings.name: BizomNextSKUFilter
settings.description:
This setting is a json setting used to configure the filters and SKU type in Bizom Next app only. The SKU Type and Filters can be configured as filled in the json.
By Default this setting will be disabled and the setting skuappfilter will be considered.
Default json will be :
{ "enable": "0" , "SkuType": [ "all sku", "focus sku", "msl", "rest sku", "frequently ordered" ], "Filters": [ "brand", "subbrand", "category", "subcategory", "variant", "size" ] }
To enable this setting, set the "enable" value to "1" and enter the SKU Types and Filters as required. Once enabled, the SKU Types and Filters will appear in the exact order they are defined in the JSON. Once this setting is enabled and configured the setting skuappfilter will not be valid in Bizom Next.

settings.name: AttendanceFaceRecognition
settings.description:
This setting will have 3 possible values: 0 or 1 or 2.
By default the setting will have value 0.
Here there will be no face recognition happening in the attendance image capture screen.

When the setting value is 1, system will work as below:
Face recognition will work with the red & green circle logic if face is detected or not.
Users will be able to submit the attendance image irrespective of if the face is detected or not.

When the setting value is 2, system will work as below:
Face recognition will work with the red & green circle logic if face is detected or not.
Users will be able to submit the attendance image only if the face is detected.

settings.name: Bluetooth_DIG_Configuration
settings.description: This configuration is used to control Bluetooth DIG printing behavior for Sale, Return, Collection, and Loadout modules. When the isCollectionSeparate key is set to true, collections will appear individually; when set to false, all collections will be combined and displayed within the same template. Additionally, it provides options to configure printer sizes 2-inch printers (32 characters per line) and 3-inch printers (46 characters per line), ensuring accurate and properly aligned invoice print layouts.

settings.name: dateselectioninloadout
settings.description:
Defines the maximum number of days from the current date that a user can select in the Loadout & submit the loadout requests.
If set to 0, users can raise a loadout request only for the current date.
This setting applies to the app. Default Value is 90

settings.name: is_grn_allowed
settings.description: This setting is used to bypass the GRN check for the user. If it is set to 1, the GRN check will be bypassed for specific customergroups which can be seen from /customergroups url

settings.name: showPONumber
settings.description: Enable PO Number field support in BizomNext. Can have values 0 (default, disabled) and 1 (enabled)

settings.name: validate_serialnumber_in_GRN
settings.description:
Value - 0 (Default): System enforces serial number validation (scan or type manual entry) during GRN acceptance.
    Value - 1: Serial number validation (scan or type ) is non-mandatory.
    Distributors can accept primary GRN without scanning or type serial numbers on the "/inventories/transferhistory" page only.

settings.name: updateInventoryFromBillToShipToOutlet
settings.description:
This is a company-level setting that supports values 0 and 1 (default is 1).
If the setting value is 0, inventory will be updated from the bill to the outlet.
If the setting value is 1, then during a primary sale return with an invoice, the stock will be considered from the shipping_outlet_id, provided that shipping_outlet_id is not equal to outlet_id.

settings.name: enhancededitapproval
settings.description: Enabling this setting will support the edit outlet approval and outlet add approval, approver list will select based on the defined outlet values. when this setting enable then editapproval and enableMultilevelApprovalInOutletEdit setting must enable. Default value is 0.

settings.name: mdmschedulermaxday
settings.description: set max day for schedule an mdm, minimum it should be 2, if set below 2 then by default consider it as 2

settings.name: Asset_image_validation
settings.description:
For this setting to work multiple asset image validation needs to be enabled
Value 0 - disable (default)
Value 1 - Enabled with soft block (allows salesman to do asset audit even if validation fails) (Asset audit is available in offline mode)
Value 2 - Enable with hard block (prevents salesman from doing asset audit if validation fails) (Asset audit not available in offline mode as Image validation cannot happen in offline)

settings.name: Mutiple_asset_image
settings.description:
For this to work asset image validation setting needs to be enabled
Value 0 - disable (default)
Value 1 - Enables to store multiple reference images for the same asset.

settings.name: enable_insights
settings.description: This setting is supported in both App and Web.If this setting is enabled, we provide the insights feature. Set it to 1 to enable and 0 to disable.

settings.name: skipassetredeploymentrestriction
settings.description: Default value 0, supported value 0 and 1. If the value of the setting is set to 1 then the asset can be redeployed from any outlet to any outlet which is tagged to the user with rulesets. If set to 2, then the asset can be redeployed from any outlet to any outlet without any rulesets.

settings.name: allowassetrejectionafterapproval
settings.description: default value 0, supported value 0 and 1. users will have the access to change the asset order quantity in the asset order approval screen in web . The user shouldn't have the access to update the asset order quantity once at least one serial number has been registered at the outlet

settings.name: Sale_Bypass
settings.description: This setting will be used to bypass the validation error for user ids mapped to warehouse in MDM

settings.name: enableFindBestSalesmanForBeat
settings.description:
This is a user-level setting that controls the access to the Find Best Salesman for Beat feature.
    0 - Access not allowed
    1 - Access allowed
    The default value is 0.

settings.name: AllowUserToChangeTheClaimStatus
settings.description:
This setting can have four possible values: 0, 1, 2, or 3.
By default, the setting value is 0.

If the setting value is 0, the user will not be able to change the claim status.
If the setting value is 1, the user can reject approved claims at any level.
If the setting value is 2, the user can revert rejected claims back to their previous status.
If the setting value is 3, the user can perform both actions.

settings.name: BeatLevelDashboardConfig
settings.description:
This setting is for new beatlevel targets and achievements logic.This is a json setting.
Json structure - {"enable":"","gap_target_percetage":"","gsv_achievement_value":"","exception_subzone":{"id":"","subzone_gsv_achievement_value":""}}
Default value is {"enable":"0","gap_target_percetage":"55","gsv_achievement_value":"250","exception_subzone":{"id":"33","subzone_gsv_achievement_value":"300"}}.
"enable" key is used to enable or disable the setting (1 or 0 respectively).
"gap_target_percetage" this percentage value is used for calculating GAP target.
"gsv_achievement_value" this value is used to check minimum gsv value for a productive call.

settings.name: Handsfree
settings.description:
This setting is for only Bizom next SFA users.
Controls voice capture and actions in SFA.

0: Disable (default value)
1: Detect and add SKU with quantity for order/sale through voice capture of sales executive
2: Displays key points missed by sale executive in order summary screen and enforces user to cover the pitch gaps
3: Both add SKU and pitch correction are enabled

settings.name: portalAccessManagement
settings.description: This setting allows control over where a user can log in across all environments. Supported values are 0 (restricted) and 1 (allowed). Configure as WEB:0, APP:1, API:0, REPORT:1 without spaces. The setting is not supported at the company level. App access should not be enabled for Admin and Zone Manager roles. API access is allowed only for the Admin role. WEB access applies to domain.bizom.in, APP access applies to Bizom Android, Next, and iOS, API access applies to integration GET and POST APIs, and REPORT access applies to reports.bizom.in and reports.bizom.app.

settings.name: EnableMultipleCreditlimits
settings.description: Only buyers (distributors) with outlet_level = credit, will have their credit limits checked. If the credit limit type is not selected for a credit outlet, an error will be thrown while placing the order. When enabled to 2- The system checks for an active credit limit for the buyer (distributor). If no active credit limit is found, the buyer (distributor) is blocked from placing orders. When enabled to 3- The system checks for an active credit limit for the buyer (distributor); if none exists for the specific seller, it falls back to a credit limit configured for the buyer (distributor) against any seller (fromoutlet_id/fromwarehouse_id left blank). If neither is found, the buyer (distributor) is blocked from placing orders.

settings.name: IsParallelDotsCameraTiltRestricted
settings.description:
When setting is set to 1 , camera Tilt is restricted at 15 degree for all merchandising related activity(planogram , smart asset,pricing ) s.
When this setting is set to 0 , there will be no tilt detection and user will be able to click an image in any orientation

settings.name: SetParallelDotsCameraOrientation
settings.description: Specifies the camera orientation mode used during capture in ParallelDots. It accepts three values: 1 for Portrait (default), 2 for Landscape, and 3 for selecting the orientation dynamically at runtime based on the device orientation or app flow. This setting allows you to control how the camera aligns during scanning depending on your UI requirement.

settings.name: real_time_suggested_order_primary
settings.description: Default value 0. If set to 1, RTSOP will work based on the current inventory level of the distributor and the inventory norms set for the distributor. Applicable for Bizom Next App only.

settings.name: free_sku_scheme_budget
settings.description: This setting is to enable/disable free sku limit on schemes which give free skus , limit is configured on both schemegroup as well as distributor level , value 1 is to enable this feature

settings.name: outletconsentformsetting
settings.description: This company-level setting to enable outlet consent form

settings.name: abbreviatedInputTitle
settings.description:
Updated description: This setting is supported in the Bizom Next app with values 0 and 1, where the default configuration is 1.
Value = 0: Full titles will be displayed for input fields such as Case, Unit, and Unit Case across the app.
Value = 1: Abbreviated titles will be displayed for these input fields (e.g., CE, UT, UE) across the app.

settings.name: allowEWayBillGenerationWithoutTransporter
settings.description: Default value is 0, when setting value is 1 then transporter details optional during e-Way Bill generation.

settings.name: tasks_visit_control
settings.description:
This is a User/Role/Designation level setting. It controls whether the visit button for Outlet and Distributor visits is displayed on the Weekly Calendar screen for different task types of the Tour Program.

The value is a JSON configuration with the following options:
- "outlet_visit": Default value is 1 ,when enabled visit button for Outlet visits will be enabled; if 0, it will be hidden. (Example: "outlet_visit": 0)
- "distributor_visit": Default value is 1 ,when enabled visit button for Distributor visits will be enabled; if 0, it will be hidden. (Example: "distributor_visit": 0)
- "remove_beat_restriction": Default value is 0 ,when enabled the restriction requiring the outlet to be in the user's beat is removed. (Example: "remove_beat_restriction": 0)

Example JSON Configuration:
    {
        "outlet_visit": 0,
        "distributor_visit": 0,
        "remove_beat_restriction": 0
    }

In this example, both the Outlet and Distributor visit buttons are hidden, and the beat restriction is still enforced. Modify these values as needed based on user roles or designations.

settings.name: targetVsAchievementVisibility
settings.description:
This is a User/Role/Designation level setting. It controls the visibility of the Target vs Achievement field on Tour Program Execute Task cards for different task types.

The value is a JSON configuration with the following options:
- "outlet_visit": Controls visibility of the Target vs Achievement field for Outlet Visit tasks.
- "distributor_visit": Controls visibility of the Target vs Achievement field for Distributor Visit tasks.
- "joint_working": Controls visibility of the Target vs Achievement field for Joint Working tasks.
- "joint_work_without_validation": Controls visibility of the Target vs Achievement field for Joint Work Without Validation tasks.

The possible values are:
- 0: Hide the field.
- 1: Show the field only if an active target exists on the planned date.
- 2: Always show the field, even if no active target exists.

Example JSON Configuration:
    {
        "outlet_visit": 1,
        "distributor_visit": 2,
        "joint_working": 0,
        "joint_work_without_validation": 1
    }

In this example, the Target vs Achievement field will be shown for Outlet and Joint Work Without Validation tasks only if an active target exists, while it will always be shown for Distributor Visit tasks, and hidden for Joint Working tasks.

settings.name: bizomNextTourProgramRules
settings.description: Supported values are 0 & 1. This is a user-level setting that allows users to add tasks only if defined rules exist. If no rules are set, users can add tasks. If this setting is 1, rule engine created for the designation will be applicable to the user's designation. If setting is 0, rule engine will not work for the user. Note: Applies only to Bizom Next Tour Program.

settings.name: bizomNextTaskApprover
settings.description:
This setting allows users to view and approve Tour Plans in the Bizom Next app. excepted value are 0,1
0 - Disable
1 - Enable
Note: Setting will work along with tour_program_task_approval apptabsequence.

settings.name: Distributorassetsflow
settings.description: By default value is 0. The values supported in this setting are assetorder,assetregister,assetderegister,assetredeployment, assetaudit. Dependent on the flows added in the setting, the user will be able to perform the activities at the distributor

settings.name: restrictassetmgtflow
settings.description: By default value is 0. The setting values supported are the warehousetype ids. For the warehouse type ids added in the setting, the users will be restricted to perform asset activities at those distributors.

settings.name: DaySummaryDashboardPJP
settings.description: This is a User/Role/Designation level setting. This setting can have values 0 or 1. The default value is 0. When value is 1, the Today's summary dashboard will be shown in the PJP screen. This dashboard will contain info on calls done by the user, sale return done today. If the value is 0, Today's Summary screen will not be displayed.

settings.name: MTDAvgSalesPJP
settings.description: This is a User/Role/Designation level setting. This setting can have values 0 or 1. The default value is 0. When value is 1, MTD AVG sales will be shown against the outlet in the PJP screen. If the value is 0, MTD AVG sales will not be displayed against the outlet in the PJP screen.

settings.name: HistoricalsalesInsightsOutletInfo
settings.description: This is a User/Role/Designation level setting. This setting can have values 0 or 1. The default value is 0. When value is 1, The insights dashboard will be shown in the outlet info screen. The dashboard will contain details on Avg/MTD sales, Avg/MTD lines, Target/MTD SKU Focus, and Target/MTD MSL details. If the value is 0, these details will not be displayed in the outlet info screen.

settings.name: OutletPjpFlowON
settings.description:
Supported values - 0 & 1
0 - Disabled, the functionality will not be supported
1 - if Enable, will display "-" for non-pjp outlets after order fullfillment in payment screen under PJP Outlet column.

Note - this functionality will work only for the payments for which created_by_userid and user_id are same.

settings.name: OkayaflowonSN
settings.description:
Main & Sub module - Order Fulfillment & Sale
Supported values - 0 & 1
0 - Disabled, the functionality will not be supported
1 - Enable, will have access to select the serial numbers manually based on the selected manufacturing date

Note - Enable Serialization setting, the flow will not be supported if it is disabled.

settings.name: retailersuggestedorder
settings.description:
Supported values - 0 & 1
When 1 is chosen then suggested order for retailer app will be enabled.The Smart cart will be displayed on the retailer app when this setting value is 1.This should only work when retailer app is enabled for the company. By Default the value for this setting will be 0, when the setting value is 0 the suggested order for retailer app will disabled.

settings.name: RetailerSuggestions
settings.description:
Supported values - 0, 1, 2
This setting will be a company wide setting. Multiple values can be chosen. As per chosen values the flows New Arrivals and Popular SKUs will be enabled.
By Default the value of the setting will be 0. No Suggestions will be shown.
When value is 1, The Smart cart will contain the regular suggested order.
When 2 is selected then the "Newly Launched SKUs" flow will be enabled in the smart cart and the New tag will be against the SKU in the products screen.
When 3 is selected then "Popular Around You" flow will be enabled in the smart cart and the Ã¢â‚¬Å“PopularÃ¢â‚¬Â tag will be against the SKU in the products screen.
When 4 is selected then "Favourite SKUs" configured by the retailer will be shown in the smart cart.
NOTE: This setting is dependent on retailersuggestedorder, If setting value is 1 only then this setting will be enabled.

settings.name: EnableCustomOrderDraft
settings.description: If you want to use custom order draft feature you need to add 1 for active and 0 for default order draft pdf generation

settings.name: hideSwitchIcon
settings.description: This setting is used show/hide the new and old UI toggle switch (0 => hide, 1 => show)

settings.name: EnforceKYCValidation
settings.description:
This setting enforces KYC validation. It controls the behavior of KYC fields during the start call. 

Value 0: Pop-cancelable - If KYC fields are not filled, a pop-up notification will be shown to the user during the start call at an outlet/distributor, but the user can proceed with the start call.

Value 1: Compulsory - If KYC fields are not filled, the user will see a pop-up and be redirected to the outlet edit screen to update the KYC details, provided the user has the "edit outlet" workflow enabled. If the workflow is not enabled, the user stays on the current screen. In either case, the user cannot proceed with the start call until the KYC details are updated and approved.

settings.name: newKycModule
settings.description: This is a company-level setting. Accepted values: 0 or 1. Default value of this setting is 0. When enabled, the new KYC module linked to document types will be activated and the old module will be ignored.

settings.name: conditional_grn
settings.description: Controls GRN approval based on the customer_group passed in the salesreturns/addSaleReturn integration API (allowed groups are viewable at /customergroups). 0 = GRN approval button visible for all invoices. 1 = GRN approval button visible only for allowed customer_groups, and inventory is added to the buyer after GRN approval. 2 = GRN approval button visible for all invoices, but inventory is added to the buyer after GRN approval only for allowed customer_groups.

settings.name: Fulfillspecialorderswithoutpricechange
settings.description:
This is a company wise setting. Supported value - 0,1.
When setting value is 0 = The price may change when a special order is fulfilled.(As per the user requirement).
When setting value is 1= The special order is fulfilled at the same price as the original order approved, with no price changes irrespective of the batch change for the sku.

settings.name: islocaldatetime
settings.description: The default value is 0. Value can be 0 or 1. If value is set to be 0 then datetime will have normal format, and when value is set to 1 then the format of datetime will get change to local date time as per countrys datetime format.

settings.name: enablefetchcreditnotes
settings.description: Default value is 0. If the value is 1, then in the app after call add api , additional api will call to get the payment creditnotes.

settings.name: formatAmountConfig
settings.description: Controls how amounts are displayed by defining the symbols used for thousand and decimal separation. This company-level setting applies across Bizom Web and Bizom Next and is independent of device language and country.

settings.name: Offlinesupportinapp
settings.description:
0 indicates the current flow
2 - Indicate the offline support for Direct sale
4 - Indicate the offline support for Collection
5 -  Indicate the offline support for Sale return,
This setting supports multiple values comman separated ex:- 2,4 [Direct sale , Collection]

settings.name: buyerspecificcollectionmodes
settings.description: An additional configuration option will be available on the Add and Edit screens, enabling users to select collection modes. By default, collection modes are displayed based on the payment modes and collection submodes settings. 0 - disabled, buyer-level collection modes cannot be configured. Setting value 1 allows configuration of collection mode configuration is available for warehouse, distributor & outlets. Note: Please enable the collectionmodes field using formdefintion in add & edit screens.

settings.name: priceperunitretailer
settings.description:
This setting is only valid for retailer app, the retailer app needs to be enabled at the company. By Default the value will be 0. When the value is 0,Both price and MRP of the SKU will be displayed. When the value is 1 , only the SKU price will be displayed. When the value is 2 , only the SKU MRP will be displayed.
. When the value is 3 , No Price will be displayed against the SKU. The price will be shown in the order screen.

settings.name: unifiedLogout
settings.description: The default value is 0. When set to 1, if the user logs out from any platform (web or app), they will automatically be logged out from all other platforms as well.

settings.name: showCompanyVersion
settings.description:
Controls the visibility of the web version in the page footer alongside the last login timestamp.
Default Value: 0 (Hidden)
Options:
0 - Release version is hidden from the footer
1 - Release version is visible in the footer
Note: This is a company-level setting that applies to all users within the organization.

settings.name: PerfectCallValidation
settings.description: Enables validation of call performance based on predefined KPIs to assess whether the call meets â€˜Perfect Callâ€™ criteria.

settings.name: beatPlanningParameters
settings.description: This is a JSON-based configuration used for beat visit optimization that defines key constraints: timeSpendOnOutlet (average visit time per outlet in minutes), and speed (average travel speed in km/hr used to estimate movement time between outlets).

settings.name: loadoutrequestdefaultday
settings.description: This is a user-level setting that accepts any non-negative integer value (default is 0). If the setting value is 0, the loadout request date will default to the current day. If the value is greater than 0, the system will pick the value and accordingly the default loadout request date will be set.

settings.name: suggestedordervariant
settings.description: Suggested orders flow for model to train on orders instead of sales

settings.name: isSetPaymentDetailMRPEnabled
settings.description: default value 0, supported value 0 and 1.If the value of the setting  is set to 1 then during primary sale, warehouseskunit mrp will be saved instead of skunit mrp

settings.name: changepasswordnotification
settings.description: This setting is used to configure the number of days before password expiry date which is specified in setting password_ageing_days , the notification/alert for password expire should be displayed on first login of the day , This setting is dependent on the setting password_ageing_days

settings.name: passwordresetlock
settings.description: This setting is used to block password reset for 24 hours after password change

settings.name: Progressivelockout
settings.description: This is  a company level setting, used to progressively block a user for n minutes after n incorrect tries , but after 10th try blocks the user will be blocked

settings.name: unblockuser
settings.description: This setting is to unblock users which have been blocked because of 10 invalid login attempts according to setting Progressivelockout, this enables reporting manager to have option of getting a button which can unblock its reportee users.

settings.name: accountExpiryDays
settings.description: This setting defines the maximum number of consecutive days a user can go without logging into Bizom

settings.name: EnableManualAssetVerification
settings.description: If the setting value is 1, the user will get an option to skip the QR code scanning OR serial number while doing asset audit from appside.

settings.name: orderconstraints
settings.description: This is a company wise setting. Supported value - 0 and 1. Default value is 0. When setting value is 0 then Order constraint will only be supported for order screen. When setting value is 1 then Order constraint will be supported on both direct sale and order screen in Bizom Next app.

settings.name: attendanceFaceVerification
settings.description: This is user level setting. By default, it is set to 0. When enabled, users can upload their images. If enabled, the web interface also allows images to be uploaded for any user. Once images are uploaded, the system will compare the captured image during attendance marking with the stored profile images. If there is no match, users will be prompted to upload their image up to three times. If there is still no match after three attempts, the attendance submission will be rejected. If the image matches any of the uploaded profile images, attendance will be successfully submitted and a confirmation message will be shown.

settings.name: encryptS3Url
settings.description: This setting supports values 0 and 1: If value is set to 0 means the setting is disabled. If value is set to 1 means the setting is enabled.When enabled, the S3 URL will be encrypted and converted to a private URL. Only authorized users will be able to access the encrypted URL. For now this setting has supported only screen activityformdatas/activityformreport , companies/dashboard and genericformdatas/genericformreport.

settings.name: allowHqTransferBetweenRoles
settings.description: By default, the setting value will be 0, in which case headquarters transfer will follow the existing functionality and will be allowed only between users having the same role. If the setting value is set to 1, headquarters transfer will be allowed between users having different roles, and users without any role assigned will also be considered for the transfer.

settings.name: enableschemeautoadjust
settings.description: Default value of the setting is 0, if the setting value is 0, schemes must be removed manually when free product stock is unavailable.If the setting value is 1, the scheme will be automatically removed from the sale based on the available free SKU quantity.

settings.name: AutoSplitOrder
settings.description: When the value is set to 1, SKUs from up to 5 distributors mapped to the buyer warehouse are shown in a single primary order, and after submission the order is automatically split into separate orders for each distributor. The default value is 0.

settings.name: inactivationCheckOnModule
settings.description: Default value 0. If set to 1, Then we will check the pending action items on entities in module wise and throw pop up on making inactive module screen with data on entities which action needs to be done before making the inactive. ex: On inactivating user we will check all the pending action items and will displayed on the pop up screen on edit when user is getting deactivated.

settings.name: LeadingZerosInBill
settings.description:
Controls whether bill and document sequence numbers should preserve leading zeros. 
Value 1: Leading zeros are enabled (e.g., 0009 â†’ 0010). 
Value 0: Leading zeros are disabled and sequence numbers are treated as plain integers (e.g., 9 â†’ 10).

settings.name: billFromAndShipFromInPrimaryReturns
settings.description: Controls bill-from and ship-from behavior in primary returns. 0 (Default): Existing behavior. 1: Invoice-based returns including sellerâ€“buyer and child invoices; inventory and ledger updated for seller warehouse only. 2: Same as 1, but inventory updated for ship-from location; credit note based on seller, and ship-from selectable for non-invoice returns.

settings.name: disableDeliveryReturn
settings.description: If value is 1, it will disable secondary GRN returns for users in app. Default value is 0.

settings.name: separateReturnStockFromVanInventory
settings.description: When enabled (1), stock received via secondary GRN returns on a loadsheet is isolated and cannot be used by the van user for subsequent sales.

settings.name: arsOrderDateHolidayAdjustment
settings.description: Default value 0. Enabling this setting creates ARS order before or after the holiday(prepone or postpone). 1 - ARS order will be created on previous non-route day just before holiday, 2 -  ARS order will be created on next non-route day after holiday. Route days are considered from the values defined in arsOrderDays setting.

settings.name: retailer_exclusive_sku_categories
settings.description: This setting is applicable across Retailer App. The default value is 0, which means no SKU unit categories are treated as exclusive (special). A value of -1 indicates that all SKU unit categories are treated as exclusive types.If a comma-separated list of category IDs is provided (e.g., 1 or 1,2), only those specified SKU unit categories are allowed within a single order.All other SKU unit categories will be restricted and cannot be added to the cart or included in the same order.

settings.name: retailer_exclusive_outlettype
settings.description: This setting is applicable across Retailer App, Bizom Next, and Bizom Web. The default value is 0, which means no specific outlet type is marked as exclusive and the behavior applies uniformly across all outlet types. A value of -1 indicates that all outlet types are treated as exclusive outlets. If a comma-separated list of outlet type IDs is provided (e.g., 1 or 1,2), only those specified outlet types will be treated as exclusive (special) outlets.All other outlet types will be treated as non-exclusive. Note: This setting works with retailer_exclusive_sku_categories.

settings.name: MandateInventoryaudit
settings.description:
This setting supported at company, warehouse, distributor. Supported value - 0 and 1.
Default value of the setting is 0.
If the value of the setting is 1, in the mobile application>> stock at warehouse screen>> distributor.
scenario 1: If the user didnt do inventory audit and if the user is clicking on start call, the system should show a message "Stock Audit is compulsory to start call". And once the stock audit is completed at the distributor for atleast 1 sku, the user should be able to start the call at the distributor. This functionality and the pop up should work only if the setting "MandateInventoryaudit" is enabled.
Scenario 2: If the user had completed inventory audit on that day, the user will be allowed to do either one call or multiple calls on that day

settings.name: outletFinalReject
settings.description:
Possible values are 0 and 1.By default, the setting value will be 1, and the existing flow will work as it is, where rejection by any approver in the outlet approval workflow will be treated as final and the outlet will be permanently rejected. If the setting value is set to 0, rejection by a lower-level approver can be overridden by a higher-level approver.

Note: If this setting value is set to 0, Bizom Next App approvals are not supported. In this case, only web-based approval must be configured and used by the company.

settings.name: RestrictBillingDaysForNonKYCOutlets
settings.description: This is a company-level setting. By default, it is set to 0. When enabled, this setting allows transactions for KYC-unapproved outlets (new KYC module) based on the unapproved billing days configured in the outlet type. This setting is dependent on the editapproval and newKycModule setting.

settings.name: issalereturncustomized
settings.description: This company-level setting which is being developed to enable custom return form. Default value is 0 (disabled). If it is set to 1, then user will be able to fill primary salereturn form, If set to 2, then user will be able to fill secondary salereturn form, and If set to 3 , then the user will be able to fill both the forms.

settings.name: ipAddressVerification
settings.description:
This setting controls whether user login should be restricted based on a pre-configured IP address.
The allowed IP address must be configured in the ipaddressconfig setting.
If IP restriction is enabled and the user attempts to log in from an IP address that does not match the value configured in ipaddressconfig, the login will be blocked.
Supported values:
0 - Disabled
IP restriction is not applied. Users can log in from any IP address.
1 - Enabled for both Web & App
Login is allowed only from the IP address configured in ipaddressconfig for both Web and App.
2 - Enabled for Web only
IP restriction applies only to Web login. App login is not restricted.
3 - Enabled for App only
IP restriction applies only to App login. Web login is not restricted.

settings.name: ipAddressRegex
settings.description: This setting is used to validate the IP address format. By default, the format is IPv4. Supported values are IPv4 and IPv6. For any custom regex, please reach out to the R&D team. This setting is applicable only when the "ipaddressverification" setting is enabled and helps configure IP address formats as per client requirements.

settings.name: ipAddressConfig
settings.description: This setting is supported user,designation,role and company level. It is recommended to configure the IP address at the user level, as users with the same designation or role may have different IP addresses. Multiple IP addresses are supported and should be entered as comma-separated values, without any spaces. Note: 1.Do not enable this setting for Bizom team logins (e.g., Integration login, L1/L2 resource logins), as they use Bizom/Vendor company internet. 2.Cross-check whether the users work in the markets. If yes, obtain confirmation from the client before enabling. 3.If applied to such users, login access will be completely restricted until their IP address matches the configured values. Please enable the setting â€œipaddressverification"

settings.name: ipAddressAttempts
settings.description: This setting defines the number of times a user can attempt to log in. If the login attempts exceed the configured limit, the user will be blocked as per the duration specified in the â€˜userBlockTimeâ€™ setting. This feature is supported only when the "ipaddressverification" setting is enabled.

settings.name: DaterangeinBUmapping
settings.description:
Default value: 0 (Disabled)
When this setting is set to 1 (Enabled), users can select a date range while mapping a user to BU.
If the setting remains 0, date selection input  will not show. it will used at the time of BU mapping from web

settings.name: LimitDateRange
settings.description:
Default Value: 0
When this setting is enabled (1), the date range selection will be restricted to the current Financial Year only (e.g., 01/04/2025 to 31/03/2026).
When the setting is disabled (0), users can select any date range without Financial Year restrictions.
Dependency:
This setting works only when DaterangeinBUmapping is enabled (1).
Impact:
When enabled, it restricts the date range selection while assigning a user to BU (Business Unit) mapping.

settings.name: SaleReturnForAllSku
settings.description:
Default Value: 0
Applicable For: Mobile App Only
Description:
When this setting is enabled (1), Sale and Order data will be fetched based on the user's BU mapping validity period (fromdate and todate, i.e., BU expiry date range).
When disabled (0), Sale and Order data will not be restricted based on the BU mapping date range.
Important:
This setting does not impact Sale Return functionality. Sale Return data will work independently and will not be restricted based on the BU mapping date range.

settings.name: UserBUValidation
settings.description:
Default Value: 0
Description:
When this setting is enabled (1), the system will validate and ensure a unique mapping combination of date range(fromdate and todate), Warehouse, and SKU. Duplicate mappings for the same Userâ€“Warehouseâ€“SKU combination will not be allowed.
When disabled (0), duplicate mapping validation will not be performed, and the system will allow multiple mappings with the same Userâ€“Warehouseâ€“SKU combination.
Dependency:
This setting is applicable only when DaterangeinBUmapping is enabled (1). this setting used at the time bu BU mapping

settings.name: excludeDisputeInvFromOverdue
settings.description:
This is a company wise setting. Supported value - 0 and 1.
When setting value is 0 = Disputed invoice will be counted as part of overdue check.
When setting value is 1= Disputed invoice will be as part of the credit limit check but not the overdue check.

settings.name: planogram_compliance_color
settings.description:
Value range - [0 to 100]. Default value 0.
If the compliance percentage is ABOVE the set value: Display in GREEN If the compliance percentage is BELOW or EQUAL to the set value: Display in RED.

settings.name: trainingCategoryConfig
settings.description: Possible values are 0 and 1. By default, the setting value will be 0, and the categories field will be displayed as a multiselect dropdown allowing multiple categories to be selected. If the setting value is set to 1, the category field will be displayed as a radio button, allowing only one category to be selected.

settings.name: restrictUserToEditOwnDetails
settings.description: This is User/Role/Designation level setting. By default, it is set to 0 (disabled). When enabled, users are restricted from editing their own details and are prevented from accessing the Users Edit and Users View pages. When disabled, users can edit their own details based on the assigned permissions.

settings.name: retailer_notification_channels
settings.description: This setting is used in the retailer app to send notifications. The configuration is in JSON format {"creditnotes": 0, "inventory_subscription": 0, "debitnotes": 0}. If creditnotes value is set to 1, notifications for credit notes will be sent. If inventory_subscription is set to 1, the retailer will receive notifications for subscribed inventory items. If debitnotes is set to 1, notifications for debit notes will be sent.

settings.name: draftCallSubmissionType
settings.description:
Allowed values are 0 and 1. Below is the behavior when resuming a draft call:
0 â†’ â€œPhone in Order / Start Callâ€ option will be shown based on the current location of the user.
1 â†’ â€œPhone in Order / Start Callâ€ option will be shown based on the location where the draft call was initiated (i.e., the original location of the draft call).
This ensures that even if the user moves away from the outlet location and submits the call outside the geo-fenced area, the call will still be treated as a geo-fenced call, since it was started within the allowed location.

settings.name: OutletImageDedupRestriction
settings.description:
The setting supports values 0 and 1, with the default value set to 0.
When the value is 0, users can add or edit outlets even if a duplicate outlet is detected.
When the value is 1, users will be restricted from adding a new outlet if a duplicate outlet is identified . Users will also be restricted from saving image captured for de-duplication while editing an outlet if the image being uploaded is identified as a duplicate.

settings.name: blockLocationTracking
settings.description:
This is User/Role/Designation level setting.

Default Value: 0 (Disabled)

When set to 1 (Enabled), the application will not track any location in the background or during usage. The app can be used even if location services are turned off.

Note: All location-related validations (such as Add Outlet, Order creation, Start Call, etc.) will be overridden and will function without location validation.

settings.name: Restrictreturnsforskucategories
settings.description: By default value will be 0. This setting restricts users from placing returns for specific SKU categories in Primary Returns. The restricted categories are defined by providing category IDs as comma-separated values in the setting configuration.

settings.name: DetectedSKUPriceDepthMandatory
settings.description: This user-level setting controls call submission behavior (default: 0), where 0 allows submission even if price or depth is missing for detected SKUs in IR merchandising, 1 blocks submission if price is missing for any detected SKU, 2 blocks submission if depth is missing, and 3 blocks submission if either price or depth is missing for any detected SKU.

settings.name: SendDueAmountInApi
settings.description: Company level setting. When set to 1, due amount will be included in the API response of getoutletbalance api. When set to 0, due amount will not be sent in the API response of getoutletbalance.

settings.name: resetPasswordInNextLogin
settings.description: Possible values are 0 and 1. Default value is 0. When set to 0, the existing password ageing behavior remains unchanged. When set to 1, the user will be prompted to reset the password on the next login or attendance after expiry.

settings.name: customKycStatus
settings.description:
This is a company-level setting.

Default Value: 0 (Disabled)

If enabled (1) and the outlet legacy flag (is_legacy_data) is set to 1, the outlet KYC status will be treated as "KYC Approved" regardless of whether the required KYC documents are uploaded.

This is a JKC-specific setting and is dependent on the "newKycModule" setting.

settings.name: approvalonloadinsettlements
settings.description: This setting controls approval for load-in settlement. 0 - No approval required, settlement follows the existing flow. 1 - Approval configuration is mandatory. Without configuration, both settlement and approval will be blocked. Both single & multi level approvals are supported. Setting 2 - The settlement process remains the same as the existing flow. The approval flow works based on the configured settings. Approvals are triggered only for active configurations, if the configuration is inactive, no approval is required. Note: 1. Approvals must be configured via /approvalConfigurations/index, and only the Admin role has access to this configuration.

settings.name: data_offloading_mode
settings.description:
This setting is used for storing logs in another data source. Below are the value supported. By default we will store logs in either MySQL or S3.
        0 = Master DB only
        1 = S3 only

settings.name: visperaMandateForAssetIds
settings.description: This is a user-level setting with possible values are comma-separated asset IDs. The default value is 0. If an asset ID is included in this value, Vispera will be mandatory only for those specific asset IDs. This behavior applies only when the visperaDeepLink setting value is set to 2.

settings.name: vansaleAtVanLevel
settings.description: This configuration defines how the Van Sale process - including Loadout and Load-in settlement - is managed. When set to 0, the process operates at the user level, meaning Loadout and Load-in settlements are tied directly to the user. When set to 1, the process operates at the van level, requiring the user to select a van before performing sale transactions. MANDATORY: the setting feature_loadout_setting must also be enabled for the same users. A van level loadout is created against the vehicle with user_id 0, and the only step that assigns a salesman to it is the acceptance action, which acts on in-transit loadouts only. With feature_loadout_setting disabled the loadout is created as self-approved instead, no acceptance ever runs, and the stock is stranded on the van with no user - it cannot be sold or settled. Note: Before implementing this functionality, please clear all pending loadout requests & loadin settlements at user level.

settings.name: enableReturnsRulesetMonthwise
settings.description: If the value of the setting is 1, then for primary returns, the creator will be able to set the rules month wise or wrt a single return.

settings.name: DetectedSKUPriceDepthConfig
settings.description: Controls whether the Shelf Price and Shelf Depth fields for detected SKUs in the IR merchandising flow are editable and/or mandatory, configured via JSON with true or false values for each KPI; for Price or Depth to be mandatory the field must also be editable. Default: price_editable: true, price_mandatory: false, depth_editable: true, depth_mandatory: false

settings.name: forceUpgradeBizomnext
settings.description:
This setting controls how and when the upgrade reminder bottom sheet is displayed in the app.

Enable:
If "enable":"0" (disabled), the bottom sheet will not be shown.
If "enable":"1" (enabled), the bottom sheet will be displayed after user calls.

show_after_calls:
"show_after_calls"(default is 3).
Reminder bottom sheet is displayed in the app after the specified number of calls.

Final Date:
"final_date" (format: YYYY-MM-DD, e.g., 2026-03-27) is used to calculate the remaining days for upgrade.
The app will show a countdown (Final Date - Current Date).
When the remaining days reach 0, the user will be forced to upgrade the app.

Default Value:
{"enable":"0","final_date":"","show_after_calls":"3"}

settings.name: enableOutletColorByOrderFulfillment
settings.description:
This is a company wise setting. Supported value - 0 and 1.
Default value is 0. Outlet color will follow the existing color coding logic.
When value is 1, outlet will turn Green if all orders placed for the outlet on the current date are fulfilled.
If outlet color is already set by the Outlet Color Coding module, that color will take priority.

settings.name: enableOutletReworkFlow
settings.description: Possible values are 0, 1 and 2. By default, the setting value will be 1. When the value is 0, the rework option is disabled. When the value is 1, selecting Rework will send the outlet approval request back to the creator for corrections. When the value is 2, selecting Rework will send the outlet approval request back to the previous approval level for further review.

settings.name: jointWorkingLocationWindowSeconds
settings.description: Time window (in seconds) to validate recent user location for joint working. Minimum allowed value is 60 seconds. Example: 120 = 2 minutes, 90 = 1.5 minutes.

settings.name: jointWorkingCallValidation
settings.description: Enable this setting to validate if User & Manager part of active Joint Working session visit an outlet together. When enabled, the system verifies that both users are present during outlet call validation. Only one simultaneous Joint Working session is allowed per user when this setting is active.

settings.name: retailer_skuvisibility_inventory
settings.description: This setting applies only to the Retailer App. If the value is 0, the app will display all SKUs mapped in inventory, regardless of whether they are active or inactive in warehouse inventory.If the value is "1", the app will display only those SKUs that are mapped in inventory and marked as active in warehouse inventory.

settings.name: restrictEditingToPendingFieldsOnly
settings.description: This is a company level setting. Default value is 0. When set to 0, if any field is under edit approval pending state, all outlet fields will be disabled and no edits will be allowed. When set to 1, only the fields that are under edit approval pending state will be restricted from editing, and all other fields will remain editable(Note: If any custom field is in a pending state, all custom fields will be disabled). This setting is applicable only for the Web application.

settings.name: redeploymentDays
settings.description: The default value of this setting is 0, which allows users to redeploy an asset at any time without any restrictions. This setting defines the number of days that must pass between an assetâ€™s registration and its redeployment. A redeployment request can only be raised once the specified number of days has elapsed for the given asset serial number. This setting is applicable only to the setting "Redeployment" and is supported for setting values 2 and 3.

settings.name: assetDeregisterOnOutletDeactivation
settings.description: This setting value is used to deregister asset from an outlet. If this setting is on and we are inactivating any outlet which is having active assets mapped to that outlet then we can deregister that asset from that outlet

settings.name: bizomNextLMS
settings.description:
This is a user-level setting with possible values of 0 or 1. The default value is 0. When set to 1, disables lead opportunityâ€“level mapping and enable lead stageâ€“level mapping
Note: This setting enabled for the Bizom Next app.

settings.name: allowqpsschemebeforedays
settings.description: This setting determines how many days from past, a date can be chosen as start date for a qps scheme. By default, this value is 0. The settings qpsscheme and pastdateqpsscheme must be enabled for this to work.

settings.name: mandatebatchinwithoutinvoicereturn
settings.description: If the value of the setting is made as 1 at any of the level(user/role/designation/company), while submitting a return without invoice, the user have to mandatorily select a batch against the sku along with the return reason

settings.name: restrictbatchcreationinreturn
settings.description:
This setting will be enabled at role/designation/users/company level
If the value of this setting is 1, the user should be able to select only the batches that are available in the inventory

settings.name: MulticurrencyFlow
settings.description:
Company-wide setting to enable multi-currency flow. Supported values: 0 and 1.
0 = Multi-currency flow disabled (default).
1 = Multi-currency flow enabled for all company transactions and app/web screens.

settings.name: MulticurrencyConversionRate
settings.description:
Company-wide setting to configure how conversion rates are applied. Supported values:
0 = Company-level rate applied for entire company.
1 = Distributor-level rates only.
2 = Company-level fallback if distributor rate not configured.
This setting works only if MulticurrencyFlow = 1.

settings.name: Conversionrateinvoicecheck
settings.description:
Supported values: 0 and 1.
0 = Invoice conversion uses current day's conversion rate.
1 = Invoice conversion uses conversion rate at the time of transaction.
This setting works only if MulticurrencyFlow = 1.

settings.name: screensForSecondaryCurrencyApp
settings.description:
Controls app screens where secondary currency flow is enabled.
This setting works only when MulticurrencyFlow is set to 1.
Supported numeric values (comma separated):
1 = Sale
2 = Collection
3 = Sale Return
4 = Reprints
5 = Transactions
Example: 1,2 enables Sale and Collection screens.
Default value 0 disables secondary currency across all app screens.

settings.name: blockFutureDatedSchemeNotification
settings.description: if setting value is 1 and either scheme or schemeholder is from future date, then notification will be blocked. if setting value is 0 , notifications will not be blocked.

settings.name: BlockDeregistrationOnRedeployment
settings.description: The default value of this setting is 0 (disabled). When the setting value is changed to 1, deregistration of will be restricted based on the Redeployment configuration.To enable this setting, the Redeployment setting must be enabled (with values 1 or 2) as a mandatory prerequisite. If redeployment is enabled and this setting is active, outlet deregistration will not be allowed until a redeployment request is raised and approved for that outlet.Additionally, if a redeployment request is in a pending state, the system will block the deregistration process until the request is approved

settings.name: freezeDamageClaimPrice
settings.description: supported value 0 and 1, When the freezeDamageClaimPrice setting is 1, SKU prices in damage claims are fixed at the time of claim creation. The same prices will be reflected consistently across all screens, including audit and view screens, regardless of any future price updates.

settings.name: mappingDistributorsToManagers
settings.description:
Supported values are 0 and 1. If the setting is 1, newly mapped distributors will be automatically assigned to their reporting managers.
Note: 1. Enable the setting usereportingtoforhiararchy
2. This flow works only if the user has an active reporting manager.
3. Disable the settings creatorNewlyAddedDistributorToTheManager & assignNewlyAddedDistributorToTheManager.

settings.name: enableSmartScanForOrder
settings.description:
Company level setting to enable the Smart Scan (PO upload) feature on order screens. Supported values:
0 = Disabled (default).
1 = Enabled for Primary order screen (placeorderfordistributor and order with mapped distributor).
2 = Enabled for Secondary order screen.
Multiple values can be passed as comma-separated (e.g. 1,2) to enable on both Primary and Secondary order screens simultaneously.

settings.name: ShowMSLskuscountinsummary
settings.description: This is a User/Role/Designation level setting. Default value is 0. When set to 1, the user can view the overall count of MSL SKUs at the outlet and the count of MSL SKUs where an order or sale was made.

settings.name: enableDistributionChannel
settings.description: This setting is used in the web. Supported values are 0 and 1, and the default value is 0. If the setting value is set to 1, users will be able to tag the distribution channel to distributors and also tag the distribution channel while placing a primary order and GRN approval.

settings.name: enableCliamableSchemeOnlyForAutogenerated
settings.description: Default value is 0. When set to 1, auto-generated claims will include only those payments linked to schemes where either the reason is claimable and the reason category is scheme_claimable, or the scheme has no reason selected.

settings.name: discounterpid
settings.description:
This Setting is used to enable and disable the discount erpId field on discount add and index screen. By default it will be disable: 0. If the value is 1, the discounterpid field will accept upto 10 varchar characters with no validations.
If the value is 2, then the discounterpid field has to be a unique value. [i.e if a duplicate value of discounterpid is tried to be configured, the system will block this].

settings.name: editClaimForAuditor
settings.description: Editclaimforauditor controls whether an auditor can modify a damage claim during audit 0 existing behavior 1 Auditor can add new SKUs and increase and decrease the quantity of existing SKUs

settings.name: EInvoiceAppFlow
settings.description: By default this setting is 0. When the setting is enabled to 1 the e-invoice generation flow through the app will be enabled.

settings.name: EnableGraceDays
settings.description:
Controls Grace Days workflow at distributor/warehouse level.
Possible values:
0 - Grace Days feature is disabled.
1 - Grace Days workflow is enabled. Credit sale at outlet is allowed within available credit limit until invoice overdue exceeds (Invoice Date / Actual Delivery Date / Expected Delivery Date + Credit Days + Grace Days).
2 - Grace Days workflow is enabled (App only). Credit sale at outlet is blocked once invoice overdue exceeds (Invoice Date / Actual Delivery Date / Expected Delivery Date + Credit Days + Grace Days), but cash sale is allowed.

settings.name: RestrictSaleGraceDays
settings.description:
Controls credit-sale block behaviour after grace days expire (used by SFA app sale flow).
Possible values:
0 - Default. Block credit sale once invoice overdue exceeds (Invoice Date / Actual Delivery Date / Expected Delivery Date + Credit Days + Grace Days); allow cash sale only if outlet is configured for cash.
1 - Allow credit sale at the outlet up to the available credit limit even when invoice overdue exceeds Credit Days + Grace Days.

settings.name: CollectionsUsingDueDate
settings.description:
Controls collection logic based on invoice date or due date.
Possible values:
0 - Default behavior. System evaluates collections using the oldest invoice date.
1 - System evaluates collections using the due date closest to the current date (nearest due invoice). Due date is fetched directly from the invoice due date column.

settings.name: enableEODAfterSettlement
settings.description:
Default value: 0 . Supported values: 0, 1, 2, 3.
0 - Allows users to submit EOD at any time during the day.
1 - Allows users to submit EOD after completing stock reconciliation.
2 - Allows users to submit EOD only after both stock reconciliation and cash reconciliation are completed.
3 - Allows users to perform Stock and Cash reconciliation only after submitting EOD.

settings.name: zeroInventoryTransfer
settings.description: Default value is 0. When 1, zero-inventory SKUs will also be included during distributor transfers. When disabled, only SKUs with available (non-zero) inventory will be transferred.

settings.name: excludeHolidayForUsers
settings.description:
This is a company-level setting. Default value is 0 (disabled).
When the setting value is 1 (enabled), an option is provided while adding or editing holidays where users belonging to the selected entity (zone, subzone, warehouses) can be selected. These selected users will be excluded from the holiday (supported on web and MDM).

settings.name: DueDateCalculation
settings.description:
Controls how due date is calculated for credit terms.
Possible values:
0 - Default behavior. No change in existing flow.
1 - Due date is calculated based on Expected Delivery Date. Expected Delivery is derived from salesman input or configured default days.
2 - Due date is calculated based on Actual Delivery Date (when order is delivered by salesman).
3 - Due date is calculated based on Delivery Lead Time.

settings.name: outletbeat_insights
settings.description: This is a company-level setting. Default value is 0. When set to 1, the Today Summary page in the app uses the revised calculation logic for sales and averages. This behavior is implemented as a custom requirement for GCPL Indonesia.

settings.name: allowSalesReturnGreaterthanSale
settings.description:
This is a company-level setting with supported values 0 and 1.
The default value is 0, where outlet color follows the existing color-coding logic.

When the value is set to 1, a checkbox will be available on the outlet add/edit page in the UI (Add and Update MDM) to allow sales returns exceeding sales. If this checkbox is selected, users will be able to process returns greater than sales on the app side.

This functionality impacts only the app and the checkbox will be visible only when the Salecheck setting is enabled (set to 1). This setting effectively allows bypassing the Salecheck validation in the app.

settings.name: additionalTaxUserInput
settings.description:
Additional Tax behavior depends on the setting value in orders/sales screens:
0 â†’ auto-applied on both primary and secondary.
1 â†’ auto-applied only on primary (manual for secondary).
2 â†’ auto-applied only on secondary (manual for primary).
3 â†’ manual for primary and secondary.
This setting is applicable only when enable_additional_tax is set to 1.

settings.name: saleReturnMultiReference
settings.description: If this setting is enabled (value set to 1), the system will generate a single sales return number and one credit note for all the selected invoice references. By default, this feature is disabled (value set to 0). This is dependent on autoReturnwithInvoice(for web) & smartSaleReturnBizomNext(for app).

settings.name: smartSaleReturnBizomNext
settings.description: If this setting is enabled (value set to 1), the smartSaleReturnBizomNext with Invoice feature will be activated for APP.

settings.name: maxSkuReturnDays
settings.description: If this setting is enabled (value set to 1), users will be able to define the maximum return days for a SKU in the Skunits add/edit page, maximum days user can configure is 365. When the autoReturnwithInvoice feature is used and maxSkuReturnDays is defined for a SKU, the system will consider this value instead of the autoLastnDayInvoicesInReturn setting. Only invoices within the configured return day range will be displayed. By default, this setting is disabled (value set to 0).

settings.name: assetManagementWithoutSerialno
settings.description: If enabled (1), users can perform asset registration, audit, deregistration and redeployment without serial no. Default 0 (disabled).

settings.name: verifyOutletPhoneWeb
settings.description: This Setting is used to enable/disable the outlet phone number validation via OTP on the Web. Default value is 0 If value is 1, outlet phone number validation will be enabled but wont be mandatoryIf value is 2, outlet phone number validation will be enabled and will be mandatory.

settings.name: dbOnboardDuplicacyCheck
settings.description:
This is a company level setting.

Disable:
If "dbOnboardDuplicacyCheck":"0" (Disabled), the system will not validate duplicate distributors during onboarding.

Enable:
If "dbOnboardDuplicacyCheck":"1" (Enabled), the system will validate duplicate distributors during onboarding based on the setting checkForUniqueFieldInWarehouse.

If a matching distributor is found in Rejected & Inactive status, the user will be provided an option to edit and resubmit the distributor.

Upon resubmission, the approval workflow will be reset and the distributor onboarding process will restart from Stage 1.

Users will be allowed to edit only those distributors that belong to their assigned zones.

settings.name: restrictVanSalePostSettlementEdit
settings.description: This setting will help in restricting the edit invoices in the van sale process before / after settlement. Supported values are 0, 1 & 2. 0 - allows invoice edit before / after loadin settlement. 1 - restrict the invoice edit after settlement and allow before settlement as default. 2 - restrict the invoice edit before & after loadin settlement. This should include order fulfillment & direct sale which were performed by van sale users.

settings.name: enableSaleDIGForBizomNext
settings.description: If you want to use sale DIG Template for Bizom Next you need to enable this setting

settings.name: enableSaleReturnDIGForBizomNext
settings.description: If you want to use sale return DIG Template for Bizom Next you need to enable this setting

settings.name: enableCollectionDIGForBizomNext
settings.description: If you want to use collection DIG Template for Bizom Next you need to enable this setting

settings.name: enableLoadoutDIGForBizomNext
settings.description: If you want to use loadout DIG Template for Bizom Next you need to enable this setting

settings.name: restrictclaimsubmission
settings.description:
This setting determines how the claim restriction, based on the “Claimant Backdated Claim Duration” configured under Claim Types, will be applied.
If set to 0, the restriction will be validated only while adding claims to the cart.If set to 1, the restriction will be validated both while adding claims to the cart and during claim submission

settings.name: calendarclaimlimit
settings.description: If this user-level setting is enabled, claim limits will be validated based on the configured Date, Week, Month, Quarter, or Year period defined in the Bizom Dates configuration (Dates table). If disabled, the existing validation logic will be used: Daily = current date, Weekly = last 7 days, Monthly = last 30 days, Quarterly = last 90 days, and Yearly = last 365 days.

settings.name: mandatorybatchforexchangesalereturnapproval
settings.description: When enabled (value = 1), enforces mandatory batch selection while approving an Exchange sale return on the /payments/salesreturnreport screen. Applies to single approve, multi-level confirm, and bulk approve flows. Reject flow is not affected. Allowed values: 0 - Disabled (default), 1 - Enabled.

settings.name: BulkCancelReturn
settings.description: The default value of the setting will be 0, when the value is zero the feature will be disabled. When value is selected as 1 only secondary sale returns can be bulk cancelled. When the value is selected as 2 only primary sale returns can be bulk cancelled. When the value is selected as 3 both primary and secondary sale returns can be bulk cancelled.

settings.name: skuVariableDiscountException
settings.description: This setting restricts SKU-wise variable discounts in the Sale/Order workflow. It is a multi-valued comma-separated setting applicable on both Web. independent of orderTypeClassification. Allowed values: 1 - Restrict SKU Wise Variable Discount for Order, 2 - Restrict SKU Wise Variable Discount for Special Order, 3 - Restrict SKU Wise Variable Discount for Sale, 4 - Restrict SKU Wise Variable Discount for Special Sale. Multiple values can be configured together as comma-separated (e.g., 1,2,3,4).

settings.name: newAddressField
settings.description:
This feature is developed specifically for BAT. Before enabling this setting, please reach out to the Product Team.

When this setting is enabled:

In Outlet Add/Edit, the existing single address field will be replaced with multiple address fields such as:
address1
address2
address3
address4
The address fields displayed will depend on the mapping configured from the "Basic Outlet Form".
Only the mapped address fields from "Basic Outlet Form" will be visible to the user.
During save, all address field values will be concatenated and stored in the existing address field for backward compatibility with the current system flow.
The individual address field values will also be stored separately as per the implemented additional details structure.

settings.name: skipMandatoryActivitiesOnRepeatVisit
settings.description:
This setting is used in the app. Default value is 0 (disabled).
When the setting value is 1 (enabled), users can skip mandatory activities for an outlet during multiple visits on the same day, before submitting EOD (End of Day).

settings.name: UserInactivityTimeout
settings.description:
UserInactivityTimeout is a Role, Designation, or User level setting for the Bizom Next app (default value: 0).

When set to 0, the inactivity timeout is completely disabled. Any other value defines the timeout duration in exact minutes.

The inactivity timer is automatically reset by explicit user actions, including scrolling, typing, tapping, navigating between screens, unlocking the device, and reopening the app after it has been minimized, locked, or crashed.

Note: Background syncs and automated API calls do not reset the timer.

Once the user successfully re-authenticates via password, the app will restore the exact screen and workflow state the user was on before the timeout, ensuring a seamless experience.

Note: UserInactivityTimeout setting takes precedence over the requiredPasswordLoginMinutes setting.

settings.name: userToVanMappings
settings.description:
The supported values are 0,1,2,3. 0 represents disabled 1 - Van Sales 2 - Assets 3 - Delivery module. The setting can be configured with comma separated. Whatever modules are added at setting level will be displayed in the vehicle mappings. 
    </br>Note: 
    </br>1. Enable the feature_loadout_setting configuration when Van Sale is enabled. This setting will also help handle scenarios where both temporary and permanent users are logged in on the same day, ensuring the loadout process is managed correctly. 
    </br>2. Please add a note in the setting description to check the setting name "vantomodulemapping" if required.

settings.name: vanToModuleMapping
settings.description: Supported values are 0 and 1, where 0 enables single module selection per van (radio button), and 1 allows multiple module selection. This setting will be applicable only when userToVanMappings is enabled.

settings.name: vehicleNoFormat
settings.description:
This setting controls validation for the vehicle number field during vehicle creation and update (/vehicles/add and /vehicles/edit/).
Default value is 0 (disabled).
When disabled, there is no validation on the vehicle number field during add/edit, and the current behavior remains unchanged.
When enabled, only the configured vehicle number format/value will be allowed during vehicle creation and updates.

settings.name: blockSaleReturnAtCashOutlets
settings.description: This is a warehouses/disreibutor level setting. 0 (Disabled) ,1 (Enabled) â€“ Sale Return is restricted for Cash outlets.  When enabled, it restricts all types of secondary sale return activities (with invoice, without invoice) for cash outlets across web, API, and app. When disabled, sale return transactions continue as per the existing flow.

settings.name: outletLevelWorkFlowsOnApproval
settings.description: This is a company level setting. Possible values are 0 and 1. Default value is 0. When set to 1, specific outlet workflows can be enabled after each level of outlet approval based on the configured approval sequence. Before the first level of approval, no workflows are accessible. After the final level of approval, only the workflows configured for the final approval stage remain accessible, while all other workflows continue to be restricted. This setting takes precedence over the blockFirstTransaction setting.

settings.name: parentOutletVisibility
settings.description: This configuration controls the outlet data displayed in the Parent Outlet filter while adding or editing an outlet (Bill-To / Ship-To flow). When the value is set to 0 (default), the setting is disabled and the Parent Outlet filter will display all active outlets available at the company level. When the value is set to 1, the Parent Outlet list will be displayed based on the user-to-distributor mapping. When the value is set to 2, the Parent Outlet list will be displayed based on the user-to-area mapping. Note: The functional behavior will remain consistent across both Web and App platforms.

settings.name: couponSubbrands
settings.description: This setting can have values 0 and 1. If setting value is 1 then it restricts the addition of products from multiple sub-brands in the Retailer App cart. When set to 1, users can add products from only one sub-brand at a time. SKUs belonging to other sub-brands will not be allowed in the cart.

settings.name: EnableSuperCase
settings.description: This is a company-level setting with supported values 0 and 1. The default value is 0 (disabled). When set to 1, the SuperCase feature is enabled, allowing the configuration of a parent SKU (SuperCase) that maps to one or more child physical SKUs along with the per-unit quantity of each child SKU contained in one parent. The parent-to-child mapping is stored in the `supercase_parent_child` table and is used to expand SuperCase orders/invoices into their underlying physical SKUs for downstream operations.

settings.name: topdealsGroupSchemes
settings.description: This is a Company level setting. This setting can have values 0 or 1. The default value is 0. When value is 1, the Top Deals feature is enabled and top-deal (is_top_deal) scheme group slabs are resolved for outlets.

settings.name: EnabledMSLinPWA
settings.description: Default value is 0. To enable set value as 1. This setting is used to support MSL for Retailer App.Same setting is used to add configs in web/mdm for Retailer App.

settings.name: showpaymentmodeBizomNext
settings.description: Default value is 0. If set to 1, Payment mode will be displayed in unfulfilled orders, loadsheet & pending collection in BizomNext App.

settings.name: SmartArsDashboardConfig
settings.description: Default value: {"enable":"0","dashboard_id":"0","widget_id":"0"}. The "enable" field controls whether the Smart ARS Dashboard configuration is active: "0" = Disabled, "1" = Enabled. The ARS Dashboard ID should be configured in the "dashboard_id" field. This ID can be obtained from the Reports . The corresponding Widget ID should be configured in the "widget_id" field. The Widget ID can also be obtained from the Reports  and must belong to the configured ARS Dashboard.

settings.name: enableSmartScaninApp
settings.description:
App-level setting to enable the Smart Scan workflow. Supported values:
0 = Disabled (default).
1 = Enabled for Secondary order screen in the app.

settings.name: retailerAppCreditAgeingBlock
settings.description: Credit ageing block config for Retailer App orders â€” controls exposure days, exposure limit and order states for overdue calculation

settings.name: salereturnBackgroundProcess
settings.description: Company level setting. Default value is 0. When value is 1, sale-return submissions with more than 20 SKUs are processed in the background (salereturn:process command) instead of synchronously, avoiding request timeouts. Progress can be tracked on the Background Processes screen.

settings.name: SKUPriceValidation
settings.description: Validates the SKU price entered when the Enter SKU Price feature (enterskuprice) is enabled. "Value" controls the mode: 0 (Default) = no validation, existing workflow is unchanged. 1 = price must be between Rs.1 and the SKU MRP; MinPricePercentage and MaxPricePercentage are ignored. 2 = price must be between MinPricePercentage and MaxPricePercentage of the SKU MRP, both configured as percentages (e.g. MinPricePercentage=10 and MaxPricePercentage=90 allow Rs.10 to Rs.90 for a SKU with MRP Rs.100).

settings.name: enableSecondaryOrderApproval
settings.description: Controls the Order Approval tab options in Bizom Next (Android and iOS mobile app). Default value: 0. If enableSecondaryOrderApproval = 1, only Secondary Orders are available under the Order Approval tab and filter. If both isPrimaryOrderUpdate = 1 and enableSecondaryOrderApproval = 1, Primary, Secondary, and Both options are available under the Order Approval tab and filter. If only isPrimaryOrderUpdate = 1, only Primary Orders are available under the Order Approval tab and filter.

settings.name: enabledynamicfilter
settings.description: Default value is 0 - disabled, 1 - enabled.
