If value is 1, the SKU attribute filters (Brand, Sub Brand, Category, Sub Category, Variant, Size, Packaging, Sub Packs) on the web Sales/Order and Sale Return screens become drill-down filters - each filter starts unselected and, as values are chosen, shows only the values present in the currently matching SKUs, filters with no matching values are hidden and a Clear All resets them.

settings.name: ARS_SKU_INVENTORY_SOURCE
settings.description:
This is a custom development for GCPL.
If the setting value is 0, in the ARS screen, the SKU list is fetched based on the sellers(Warehouse) inventory mapping. If the setting value is 1, the SKU list is fetched based on the buyers(Distributor) inventory

settings.name: distanceFormStartCall
settings.description:
Allowed Values: 0, 1
Default Value: 0
0: Calculate distance using Call End Time, end_call_latitude, and end_call_longitude.
1: Calculate distance using Call Start Time, Start Latitude, and Start Longitude.

settings.name: enableMerchandisingReportError
settings.description:
The supported values are 0 and 1. 0 represents disabled. Default value is 1.
    </br>0 - The feature will be disabled in the app.
    </br>1 - A "Report an Error" link will be available on merchandising screens, including Smart Assets, Product Merchandising, and Planogram, allowing users to report issues.

settings.name: AttendanceImageMatchSensitivity
settings.description: Configurable percentage that determines how closely a submitted image must match the profile images to be considered a successful match.

settings.name: WarehouseStockApproval
settings.description: When enabled , warehouse stock update by distributor salesman goes to approval by warehouse manager- Custom Development for GCPL India.

settings.name: stockAuditExpiryTime
settings.description: Duration in hours after which pending warehousestock audit expires ( Default- 24, applicable values [1,168] ) WarehouseStockApproval setting must be enabled - - custom development for GCPL India.

settings.name: stockAuditHistoryLookbackHours
settings.description: Duration in hours until warehousestockapproval audits is visible in app( Default- 24, applicable values [1,168] )-  WarehouseStockApproval setting must be enabled . custom development for GCPL India.

settings.name: OTPBasedLogin
settings.description: (User overridable) - When enabled this allows users of the company to login to mobile dms via otp. The company value is the default; an individual user can be opted in/out via a Settingoverride row regardless of the company default. Please contact engineering before enabling this configuration. Default - 0

settings.name: CallValidatedTasks
settings.description:
This is a User/Role/Designation level setting for the Bizom Next Tour Program. The allowed values for this setting are 0/1. By default it will be 0 (disabled) and when set to 1 it is enabled.

When enabled, Outlet Visit and Distributor Visit tasks planned in the Tour Program cannot be executed directly from the Tour Program screen. Instead, the task card will show a Start Call button, and the planned subtasks must be completed from within the Outlet/Distributor call flow (SubTasks tab). Subtasks that are Not Started will continue to appear on subsequent visits to the same outlet, and followed-up subtasks will appear on their follow-up date.

Note: This setting is applicable only for the Bizom Next Tour Program. The setting MandateSubtasks works along with this setting.

settings.name: MandateSubtasks
settings.description:
This is a User/Role/Designation level setting for the Bizom Next Tour Program. The allowed values for this setting are 0/1. By default it will be 0 (disabled) and when set to 1 it is enabled.

This setting works only when the CallValidatedTasks setting is enabled. When enabled, the user will not be allowed to submit/end an Outlet or Distributor call unless all the subtasks planned for that outlet/distributor on that date are completed.

When disabled, the call can be submitted even if planned subtasks are pending; the app will only show an alert that the tasks are not completed.

settings.name: jointworkinguserfilter
settings.description: Controls user visibility in joint working selection. Supported values: 0 - Disabled (default behavior, no change in current visibility), 1 - Immediate Reporting Users (shows only direct reportees of the logged-in user), 2 - Full Reporting Hierarchy (shows all users in the reporting tree under the logged-in user). Applicable levels: User / Role / Designation.

settings.name: enabletradepayoutschemes
settings.description:
This is a Company level setting which controls the availability of the trade payout scheme types. The allowed values for this setting are 0/1/2/1,2 and the default value is 0.
0 (default) - Disabled. Neither trade payout scheme type is available.
1 - Admin can configure Non-Transactional FOC schemes and assign them to the relevant entities (as per PR1-T10645).
2 - Users can configure Monetary Trade Payout schemes ("Trade Payouts" scheme type becomes selectable on the Add Scheme page and on the Assign Scheme page, both from the UI and from the MDMs), assign eligible outlets, and the apply/skip option appears for the Reps at billing. This value works only when the multischemeenable setting is also enabled, without it the "Trade Payouts" scheme type is neither offered nor applied.
1,2 - Both scheme types work independently and simultaneously. An outlet may hold both an FOC scheme and a monetary trade payout at the same time and each of them follows its own rules with no interaction between them.

settings.name: IrPricing
settings.description: 0 = disabled, 1 = enabled. Enables the price-detection workflow on top of IR merchandising. Additive â€” does not disable IR merchandising.

settings.name: attendanceValidatedTasks
settings.description:
This is a User/Role/Designation level setting. The allowed values for this setting are 0/1. By default it will be 0 (disabled) and when set to 1 it is enabled.

When enabled, the user can only update tasks if the user has marked attendance for the day.

Users will still be able to add tasks for future days even if attendance is not marked for the day.

settings.name: closeTaskStatus
settings.description:
This is a User/Role/Designation level setting for the Bizom Next Tour Program. The allowed values for this setting are 0/1. By default it will be 0 (disabled) and when set to 1 it is enabled.

When enabled, the user gets the option to close tasks that are not going to be executed. Any sub-task that is in Start or Not Started state can be marked as Closed. Sub-tasks that are already Completed, Solved, or Followed Up cannot be closed. When all the sub-tasks of a main task are in Start or Not Started state, the user can also close the main task directly in a single action instead of closing each sub-task individually.

settings.name: taskExpiryValidation
settings.description:
This is a User/Role/Designation level JSON setting for the Tour Program. It works only when the CloseTaskStatus setting is enabled. By default the day values are 0, which keeps this validation off until configured.

Keys:
- expiryDays: takes a number (N). The planned task stays actionable for N days after its planned date â€” within this window the user can execute, update, close, or follow up the task. After N days it expires and the user can no longer act on it.
- autoCloseDays: takes a number (N). If a task is still not executed, the system automatically closes it N days after its planned date, so stale tasks do not stay open. This is always kept on or after the expiry window.
- allowFollowUpBeforeExpiry: takes 0 or 1. When 1, the user can follow up a task while it is still within its actionable window.
- showExpiryIndicator: takes 0 or 1. When 1, the task shows how much time is left before it expires (for example "Expires Today" or "2 Days Left").

Note: the auto-close days must be equal to or greater than the expiry days.

settings.name: sendeodtolevel2mgr
settings.description: If value is set to 1 then mail will only be sent to level 2 reporting managers of the user. If the setting is disabled then we send the mail to level 1 reporting manager and self.

settings.name: HidePriceInRetailerApp
settings.description: Retailer App setting. 0 = disabled (default), 1 = enabled. When enabled, selling price, amount, total and discount are hidden everywhere in the Retailer App.

settings.name: PriceMrpDisplayConfigInRetailerApp
settings.description: Retailer App setting. Controls what the SKU card shows. 0 = default (default), 1 = show MRP and Price, 2 = show MRP only, 3 = show neither.

settings.name: Vansalereturns
settings.description: (User overridable) - When enabled the van sale return raised from the app is routed through the vanSaleReturn multi-level approval configuration instead of being auto-approved. The company value is the default; a role/designation/user can be overridden via a Settingoverride row. If no vanSaleReturn approval configuration exists for the requester the request is treated as auto-approved. Default - 0

settings.name: enable_proforma_invoice
settings.description:
Setting supports value 0 and 1.Once enabled, users will be able to print the Proforma Invoice and share it as an image or PDF.
Disabled: value set to 0.
Enabled :Value set to 1.

settings.name: SmartArsRecommendationSettings
settings.description:
This setting is used to enable Smart ARS recommendations In RI Copilot Suggested Orders. If the value is 0 then it is considered disabled.To enable this setting, the value entered in json should be {"SmartArsSuggestionUpliftPercentage": 0, "SmartArsSalesNumMonths": 6, "SmartArsSalesModeMinTransactionsPerOutlet": 6, "SmartArsMinActiveMonths": 6, "SmartArsCrossSellScope": "beat", "SmartArsRecoveryTenureMonths": 3, "SmartArsNormalGroupingColumn": "", "SmartArsParentChildGroupingEnabled": false}.

Meaning of each key -
SmartArsSuggestionUpliftPercentage (int, allowed 0 to 100): percentage quantity uplift applied on all the final Smart ARS recommendations (regular, upsell, cross sell and recovery) after they are merged, formula ceil(qty * (1 + value/100)), set 0 for no uplift.
SmartArsSalesNumMonths (int, min 1): number of past months considered as the sales lookback window while deciding whether an outlet should be served in SALES mode or ORDER mode, recommended 6.
SmartArsSalesModeMinTransactionsPerOutlet (int, min 1): minimum number of payment transactions an outlet must have inside the SmartArsSalesNumMonths lookback window to become eligible for SALES mode, outlets below this fall back to ORDER mode, recommended 6.
SmartArsMinActiveMonths (int, min 1): minimum number of months of historical activity required for an outlet-SKU pair before it is included in ML training and prediction, recommended 6.
SmartArsCrossSellScope (string, allowed beat or warehouse): neighbourhood used to compute cross sell recommendations, beat compares the outlet against other outlets of the same beat, warehouse compares against all outlets of the same warehouse (distributor), recommended beat.
SmartArsRecoveryTenureMonths (int, min 0): number of continuous months without any sales of an outlet-SKU pair after which the SKU is flagged for product recovery, set 0 to disable product recovery, recommended 3.
SmartArsNormalGroupingColumn (string, optional): name of the SKU attribute column used to group SKUs together (normal grouping) when computing suggested-order recommendations for this company. Must match ^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$. Leave blank or omit the key to disable normal grouping.
SmartArsParentChildGroupingEnabled (boolean, optional, default false): whether parent-child SKU grouping is applied for this company, child SKUs are remapped to their parent SKU (via skunitgroups) before generating recommendations.

Note - the json MUST be entered in the exact structure given above with all the keys, except SmartArsNormalGroupingColumn and SmartArsParentChildGroupingEnabled which are optional.

settings.name: enableOfflineSchemeCappingAndBudget
settings.description: Default is 0. Setting supports values 0 and 1. When set to 1, offline scheme capping and budget calculated on mobile devices will be ingested, allowing over-budget recording in ledger, deactivating exhausted scheme holders or groups, and bypassing online blocking/recalculation alerts.

settings.name: sampleOrderSku
settings.description:
A warehouse / distributor-level JSON setting used to control the availability of Sample Order and Sample Sale flows for both Primary and Secondary transactions.By default, all flows are disabled. When all configuration values are set to 0, the existing system behavior remains unchanged. Based on the configured JSON values, the corresponding Sample Order and/or Sample Sale flows will be enabled for the warehouse.
For example, to enable Sample Order for Primary transactions and Sample Sale for Secondary transactions:
{"primary": {"order": 1,"sale": 0},"secondary": {"order": 0,"sale": 1}}
Note: When adding new Sample SKUs to the system, it is recommended to configure the Sample SKU price as 0 in the SKU Master to ensure the intended pricing is maintained for all transactions.
settings.rule_set: {"type": "json", "rules": [{"key": "primary", "type": "json", "rules": [{"key": "order", "type": "int", "rules": ["MIN_0", "MAX_1"], "required": true}, {"key": "sale", "type": "int", "rules": ["MIN_0", "MAX_1"], "required": true}], "required": true}, {"key": "secondary", "type": "json", "rules": [{"key": "order", "type": "int", "rules": ["MIN_0", "MAX_1"], "required": true}, {"key": "sale", "type": "int", "rules": ["MIN_0", "MAX_1"], "required": true}], "required": true}]}

settings.name: allowOrderCaptureWhenAbsent
settings.description: This is a company-level setting to control whether users who are marked Absent or are on Leave can capture orders. The setting accepts 0 or 1 and is disabled by default with a value of 0. When the value is 0, the existing behaviour remains unchanged and users cannot capture orders while Absent/on Leave. When the value is set to 1, order capture is allowed for eligible users while Absent/on Leave through the configured and enabled order entry paths. In this state, only the Order section is available as per the Off Location configuration, while other activities remain hidden or unavailable.

settings.name: deliveryConfirmationWindow
settings.description: This is retailer App Settings Configuration for the number of past days (based on Invoice Date or Delivered Date) within which a retailer can mark delivery confirmation. Invoices not confirmed within this window are set to a "Not confirmed" state and are not recorded/reported as received. Default 0 â€“ no restriction (all past invoices are eligible).

settings.name: hideInventoryBasedPriceColor
settings.description:
Company-level setting used to control the color coding of the SKU unit price based on inventory availability.

* When set to `0`, the existing inventory-based price color behavior will be maintained.
* When set to `1`, the red color indication for the SKU unit price will be suppressed, and the price will be displayed using the default/grey color.

**Note:** This setting only controls the visual color of the SKU unit price. It does not affect SKU availability, inventory calculation, pricing, quantity/case color coding, SKU selection, order validation, or order submission. The existing behavior will remain unchanged when `stockatwarehouse = 1`.
in APP only

settings.name: skuPriceMrpCaptureConfig
settings.description:
**Default Value:** `{"price":"1","mrp":"1"}` **Supported Parameters:** `price`, `mrp` Company-level JSON setting used to control the visibility of the **Price** and **MRP** fields on the Competitor screen in the app. By default, both fields are visible. The visibility of each field can be controlled using the respective configuration value: * If `price` is set to `1`, the **Price** field will be displayed. * If `mrp` is set to `1`, the **MRP** field will be displayed. * If either configuration value is set to `0`, the corresponding field will not be displayed.
**Note:** This setting is applicable only to the **App**.

settings.name: reserve_stock_transfer_stock
settings.description: Holds the approved quantity at the sending warehouse while an intra distributor transfer is being approved, so it cannot be sold. Default 0.

settings.name: intra_warehouse_stock_transfer
settings.description: Enables the Intra Distributor Stock Transfer module. When disabled, Stock Transfer is not visible to any user. Default 0.

settings.name: enableSkuMappingForPO
settings.description:
This is a User/Role/Designation level setting.

Controls whether a user can map an unmatched SKU to a vendor during Smart Scan PO (Bizom Smart - Scan PO Automation), i.e. the "Save Mappings to Vendor" action on the order/sale screen. This setting is dependent on setting 'enableSmartScanForOrder' being enabled.

Supported values:
0 = Disabled â€” cannot map a SKU to the vendor (default). When a PO is scanned and a line item's product name does not match any existing SKU-vendor mapping, the item is still listed as unmapped on the order/sale screen, but the "Save Mappings to Vendor" action is blocked for this user with the message "You do not have permission to map SKUs to a vendor for Smart Scan PO." â€” an authorized user (see below) must perform the mapping instead.
1 = Enabled â€” User can map an unmatched SKU to the vendor and save it. When enabled, the user can search and select the correct Bizom SKU against each unmapped PO line item and click "Save Mappings to Vendor" to permanently record that SKUâ†”vendor mapping (in skuvendormappings) for future PO scans of this vendor, and the matched quantity is immediately applied to the current order. This mapping, once saved, is treated as permanent and can only be corrected later by an admin.

settings.name: poDateExpiryFlow
settings.description:
This is a User/Role/Designation level setting.

Controls whether the PO Date and PO Expiry Date fields are shown while processing a Smart Scan PO (Bizom Smart - Scan PO Automation) in the mobile app, and whether they must be filled in before the PO can be saved.

Supported values:
0 = Disabled â€” PO Date and PO Expiry Date fields are not shown (default).
1 = Enabled â€” fields are shown but optional; the PO can be saved without them.
2 = Mandatory â€” fields are shown and must be filled in before the PO can be saved.

settings.name: complaintAtAssetLevel
settings.description: This setting controls whether a complaint on an asset is raised against a single installed unit or against the asset type. Default value is 0. When the value is 0 the complaint is raised against the asset type, as it is today. When the value is 1 the complaint screen asks for the installed unit after the asset type is chosen, and the complaint stores that unit along with its serial number, so an outlet holding more than one unit of the same asset type can be told apart on the complaint list and the complaint page. Units are shown by serial number, and where a unit has no serial number it is shown with its id and the date it was added.

settings.name: myComplaintsDays
settings.description: This setting limits how far back the complaints API (getMyComplaints) looks, counted from the date each complaint was raised. Default value is 0. When the value is 0 or blank every complaint is returned, however old, which is how the API behaved before this setting. When the value is between 1 and 365 only complaints raised within that many days are returned. The highest allowed value is 365, and anything larger is treated as 365.

settings.name: otpVerificationTourProgram
settings.value: {"enabled": 0, "message": "_code_ is your Bizom outlet verification code."}
settings.description: Enables and configures reporting manager OTP verification on tour program subtask submission. The OTP is sent to the warehouse phone number of the task's distributor, so the warehouse must have a phone number. Value (JSON): {"enabled": 0|1, "message": "<DLT-registered SMS template>"}. Default enabled = 0. Message placeholders: _code_, _submitter_, _manager_ (warehouse name), _task_name_, _fordate_, _company_.

settings.name: outletTypeAutoApproveList
settings.description:
Default value is 0. Comma-separated list of Outlet Type IDs (e.g. 2,5) used to automatically approve outlet type changes for the listed types.
By default (value 0), every outlet type change goes through the normal Outlet Type edit-approval process, if one is configured.
When one or more Outlet Type IDs are configured, changing an outlet to one of these types is approved automatically and immediately, skipping the edit-approval process for that change, even if approval is otherwise configured for it.

settings.name: reprintaddon
settings.description: This setting is used to support credit and debit notes in the reprint screen in app. Default value is 0. When the value is 0 the reprint will have no change. When value is 1 then credit note will be supported in the reprint screen. When the value is 2 debit notes will be supported in the reprint screen. When the value is 3 both credit and debit notes will be supported in the reprint screen.

settings.name: loadinSettlementMode
settings.description: Default value is 0. This setting is used when Vansale user does only Salereturn pick up & re-sells those saleable stock. When value is 1, stock stays with the van user, which he can sell and moves to the distributor only after Loadin settlement, and cash stays with the van user and is handed over at Loadin settlement. When the value is 2 stock stays with the van user which he can sell and moves to the distributor after Loadin settlement. When the value is 3 stock posts to the distributor directly and no stock settlement is needed, while cash stays with the van user and is settled at Loadin. While enabling the setting for user/role/designation, it has to be set for vansalesman persona.

settings.name: lwsLoyaltyConfig
settings.description: Company-level LWS loyalty integration. JSON keys/defaults: enabled=false, secretKey="", tokenPath="/SIN/GetTokenDetails.aspx", redirectPath="/xx/default.aspx", domains.staging="https://stagingxxx.bizomstaging.in", domains.production="https://xxx.xx.xx". Bizom uses domains[env]+tokenPath to obtain a sign-on Token, then redirects to domains[env]+redirectPath with encrypted UserCode/CustomerMobile/Token params.
settings.rule_set: {"type": "json", "rules": [{"key": "enabled", "type": "boolean", "rules": ["BOOLEAN_0_1"], "required": true}, {"key": "secretKey", "type": "string", "rules": ["MIN_LENGTH_1", "MAX_LENGTH_50"], "required": true}, {"key": "tokenPath", "type": "string", "rules": ["MIN_LENGTH_1", "MAX_LENGTH_50"], "required": true}, {"key": "redirectPath", "type": "string", "rules": ["MIN_LENGTH_1", "MAX_LENGTH_50"], "required": true}, {"key": "domains", "type": "json", "rules": [{"key": "staging", "type": "string", "rules": ["VALID_URL", "MIN_LENGTH_10", "MAX_LENGTH_100"], "required": true}, {"key": "production", "type": "string", "rules": ["VALID_URL", "MIN_LENGTH_10", "MAX_LENGTH_100"], "required": true}], "required": true}]}

settings.name: autoorderretailer
settings.description: Retailer App auto order setting (JSON). Keys: enable = 0 (default, auto order disabled; subscriptions cannot be created) or 1 (auto order enabled; subscriptions can be created and orders are placed automatically; applies to white-labelled and multi-brand Retailer Apps). time = 24-hour time (HH:MM) at which the auto order is placed, e.g. "09:30"; it is required when the setting is saved.

settings.name: Multilevelcomplaintsapproval
settings.description: This is a company level setting. Possible values are 0 and 1. Default value is 0. When set to 1, complaint approval is routed through the multilevel approval sequence configured for the raiser on the Add Approvals screen, replacing the existing single approver and reporting manager routing. A level whose configured approver does not exist in the raiser's hierarchy is skipped and recorded. When set to 0, complaint approval behaves as it does today.

settings.name: BusinessunitApprovalConfig
settings.description: JSON setting for the Business Unit mapping approval threshold. status: 0 = approval disabled, 1 = enabled. approvaldays: when enabled, mappings whose start date is on or before (today - approvaldays) require approval.

settings.name: enableBeatOptimisation
settings.description:
This setting enables the Beat Optimisation mode inside the Optimised tab of the DSR app. Default value is 0 (disabled).
When the setting value is 1 (enabled), the salesman can enter the number of outlets to cover and a maximum walking distance, and the app returns a prioritised, walking-ordered subset of the beat. Enabling this setting also displays the Beat Optimisation tab on the Settings page for Admin users, where the scoring weights are configured.

settings.name: suggested_batch_display
settings.description:
Controls whether FEFO batch-suggestion and compliance-audit features appear during order fulfilment.
Enabled (value 1): Shows Print/Show Suggested Batch buttons on /orders and Order Edit/View, plus a colour-coded confirmation at Submit that shows an optional, informational acknowledgement and logs an audit entry whenever a scanned batch differs from the FEFO suggestion.
Disabled (value 0, default): No new buttons or FEFO warning/audit behaviour; fulfilment works as today.
Scope: Applies only where batch/serial tracking (serialization) is enabled

settings.name: blockSettlementUndelivered
settings.description:
This setting controls whether a loadsheet can be settled with undelivered invoices.
Supported values are 0 & 1.
0 - Allows loadsheet settlement even when there are undelivered invoices.
1 - Restricts loadsheet settlement when there are undelivered invoices.
The flow remains the same for primary & secondary invoices.This will be supported only when deliverymodulestatus is enabled.

settings.name: applyoptionalscheme
settings.description:
This is a Company level setting which enables the "Apply Optional Scheme" capability, letting the user search, tag and apply optional schemes themselves on the order/sale create screen, the order/invoice edit screen and during order fulfilment, instead of only the system-picked default scheme. The allowed values are 0/1 and the default value is 0.
0 (default) - Disabled. Behaviour is exactly as today (only the default applied scheme).
1 - Enabled. The "Apply Optional Scheme" control is shown and optional schemes can be tagged/applied.

This setting works only when the multischemeenable setting is also enabled; without it the optional-scheme capability is neither offered nor applied.

Note: These optional schemes will not be considered in WITHOUT invoice return.

settings.name: enableAccountingParentBilling
settings.description: Company-level setting. Default 0 (disabled). When set to 1, enables the Key Account Management - Accounting Parent model. Admins can create Accounting Parents (Key Accounts) and map outlets to them as Company Owned (COCO) or Franchise (CODO) children. For Company Owned children, credit (credit limit, credit days, grace days, no. of invoice limit), billing, collections and credit/debit notes are managed at the Accounting Parent; Franchise children keep their own credit and are mapped to the parent for reporting only. When set to 2, everything of 1 applies and a credit Key Account's credit is kept per distributor: the distributors selected on the Key Account each get their own credit parameters and balance, and only those distributors can sell to the Key Account. When set to 0, the existing outlet behaviour remains unchanged.

settings.name: purchaseOrderimages
settings.description: Lets the app capture multiple images against the PO, GRN and RO number fields, because an invoice can run over several pages. The images are uploaded to S3 and linked to the stored transaction through POST /transactions/documents. Whether they are mandatory is governed by purchaseOrderWorkFlow. Accepted values 0 and 1 (1-enable, 0-disable). Default 0 (off).

settings.name: kycVerificationVendor
settings.description:
**Default Value:** `SANDBOX`
**Supported Values:** `SANDBOX`, `DIGIO`

Company-level setting used to select the vendor for PAN and Aadhaar verification during outlet, warehouse and distributor add/edit.
* `SANDBOX` - verification is done through Sandbox.
* `DIGIO` - verification is done through Digio.

**Note:** Any other value falls back to `SANDBOX`.

settings.name: retailer_block_add_employee
settings.description: Retailer App setting that blocks admin level users from adding employees for the given Outlet Type / Outlet Category IDs (comma-separated); 0 allows all and -1 blocks all. Default: {"outlettype":"0","outletcategory":"0"}.

settings.name: crossSellNeighbourRadiusKm
settings.description:
This is a Company level numeric setting which defines the radius (in KM) used to find neighbouring outlets for RI Copilot cross-sell recommendations. Being Company level, it can be switched on and tuned per brand. The default value is 10.
0 - Disabled. Falls back to the existing beat-based logic for picking neighbouring outlets.
Any positive number - Outlets within this radius (in KM) of the outlet are considered neighbours for cross-sell.

Allowed values are whole numbers from 0 to 25. The suggested range is 1 to 25 KM; very large values widen the neighbour set and can dilute recommendations.

settings.name: restrictionTransaction
settings.description:
Default Value: {"Primaryorder":"0","Primarysalereturn":"0"}

The restriction will be managed through a single JSON configuration, allowing separate control for Primary Order and Primary Sales Return.

Configuration JSON:
{
  "Primaryorder": "1",
  "Primarysalereturn": "0"
}

Configuration Details
ParameterDescription
PrimaryorderMaximum number of Primary Orders allowed per distributor per calendar day.
PrimarysalereturnMaximum number of Primary Sales Returns allowed per distributor per calendar day.

Validation Rules
  • 0 - Restriction disabled for the respective transaction type.
  • 1-5 - Maximum permitted transactions per distributor per calendar day.
  • Order and Sales Return limits are validated independently.
  • Validation is based on Distributor Code and calendar date, irrespective of Distributor or Sales Officer channel.
  • Validation must be performed before pushing the transaction to SAP.
  • If a distributor has already raised a return with or without an invoice today, they should not be allowed to raise another return with or without an invoice today, irrespective of the return or invoice date.
  • For example, if a distributor attempts to raise a return today by selecting an invoice dated 29th September, the system should check whether the distributor has already raised any return today, irrespective of the date associated with the previous return. If a return already exists for today, the system should restrict the distributor from raising another return.
Example
For the configuration above:
  • Primaryorder: "1" - Allows a maximum of 1 Primary Order per distributor per day.
  • Primarysalereturn: "0" - No daily restriction on Primary Sales Returns.

settings.name: SuggestedOrderMinYearlyTransaction
settings.description:
This is a Company level numeric setting which defines the minimum number of transactions an outlet-SKU pair must have in the past year to be included in RI Copilot Suggested Order model training and prediction. The default value is 6.
Outlet-SKU pairs with fewer transactions than this value in the past year are excluded from Suggested Orders.

Allowed values are whole numbers from 1 to 50. The suggested range is 3 to 8; a higher value excludes more slow moving SKUs, while a lower value includes more SKUs but may reduce recommendation quality.

settings.name: enableBatOfflineFlow
settings.description: Default is 0. Setting supports values 0 and 1. When set to 1, BAT offline flow is enabled in addmultiple: bypasses all business validations (van stock limits, loadout settlement check, credit limits/days, purchase limits) and stores comprehensive audit trail in offline_payment_audit_logs.

settings.name: Orderfulfillmentinapp
settings.description: This setting will control where the Order Fulfillment option is displayed in the app. When the setting value is 0, the existing behaviour will continue: Order Fulfillment will be displayed in the Hamburger Menu and Outlet Info screen. The sequence of the Order Fulfillment menu will be configured using AppTabSequences. When the setting value is 1: The Order Fulfillment tab will be moved inside the outlet Start Call flow. AppTabSequences will be used to configure the sequence of Order Fulfillment within the Start Call. Note: Direct fulfillment of the order will not be supported when setting value is 1.

settings.name: enableDeliveryConfirmationInRetailerApp
settings.description: Enables or disables the Delivery Confirmation feature in the Retailer App. When enabled (1), retailers can confirm delivery directly from My Orders, Order Details, and Notification Order Updates through a pop-up. Default: 0 (Disabled).

settings.name: enableBeatOpSplit
settings.description: This is a company-level setting that controls access to the Beat Op Split page in Bizom Web (Beats > Beat Op Split). The setting accepts 0 or 1 and is disabled by default with a value of 0. When the value is 0 the page is not accessible and users are redirected to the dashboard. When the value is set to 1 the page becomes available, allowing the Customer Success team to (a) upload an outlet master and get every outlet tagged In-City or Up-Country based on its road distance from its own distributor, and (b) upload the Rhythm Beat Details exports and get the 48 optimiser beats stitched into 24 beats per month per salesperson. Both options process the file in the background and email a download link to the resulting Excel file. This setting does not write any data into beats, beat details or PJP; the output is a file only.

settings.name: beatOpSplitBoundaryKm
settings.description: This is a company-level setting that defines the road distance in kilometres used to separate In-City outlets from Up-Country outlets on the Beat Op Split page. The default value is 14. For every outlet the system calculates the straight line distance from the distributor mapped to that outlet and converts it to a road distance by multiplying by 1.35. An outlet whose road distance is less than or equal to this setting is tagged In-City, and an outlet above it is tagged Up-Country. The tag is written into the Consumer Channel column of the output file so that it can be used directly as a plan filter in the beat optimiser. Only positive numeric values are accepted and the value may include decimals. This setting has no effect unless enableBeatOpSplit is set to 1.

settings.name: splitordernew
settings.description: Description to be provided by product.

settings.name: reorder
settings.description:
Controls the availability of the Reorder option for completed Primary Orders.
Enabled (value 1): Displays the Reorder button for eligible Primary Orders. Clicking Reorder creates a draft cart with the same order quantities prefilled and redirects the user to the Cart (Place Order) screen.
Disabled (value 0): Hides the Reorder button.
Scope: Supported only for Primary Orders on the web interface. Secondary Orders are not supported.
Note: If this setting is enabled at the warehouse level, it must also be enabled for both the buyer and seller. The Reorder option will be displayed based on the applicable buyerâ€“seller combination.

settings.name: autoapprovegrnsalereturn
settings.description: Multi-valued, comma-separated. Default 0, feature disabled. 1 - Sale returns arising from Primary GRN discards are auto-approved. 2 - Sale returns arising from Secondary GRN discards are auto-approved. 3 - sale returns arising from Retailer App GRN discards are auto-approved.

settings.name: OTPvalidategrn
settings.description: Controls OTP validation for GRN acceptance. primarygrn: 0 = no OTP (default), 1 = OTP sent to the distributor on Approve in Primary GRN (Web/App) and must be entered before the GRN is accepted. secondarygrn: 0 = no OTP (default), 1 = OTP sent to the salesman marking the GRN on Settle/Submit (loadout sheet settlement on Web(OTP sent to Loadsheet assigned user), delivery on App), 2 = OTP sent to the retailer's registered outlet phone number instead; the OTP must be entered before the loadout sheet is settled(setting value 2, supported only in app). retailerappgrn: 0 = no OTP (default), 1 = OTP sent to the retailer's registered outlet phone number on Approve in Retailer App GRN and must be entered before the GRN is accepted.

settings.name: orderblockgrn
settings.description: Blocks primary ordering based on pending GRNs. Default: {"value":"0","pendingdaysGRN":"10","Primaryorder":"1","Secondaryorder":"1"}. value: 0 = setting disabled, 1 = enabled. When enabled, Primaryorder: 0 = no change to current ordering behaviour, 1 = primary ordering is blocked if the oldest pending GRN has been outstanding for more than pendingdaysGRN days. Same goes for secondaryorders.

settings.name: allowcreditnoteredemption
settings.description: This setting enables users to manually redeem Credit Notes against open Invoices and Debit Notes. Setting value = 0: Manual redemption is disabled. Users cannot manually redeem Credit Notes against open Invoices or Debit Notes. Setting value = 1: Manual redemption is enabled. Users can manually adjust Credit Notes against open Invoices and Debit Notes without making a collection. Setting value = 2: Manual redemption is enabled only for adjusting Credit Notes against open Debit Notes, without making a collection. Setting value = 3: Manual redemption is enabled only for adjusting Credit Notes against open invoices / payments, without making a collection. Supported Flow:  This functionality is supported on the UI through: /collections/collectionInvoicewise & In the App, this functionality is supported when the crdrnoteredemptioninapp setting is enabled. Note: This functionality is not supported in the New Collection (NetSaleCollection) flow in the App. This setting will be supported only when manual redemption for Credit Notes is enabled through the creditnoteautoredeemmodule setting.

settings.name: orderCommentOnSummary
settings.description:
Controls the Comment field on the Order Summary screen in the Bizom Next app. Supported values are 0, 1 and 2.
0 - Default. Existing behaviour, no change for any company.
1 - Comment field is shown and is optional.
2 - Comment field is shown and is mandatory.

settings.name: nativeCameraForMerchandising
settings.description:
This setting decides which camera is used for merchandising in the app. * **0** - Third party camera SDK is used (existing flow). * **1** - Native camera support (inbuilt iOS or Android camera) is used.
**Default Value:** `0`
**Note:** This setting is applicable only to the **App**.

settings.name: enableNova
settings.description: This setting enables the RI Sales Coach feature in the Bizom Next app for users.

settings.name: jointWorkingFilters
settings.description: Joint Working participant filters.This is  User / Role / Designation level setting (use Designation level for designations outside the sales hierarchy, such as marketing or channel managers; do not enable for salesmen). Default value: {"enabled": 0, "designation": 1, "restrictToMapped": 1}. Value (JSON) keys: enabled - 1: the Plan Joint Working participant list is built from the Zone and Warehouse filters (both always shown, mandatory, single select) and the reporting hierarchy (jointworkinguserfilter) is ignored. 0 or setting absent: no filters, the list comes from the reporting hierarchy exactly as before. designation - 1: an optional Designation filter (multi select) is shown. 0: the Designation filter is hidden. Only used when enabled is 1. restrictToMapped - 1: Zone and Warehouse options are limited to the zones and warehouses mapped to the user. 0: all active zones are listed and, once a zone is chosen, all active warehouses of that zone. Only used when enabled is 1.

settings.name: mandateAssetRegistrationFromOrders
settings.description:
User-level setting that controls whether assets can be registered only through approved orders. **Supported Values:** * **0 (Default):** Off. Existing scan and search functionality remains unchanged. The "Register Against Approved Order?" pop-up can still appear when an approved order has pending units of that asset. * **1:** On. Asset registration is allowed only through approved orders. Scan and search functionalities are disabled, and the following banner is displayed: "Only assets from approved orders can be registered. Tap Register on an asset above."
**Note:** This setting is applicable only to the **App**.

settings.name: enableUserAssignedBeats
settings.description:
This is a User/Role/Designation level setting. The allowed values for this setting are 0/1. By default it will be 0 (disabled) and when set to 1 it is enabled.

When enabled, the beats of a user come from the beats actively assigned to that user in user_assigned_beats (through the User Assigned Beats MDM) instead of the beats in the user's PJP:
* The beat-wise outlets API (getbeatwiseoutletsnew) returns the outlets of every assigned beat. An assigned beat planned in the PJP keeps its PJP dates in fordate; an assigned beat that is not planned is sent with an empty fordate.
* Only assigned beats can be picked while planning the PJP (getuserapplicablebeat).
* When a manager syncs a team member (userId), the team member's setting and assigned beats are used.

If the user has no active assigned beats, no beats are returned.

settings.name: CustomOutletFormId
settings.description: This Setting is used to set form id that needs to be Used in Custom outlet data MDM for BAT Vietnam company

settings.name: retailergrn
settings.description: Retailer App setting, warehouse wise. Default 0 - GRN disabled in the retailer app. 1 - GRN enabled in the retailer app. Affects the retailer app only, with no impact on the SFA app. Works only for white-labelled apps.

settings.name: enableDBtoDBLCMExemption
settings.description:
Default Value: 0

Skip LCM quantity validation on Primary Orders and Sales between distributors (DB to DB).
  • 0 - Disabled. LCM applies as today.
  • 1 - Enabled. LCM is skipped when both the seller and the buyer outlet are warehouses with isdistributor = 1.
Note: Resolved on the seller warehouse. Secondary Orders are not affected.

settings.name: restrictbeatasdropdown
settings.description:
This setting decides whether the beat dropdown on the Outlets (Maps / List) screen depends on a PJP being planned for the day. * **0** - The dropdown does not depend on a PJP. It works as set by **showbeatsasdropdown**. * **1** - The dropdown shows beats only when a PJP is planned for today. With no PJP planned, tapping the dropdown shows the "Beat Switching Disabled" pop-up asking the user to plan a beat (Tour Program > Plan > PJP Plan).
**Default Value:** `0`
**Note:** Works only when **showbeatsasdropdown** is 1 or 2; with 0 (sliding tabs) it has no effect. This setting is applicable only to the **App**.

settings.name: outletleveldefaultcash
settings.description:
Controls the default outlet credit level at outlet creation. Supported values are 0 & 1.
0 - Existing behaviour, the outlet level is determined from the distributor's outlet level.
1 - All outlets created under the distributor / warehouse are assigned Cash level, irrespective of the distributor's outlet level.
Default value is 0. Can be enabled company wide or for specific distributors / warehouses.

settings.name: excludeBackendTxsFromVisits
settings.description:
This setting decides whether orders, sale returns, collections and other transactions created from the backend (web, MDM, API) can make an outlet count as visited. * **0** - Any transaction on an outlet in the salesman's PJP can mark it visited (existing behaviour). * **1** - Only activity done on the app counts as a visit. Transactions created from the backend are shown separately and do not create, complete or make a visit productive.
**Default Value:** `0`
**Note:** Takes effect on the next app sync. Days already submitted are not recalculated. Clients that capture field calls in their own app and push them through the API should keep this at 0.

settings.name: Merchandising_camera_resolution
settings.description:
This setting controls the resolution of the images clicked by the camera in Merchandising. The value is the image resolution in pixels (**res x res**) and can be set from **1000 x 1000** to **4000 x 4000**. * **4000** - High resolution (4000 x 4000) * **3000** - Medium resolution (3000 x 3000) - default * **2000** - Low resolution (2000 x 2000)
**Default Value:** `3000`
**Note:** This setting is applicable only to the **App** and takes effect on the next app sync.
Applicable only to parallel dots camera.

settings.name: TourPJPCalendarMerge
settings.description: Setting to decide if the PJP calendar should be merged into the calendar on the Tour Program screen. Set the value to 1 to show the PJP entries along with the Tour Program entries in the Tour Program calendar. Set the value to 0 (default) to keep the existing separate calendars.

settings.name: enableNewSkuCardDesign
settings.description:
This setting decides which SKU design is shown on the Order and Sale screens. * **0** - Existing SKU design is used. * **1** - New SKU design (2 column grid, showing prices and multiple order quantity fields per SKU) is used.
**Default Value:** `0`
**Note:** This setting is applicable only to the **Order** and **Sale** screens.

settings.name: gyftr_client
settings.description: Company-level setting for the Gyftr loyalty partner. Value (JSON): {"client": "jkc", "staging_sso_url": "<staging sso base url>", "production_sso_url": "<production sso base url>"}. `client` is the client name sent to the api gateway sign-on token API (sent as `<client>-gyftr`); supported client values: jkc. The user is redirected to the staging or production SSO url based on the environment, with access_token and user_phone appended, when opening the loyalty page.

settings.name: einvoiceFromService
settings.description:
Decides how India E-Invoicing (IRN generation) is processed when the warehouse/distributor has the setting isEInvoiceEnabled = 1. Default value is 0.
0: the invoice is submitted to the GST portal directly from the application (existing flow).
1: the invoice request is sent to the E-Invoice service through the API gateway, which generates the IRN. With 1, Bulk IRN generation retry counts only the logs already sent to the service (reference id present, action generateIRN) against the limit of 3 attempts.
This setting has no effect when isEInvoiceEnabled is 0, 2 or 3. It replaces the einvoiceFromService key earlier kept in the core config file.
